At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

This position is for a Senior Software Engineer with at least 5 years of professional experience. If you enjoy working in hands-on multidiscipline teams, the Test Solutions Team is interested in hearing from you.

**This position is 100% on-site in Huntsville, AL**

The Test Solutions (TS) Directorate is a multi-discipline organization responsible for developing test solutions for all Raytheon products. Our engineers are responsible for all elements of the development of the lifecycle for test.

Your qualifications could add tremendous value to our team. Our customers come from all different backgrounds, and so do our employees. If you’re passionate about what you could accomplish here, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You Will Do**

The Senior Software Engineer (Test Engineering) will develop, integrate, and sustain software solutions that support automated test equipment (ATE), system verification, hardware bring‑up, and test workflow optimization. This role requires strong proficiency in C++ and C#, hands-on experience with Microsoft Visual Studio and NI TestStand, and a solid understanding of configuration management and software release processes. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in software debugging, test‑system development, hardware–software integration, and designing wrapper interfaces for hardware drivers. Experience within Agile engineering teams is essential.

**What You Will Learn**

* Develop and maintain test software, test sequences, and automation frameworks using C++ and C#.
* Create and integrate hardware driver wrappers and abstraction layers to support automated test environments.
* Implement test sequences, step types, and automation logic using NI TestStand.
* Debug complex issues across hardware interfaces, test equipment, software modules, and system-level interactions.
* Collaborate with test engineers to design test strategies, validate hardware performance, and refine test coverage.
* Support hardware bring‑up and troubleshooting during system integration and verification activities.
* Manage software configuration, version control, branching, and release processes for test applications.
* Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and team ceremonies.
* Develop documentation for test procedures, test architecture, system integration workflows, and release notes.
* Partner with systems engineering, hardware engineering, and manufacturing test teams to ensure test reliability and repeatability.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Strong proficiency in C++ and C#, including hardware‑related and system‑level development.
* Experience developing automated test sequences using NI TestStand.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Visual Studio for development and debugging.
* Demonstrated capability in root‑cause analysis, troubleshooting, and diagnostic workflows.
* Hands-on experience integrating software with hardware components, test equipment, or embedded systems.
* Understanding of configuration management, code versioning, and software release practices.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments.
* Ability to design and maintain software wrappers for hardware drivers and test instrumentation.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* An active U.S. government issued security clearance is required to start. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Master’s degree in an engineering discipline.
* Experience developing or supporting automated test equipment (ATE) or hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems.
* Familiarity with real‑time or embedded systems used in test architectures.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated build servers, and test orchestration tools.
* Experience with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, LabVIEW scripting, etc.) for automation or data processing.
* Prior experience in industries requiring rigorous testing (aerospace, defense, automotive, medical devices).
* Experience performing system verification, environmental testing, or production test development.
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to test framework strategy and process improvements.

**What We Offer**

* A total rewards package that goes above and beyond with compensation; healthcare, wellness, and work/life benefits; career development and recognition programs. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

The Principal Software Engineer is the most senior hands-on technical role on our software team, combining deep full-stack engineering expertise with cloud architecture leadership. This role sets the technical direction for our cloud-based sensor management and data analytics software product called PRISM and related intelligent water platforms. You will design and build across the full stack in C#, .NET, and Angular, shape how our platforms scale in Azure, and raise the engineering bar for the entire team. To succeed in this role, you will have a passion for Agile software development with multi-terabyte datasets, foster a culture of collaboration and innovation, and ship high-quality software that delivers value for our customers.

  

We’re a globally distributed team that embraces the culture of remote working. We move fast by building our products in the Microsoft Azure cloud ecosystem using agile software development techniques, automated testing, continuous integration, and microservices.

  

We’re a team that’s very passionate about the products we create because of the long-term positive effects we’re able to have on millions of people around the globe. We make the world a better place through our software and IoT hardware products that provide information on municipal water collection systems. As the leader in our industry and with over 50 years of experience, our business is experiencing unbelievable growth yet has a stable business model allowing us to invest in long-term software projects.

  

**Primary Duties:**

* Serve as the senior technical leader for PRISM and related cloud platforms, setting technical direction, engineering standards, and the long-term architecture roadmap in partnership with software leadership.
* Using strong computer science fundamentals, design and write highly-performant, scalable, and secure software APIs and services with C#, ASP.NET Core, Cosmos DB, and other Azure technologies.
* Lead front-end architecture in Angular and TypeScript, driving UI performance, consistency, and user experience improvements across our applications.
* Design and evolve our cloud architecture, including microservices, containers, and Kubernetes, balancing scalability, reliability, security, and cost.
* Implement and manage cloud security measures to protect against unauthorized access and data breaches.
* Develop a strong DevOps practice within our software team, helping us to achieve good, automated unit test coverage, CI/CD, automated infrastructure, and teach us how to be more efficient and toil less.
* Lead design and code reviews and establish best practices that raise the quality bar across the team.
* Mentor engineers at all levels and lead cross-training initiatives with UI and API best practices in mind.
* Work with a team that includes front-end developers, back-end developers, data scientists, business analysts, QA, and hardware/firmware teams to turn business requirements into sound technical designs.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, including AI-enabled features and AI-assisted development tools, where they deliver real business value.
* Create and maintain architecture documentation and guidelines for how ADS can best use cloud computing.
* Participate in all aspects of software development: from estimating to scheduling, to implementation and release, and resolution of complex production issues.
* Provide input on improving the software organization to increase throughput, improve quality, and continuously improve processes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, or a related degree, or equivalent professional experience
* 10+ years production coding experience with .NET, C#, Angular, and TypeScript in an agile environment
* Proven experience as a technical lead or architect on large-scale, cloud-based SaaS applications
* Solid database skills with Azure Cosmos DB, SQL Server, or other non-relational technologies (Redis, MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.)
* A strong understanding of microservice architectures and how they can be built in a containerized, Kubernetes-managed environment • Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting applications in Microsoft Azure
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing using Azure DevOps and Git
Ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with high-scale SaaS software systems built for the cloud.
* Experience with IoT, telemetry, or time-series data at multi-terabyte scale • Azure-based cloud architecture and migration experience; Azure certifications a plus
* Experience integrating AI/ML or LLM services into production applications
* Familiarity with security and compliance practices for cloud and industrial systems
* Experience with MS Azure, Amazon AWS or Google Cloud
* Experience in the water, wastewater, or utilities industry

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

IES is a Systems Integrator that specializes in designing and building industrial control systems and custom manufacturing equipment. IES works in the following industrial sectors; automotive, chemical, manufacturing, food & beverage, pulp & paper, and wood products. We are staffed with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, mechanical designers, and electrical and mechanical assembly personnel. IES specializes in PLC Control Systems, Industrial Robotics, Motor Controls, Vision Systems, and Custom Manufacturing Equipment.

IES is looking for an experience controls engineer that is capable of designing, building, and installing turnkey control systems. We are looking for an engineer that is self-reliant, willing to learn and adapt to each new project and that has well-developed problem-solving skills.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Design Electrical Control Panels for Machines and Control Systems.
* Design and Build PLC programs.
* Design and Build HMI Programs.
* Design Systems using current safety procedures and practices.
* Startup and troubleshoot VFD and motor controls.
* Startup and troubleshoot Servo Motor Applications.
* Understand and troubleshoot Industrial Networking.
* Manage individual projects, including budget control, customer communication, scheduling, installation, and startup.
* Program Industrial Robots (I.e. Fanuc) (not required but desired)
* Understand and troubleshoot PLC controllers, industrial networks such as Ethernet/IP and Profinet, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* Travel is required but not excessive (25%)

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering.
* PLC Programming experience. Rockwell Automation and GE/Emerson products preferred.
* Experience with Electrical Theory, Robotics, Controls Components, and Automated Equipment
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, programming, and designing HMI and control network components
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including Motor Starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and Standard Electrical Components
* Industrial electrical hands-on experience and troubleshooting, including 480V 3-phase, 110 VAC, and 24VDC systems
* Experience interpreting, modifying, and developing mechanical and electrical drawings

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**nou Systems, Inc. (nSI) is a 100% employee-owned company!** We value teamwork and collaboration, and this transition allows us to take that commitment to a new level. nSI empowers our customers by supplying products, services, and expertise with powerful, data driven insights that transform defense systems and improve capabilities.

We are pleased to announce the opening for a Data Platforms Integrator (Engineer 4 / Analyst 4), who will support the Missile Defense Agency's (MDA) Next Generation Environment (NGE) program and become part of our technology company operating in missile defense, cybersecurity, test range modernization, biotechnology, and space control marketspaces. You will be part of a team known for delivering innovative technical solutions that support critical national security missions.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor in a Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) capacity, directly supporting the Government Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and NGE leadership. You will provide technical oversight and integration guidance for the NGE Data Design Area, supporting the development of a secure, resilient hybrid multi-cloud environment.

You will evaluate existing applications, databases, and modern data platforms across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments to ensure alignment with the Department of Defense (DoD) Zero Trust Strategy. Your work will focus on data discovery, classification, protection, and access governance to ensure mission-critical information remains secure and accessible only to authorized users.

**Responsibilities:**

You'll be responsible for:

* Serving as a senior technical authority in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), evaluating proposed database architectures, data storage solutions, and data pipelines against NGE requirements and DoD Zero Trust mandates.
* Conducting technical assessments of existing mission applications, relational databases, NoSQL environments, and object storage repositories to identify modernization opportunities and Zero Trust integration gaps.
* Providing architectural oversight for enterprise data discovery, automated cataloging, classification, labeling, and tagging across hybrid multi-cloud environments.
* Designing and validating data protection solutions, including data-at-rest encryption, automated Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data rights management, and dynamic data masking.
* Ensuring data platform architectures align with DISA Thunderdome Zero Trust capabilities, including Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), and enterprise DLP policies.
* Developing and evaluating fine-grained Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) solutions using Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) attributes and contextual risk assessments.
* Overseeing integration of Policy Enforcement Points (PEPs) and Policy Decision Points (PDPs) to support dynamic authorization and secure data access.
* Providing technical guidance for data virtualization, database security, and access governance across AWS, Azure, and on-premises VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments.
* Ensuring compliance with DoD Data-at-Rest (DAR) requirements, Key Management Service (KMS) integration standards, Hardware Security Module (HSM) requirements, and applicable JSIG and NIST SP 800-207 guidelines.
* Evaluating data platform modernization strategies and integration approaches to improve interoperability, security, and enterprise data governance.
* Leading technical exchange meetings (TEMs) with integration contractors, database vendors, and security technology providers to evaluate proposed solutions and resolve cross-platform integration challenges.
* Translating Government leadership requirements into actionable engineering solutions while maintaining alignment with NGE architecture and DoD cybersecurity standards.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* You must have a Master's degree in a STEM discipline with at least 12 years of engineering or IT architectural experience, or a Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline with at least 20 years of relevant experience. Degrees in Computer Science, Data Management, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline are preferred.
* You must have a minimum of 6 years of experience analyzing, architecting, and integrating complex enterprise databases, including relational database management systems (RDBMS), NoSQL platforms, storage solutions, and data pipelines.
* You must have demonstrated experience designing and implementing Zero Trust data protection solutions, including automated data classification, data rights management, dynamic access governance, and encryption.
* You must have hands-on experience architecting and securing enterprise data storage and analytics services across both AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.
* You must have experience designing, accrediting, and operating data platforms within classified DoD environments.
* You must possess an active Top Secret security clearance with current SCI eligibility (TS/SCI).
* You must meet DoD 8140/8570 requirements for an IAM Level III or IASAE Level II/III position.
* You must possess an active (ISC)² Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
* You must be a U.S. citizen to be eligible for this position.

Lacking any one of these disqualifies you from this job.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty or AWS Certified Database – Specialty certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator (SC-400) certification.
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) certification.
* Experience implementing DISA Thunderdome Zero Trust capabilities and applying the DoD Data Strategy, DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, and NIST SP 800-207.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DataOps automati

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer / Counter-UAS
jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer – Counter-UAS (C-UAS)**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineer to support the design, development, and integration of Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS). This role focuses on electrical architecture, power distribution, signal integrity, and integration of advanced sensor and countermeasure technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience working with complex, mission-critical systems in defense, aerospace, or similar high-reliability environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop electrical systems and architectures for C-UAS platforms, including power distribution, signal routing, and grounding strategies
* Support integration of radar, RF detection systems, EO/IR sensors, communications equipment, and countermeasure technologies
* Create schematics, wiring diagrams, harness designs, and electrical documentation
* Perform electrical analysis, including power budgets, noise/interference mitigation, and signal integrity assessments
* Collaborate with RF, software, mechanical, and systems engineers to ensure seamless system integration
* Support PCB design and review processes, including layout guidance for EMI/EMC performance
* Develop and execute test plans for electrical subsystems, including bring-up, validation, and troubleshooting
* Ensure compliance with military and industry standards (e.g., MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-704, DO-160)
* Interface with vendors and manufacturers for component selection, procurement, and production support
* Support field testing, debugging, and system deployment activities

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline
* 5+ years of experience in electrical design and system integration
* Strong understanding of power systems, analog/digital circuitry, and embedded interfaces
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB design tools (Altium, OrCAD, KiCad, etc.)
* Knowledge of EMI/EMC principles and mitigation techniques
* Experience troubleshooting complex electrical systems
* Familiarity with common communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, CAN)
* Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C-UAS, UAV, electronic warfare, or radar systems
* Background in RF systems or high-frequency design considerations
* Experience with power electronics, battery systems, or ruggedized hardware
* Knowledge of SWaP (Size, Weight, and Power) constraints for mobile or deployable systems
* Familiarity with FPGA-based systems or high-speed digital design
* Experience supporting environmental and qualification testing
* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
* Active security clearance or ability to obtain one

**Key Skills**

* Electrical system architecture and design
* Power distribution and management
* EMI/EMC compliance and mitigation
* System integration and troubleshooting
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Technical documentation and analysis

jobs.description:
**Note:** Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, **you must have the ability to work in the United States without a need for current or future visa sponsorship**.

* **Must be local to Raleigh/Durham, NC Area or Bentonville, AR Area. This is a hybrid role at least 3 days a week in person.**

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Front-End (UI) Platform Engineer-Retail Point of Sale Systems to own and evolve the ELERA point-of-sale client – the Vue 3 and TypeScript application framework behind our fixed-lane, self-checkout, kiosk, specialty, associate-mobile, and customer-display experiences. This is a successor role on a defined architect track: the person hired will be trained to become the architect for the ELERA POS client.

This is a platform role, not a feature role. Most of the work is not screens. It is the framework other teams build their screens out of: a dependency-injection and plugin system that retailers and partners extend through, a configuration merge chain that resolves customer overrides, a device layer that talks to lane hardware, a legacy Dojo application that must keep shipping beside the modern client, and the build train that releases all of it together.

The role requires experience building solutions on Vue.js and Java enterprise technologies with a focus on complex browser-side functionality. The ideal candidate will excel in our fast-paced, collaborative, customer-first environment, and is looking for a path into architecture rather than a larger backlog.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and test/debug client UI and client framework code in Vue 3 and TypeScript, and mentor the team doing the same

* Design with other developers in mind – both the internal team and the retailer, partner, and services engineers who extend the platform from outside

* Own and extend the client extensibility model: dependency injection and decorator-based registration, plugin loading, UI slot injection, and the base/TGCS/partner/customer configuration merge chain

* Maintain backward compatibility for plugins and customizations built against earlier framework versions

* Publish versioned shared packages consumed by other teams, with real semantic-versioning and deprecation discipline

* Keep two UI generations shippable at once, migrating the legacy Dojo layer incrementally rather than by flag day

* Extend the device integration layer – scanners, scales, printers, payment terminals, cash recyclers, customer display – including the mock device harness that lets the full client run on a laptop

* Maintain the client release train: hybrid Maven/npm builds, monorepo publishing, Jenkins multi-branch pipelines across the framework dependency chain, and constrained or air-gapped customer environments

* Own client-side quality: unit and component tests under a coverage gate, and a browser-automated BDD suite that gates the build

* Write and defend architecture decision records, component analyses, and solution designs; represent the client stack at the Architecture Review Board

* Maintain the client Self-Enablement Guide and generated extension catalogs, and serve as a technical interface to key technology partners

* Perform unit and functional tests of product features, and resolve unit, functional, and customer- or partner-reported defects across supported release lines

* Provide reasonable estimates, meet deliverables while assisting the team, and enable the team to meet their KPIs

* Use good programming patterns, call out anti-patterns, and handle accelerating change in pursuit of more innovative solutions

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience

* Software Engineer III: 5+ years of professional web development experience. Software Engineer IV: 9+ years of full-stack web development experience, particularly client side

* Strong analytical and TypeScript/OO programming skills, including generics, declaration files, and strict-mode discipline

* 2+ years in Vue 3 or an equivalent modern component framework, at depth: reactivity semantics, routing, and centralized state management

* Experience building shared libraries or frameworks that other teams consume – not only end-user features

* Working knowledge of a dependency-injection / inversion-of-control container (InversifyJS, tsyringe, Angular DI, Spring, or similar) and decorator-based registration; understanding of lifetimes and resolution order

* Deep technical skills in web development technologies (HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SASS, XML/JSON, Vue.js), including module-system fluency (ESM, AMD, UMD) and modern build tooling such as Vite

* Unit testing as a default habit, plus browser automation with at least one of Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium – including the ability to diagnose a flaky test rather than retry it

* Demonstrated ability to work productively inside a large legacy code base without rewriting it

* Experience developing in a Java-based environment, including enterprise/web-based content, sufficient to debug a service you do not own and determine where a defect actually lives

* REST and OpenAPI contract thinking, including a working definition of a breaking change

* Comfort in CI/CD: pipelines, containerized builds, artifact registries, dependency resolution, lockfiles, and transitive version conflicts

* Proficiency with Git at team scale: long-lived release lines, backports, and conflict resolution that does not lose work

* Experience with operating systems – Linux, Windows, iOS or Android; installation, light administration, and simple scripting

* Knowledge of software development concepts, methodology, and life cycle, especially Agile

* Clear technical writing, and a record of documenting decisions that others then followed. Communication is a hiring criterion for this role, not a bonus

jobs.title: Senior Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**  
The Avionics team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Terran R's nervous system — designing, building, testing, installing, and operating the hardware that connects and controls every major electrical system on the vehicle and ground. Engineers are deeply embedded into other functions within Relativity, working closely with propulsion, GNC, fluids, and stage engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and operation. As a Staff Engineer, you'll help shape Terran R's fundamental avionics architecture, own critical flight hardware, and build and grow the team that delivers it.  
  
**About the Role:**  
You will join the team developing the vehicle's high-voltage battery system and grow into technical ownership of it as a complete product, covering cell, mechanical, thermal, electrical/BMS, and vehicle integration. Early on, you will work closely with experienced battery engineers to learn the current design, its history, and how it flies. Over time, you will take on more of the system's technical direction. You will be the link between the battery's mechanical and electrical disciplines and the rest of the vehicle. You'll help turn mission and vehicle needs into a clear, traceable battery specification, and help shape the architecture that meets it. This is a hands-on technical role with real cross-functional influence. As the battery team grows, it offers a clear path to technical leadership, including leading other engineers.  
  
Architecture & Requirements

* Partner with the vehicle and power-system architecture team to define battery requirements from the top down — deriving energy, power, voltage, thermal, mass/volume, and life requirements from mission profile, ConOps, and power-system needs rather than anchoring on legacy designs
* Own and maintain the battery specification — the single source of truth for battery requirements, interfaces, and verification criteria — with full traceability
* Drive battery architecture and cell down-selection through documented trade studies (requirement driver options evaluation criteria rationale recommendation), in collaboration with the battery mechanical, test, and BMS engineers
* Define and manage interface control (electrical, mechanical, thermal, data) between the battery and the vehicle

Cross-Functional Definition

* Work with Flight Sciences, ConOps, and the Criteria team to define the battery's environmental and loads requirements — launch and flight vibration/shock, thermal environments, thermal cycling, EMI/EMC, altitude/vacuum, and mission duty cycles
* Partner with the avionics/EE team to define BMS requirements and scope — cell monitoring, balancing, protection (OVP/UVP/OCP), contactor/heater control, state estimation, and fault management
* Coordinate with the mechanical and vehicle-integration teams on packaging, mounting, thermal management, and installation interfaces
* Work with the criteria and structures teams to close structural, thermal, and safety margins

Safety & Verification

* Own battery safety architecture — thermal-runaway detection and propagation mitigation, venting/burst-disc strategy, physical cell protection, and hazard analysis
* Define the verification and qualification strategy — qualification and acceptance test programs at cell and pack level, test-as-you-fly philosophy, and the data systems that turn test results into rapid design feedback
* Lead FMEA/FTA, reliability analysis, and identification/mitigation of single points of failure

Program & Technical Leadership

* Carry technical program-management responsibility for the battery effort — schedule, risk, dependencies, and status — and serve as the organized, single point of communication for battery status across teams
* Represent the battery at vehicle design reviews (PDR/CDR-class), safety review boards, and cross-functional forums
* Support supplier and cell-vendor engagement, including benchmarking, RFI/RFQ evaluation, and technical down-selection
* Contribute to producibility/DFM and NPI as the design matures, and lead structured root-cause and corrective-action (RCCA) for anomalies

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, aerospace, chemical, or related)
* 5+ years of battery systems development experience across the product lifecycle (concept design qualification), including HV lithium-ion packs
* Demonstrated ability to derive and own requirements top-down, with rigorous trade studies and traceable specifications — not just execute a fixed design
* Working depth across the battery stack: cell selection/characterization, pack architecture, thermal management, BMS scope, and safety/abuse behavior
* Strong understanding of battery

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

### **Senior Electrical Engineer**

Parallel Systems is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to lead the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems for our production autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles. This role will own critical electrical architectures and subsystems, including power distribution, traction and braking interfaces, safety-critical control systems, wiring harnesses, and compute/sensor networks.

As a senior technical contributor, you will drive electrical engineering decisions from initial concept through production deployment, establish robust design and verification processes, and ensure reliable integration across mechanical, software, and autonomy systems. You will be responsible for developing high-reliability electrical systems that meet demanding performance, safety, and regulatory requirements while supporting the transition from prototype development to production.

The ideal candidate brings substantial experience designing and integrating complex electrical systems in automotive, rail, aerospace, or other vehicle-based applications. You are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, leading cross-functional engineering efforts, and balancing hands-on execution with system-level technical leadership.

#### **Responsibilities**

* **Own end-to-end electrical system development:** Lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems, including power distribution, wiring harnesses, commercial-off-the-shelf hardware, and electrical test infrastructure.
* **Drive technical design decisions:** Establish electrical design requirements, define system interfaces, evaluate design tradeoffs, and make recommendations that balance performance, reliability, safety, cost, and manufacturability.
* **Lead safety-critical engineering:** Develop and maintain system-level risk assessments, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (DFMEAs), hazard analyses, and verification and validation plans for critical electrical subsystems.
* **Lead system integration:** Coordinate electrical interfaces with mechanical, embedded software, controls, and autonomy teams to ensure reliable operation across vehicle subsystems and dependencies.
* **Drive hands-on testing and troubleshooting:** Lead hardware bring-up, bench testing, prototype vehicle integration, fault isolation, and root-cause analysis to resolve complex electrical and system-level issues.
* **Support production readiness:** Partner with manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to transition electrical designs from prototypes to production, addressing design-for-manufacturing, assembly, testability, and quality requirements.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer (Firmware)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
====================

Each year, 2.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics.

Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall-E-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self-driving in the home” with real-time 3D mapping, adaptive path-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on-device.

**Privacy First**
-----------------

What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud.

**Our Approach**
----------------

Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Matic is a tight-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy.

**About the role**
==================

As the name “firmware” may imply, this role closes the gap between our software and our hardware. In this role, you will be the hardware team’s window into Matic’s software, and you will be the software team’s window into Matic’s hardware. Firmware engineers are fundamentally cross-discipline and are expected to operate with product-focused systems-level thinking.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Firmware at Matic is a broad domain, and you will work on a wide variety of projects such as:

* Bring-up and support for hardware changes (electrical and mechanical). For example:

  + A new sensing mechanism to detect when the waste bag is full from water during mopping - requires updating device drivers to interface with the new sensor, implementing tests to ensure the new system is working as expected during assembly, and coordinating robot behaviors to accommodate the new system (data filtering, updating the bag fullness check).
* Design and improve the behavioral logic and controls algorithms for Matic’s physical systems
* Analyze robot logs along with motor and sensor data to debug hardware failures. For example:

  + Customer reports their Matic isn’t charging despite being properly docked
  + Employee testing their Matic at home mentions that their robot suddenly started making weird clicking sounds while mopping
* Support internal processes with tooling to interface with Matic’s motors and sensors

**What we look for**
--------------------

We're looking for strong software experience with electromechanical projects. This likely includes deep experience with microcontrollers (bare-metal programming, RTOS, communication protocols), a fundamental understanding of electronics (schematics, datasheets, motors, sensors, batteries), and intuition for physical systems (motors, moving parts, materials). You should have strong experience writing embedded C/C++, and we hope you are eager to learn Rust if you aren’t already familiar with it (see: why we use Rust).

### **Must haves:**

* 2+ years of industry experience or equivalent (e.g. grad school)
* Core software skills:

  + data structures, control flow, computer systems
  + deep experience with systems programming language(s): C, C++, rust, etc.
  + experience / comfort with scripting / prototyping language(s): python, etc.
* Experience with hardware (the more the better):

  + Motors (brushed and brushless DC, drivers, operating principles)
  + Controls systems
  + Sensors (datasheets, device drivers, data filtering)
  + Electrical fundamentals
  + Mechanical intuition
  + You’ve built things (robots, PCBs, 3D-printing, anything)
* Experience with microcontrollers (STM32, PIC, ESP32, etc.)
* Soft-skills:

  + Multi-disciplinary team & leadership experience
  + Thinks broadly, connecting insights from across the system to solve problems
  + Meticulous, detail oriented, organized
  + Fixated on edge-cases and testing

### **Nice to have:**

* Friendly & approachable personality

  + non-combative, selfless, team-first mentality
* Higher-level robotics exposure:

  + computer vision, machine learning, path planning, SLAM

**We’d love to hear from you if…**
----------------------------------

* You love diagnosing complex electromechanical issues
* You are genuinely motivated to help those around you
* You are passionate about learning outside of your normal comfort zones
* You are excited to do great work

**Compensation**

Base $120,000 — $200,000

Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience and qualifications. Base Salary is one part of the total compensation package. The role is also eligible for equity through the company’s discretionary equity program, along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision coverage access to a 401(k) plan.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Overlay & Networking
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------

The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.

**About the Job**
-----------------

Every Sentry Tower we ship, across Counter-Intrusion and Air Defense, boots from a common software platform: a NixOS-based overlay that defines the base images, the system services, the compute configuration for each hardware generation, and the network topology that ties the tower's payloads together. That platform is the foundation the entire product line stands on, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own it.

This is a systems and infrastructure role with unusually direct product consequences. The tower's network is not a datacenter network: it is a set of VLANs and bridges carrying camera, radar, GPS, and sensor-board traffic over a mix of mesh radio, cellular, and satellite backhaul, on hardware that sits at the far end of a very long support loop. When a business line adds a new payload with its own switch, or when a routing priority is wrong, the failure shows up in the field. You will own the topology as a contract: define it, document it, review changes against it, and make the correct integration the easy one.

You will also be a primary steward of our build and configuration system. Our images are fully declarative and reproducible, spanning several compute generations and a dozen product variants, and we are actively consolidating legacy per-product configurations into a common, composable base.

Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own the shared base of our NixOS overlay: system modules, compute platform definitions, common tower services, and the image definitions that every product variant composes from.
* Own the tower network topology end to end: VLAN and subnet allocation, bridging, link ranking and failover across heterogeneous backhaul, NAT and firewall policy, and the physical-port-to-payload mapping for each carrier board.
* Define and enforce the integration contract that business line teams use to add network-attached payloads, so their additions extend the platform instead of diverging from it.
* Drive the consolidation of legacy, per-product configurations into the common overlay, with build-time checks that keep them from drifting back apart.
* Support and extend our real-time messaging layer as services migrate from the legacy pub-sub bus to its next-generation replacement, including the topic and schema contracts that define who owns which data.
* Debug problems that cross every layer at once: kernel and device tree, systemd unit ordering, Nix evaluation, link-layer configuration, and the sensor daemons on top.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of professional software engineering with substantial time in Linux systems, embedded platforms, or infrastructure work.
* Deep, practical networking knowledge: VLANs, bridging, routing and policy routing, DHCP, multicast, NAT, and firewalling, plus fluency with ip, tcpdump, and Wireshark for diagnosing real traffic.
* Strong experience with declarative configuration management and reproducible builds. Nix or NixOS is what we use and what we most want to see; adjacent depth in Bazel, Buildroot, Yocto, or infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi) is a solid substitute.
* Proficiency in Rust or C++, enough to read and modify the services that sit on top of the platform, not just the configuration that deploys them.
* Comfort operating and troubleshooting real hardware: serial consoles, provisioning and reflashing, boot problems, and remote debugging of systems you cannot physically reach.
* Demonstrated ability to define a technical interface that other teams build against, and to hold that line through code review and documentation rather than authority.
* US person status required, with eligibility to obtain and maintain a US security clearance.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Hands-on NixOS experience, including writing modules and maintaining flakes.
* Python for tooling and automation.
* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Xavier, Orin, Thor) including BSP integration, device trees, and JetPack upgrades.
* Fleet-scale operational experience: over-the-air update systems, observability pipelines, or long-lived embedded deployments.
* Familiarity with CAN, SNMP, or managed-switch configuration in an embedded context.
* Experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for large build graphs and hardware-in-the-loop pipelines.

CHAOS is seeking a highly-skilled and motivated FPGA Engineer to join our team supporting our R&D and product engineering initially focusing on our next-generation radar products. As a member of our engineering team, you also have the opportunity to expand your skillset across our product families.

* Design and implement complex FPGA designs targeting our next-generation sensor products
* Support system integration of FPGA designs with complex software systems
* Support deployed FPGA capabilities in the hands of our U.S. and international customers
* Work full-time on-site in our office in Hawthorne, California

* 5+ years of experience in a professional setting performing detailed digital RTL design targeting FPGAs
* Extensive experience with the entire FPGA design life cycle: RTL design, behavioral simulation, place and route, timing analysis, hardware integration
* Extensive experience developing in Verilog and SystemVerilog
* Extensive experience with the ARM AMBA AXI Protocol (AXI4, AXI4-Lite, AXI4-Stream)
* Extensive experience with the AMD (Xilinx) Vivado Design Suite and SoC FPGAs (Zynq, Ultrascale/Ultrascale+, Versal)
* Experience with Network Protocols (TCP/UDP/IP)
* Experience with Serial Protocols (I2C, JTAG, UART, SPI, CAN)
* Experience using Bash and Python for scripting and testing
* Experience modifying software drivers and applications when needed to validate FPGA designs
* Experience with Agile lifecycle processes including Scrum, Continuous Integration, and Test-Driven Development Methodologies
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and collaborate on small teams
* U.S. Person status is required as this position will require the ability to access U.S.-only data systems

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience designing and implementing highly performant baseband signal processing in an FPGA
* Experience translating high level algorithms from Simulink/MATLAB or similar into RTL including FPGA Vendor IP implementations
* Experience developing and implementing software drivers (C/C++/Python) to interface with FPGA designs
* Experience with FPGA Ethernet IP blocks (1G/10G/40G/100G)
* Experience with Software-Defined Radios (SDRs) (e.g. Ettus, NI, HackRF)
* Experience with Analog Device Transceivers
* Experience in Ground or Airborne Sensors (Radars, EO/IR, EW, etc.)
* Experience with Time Synchronization technologies (NTP / PTP)
* Experience with HLS Synthesis and languages (C/C++/SystemC/Chisel)
* Experience with VHDL
* Experience with high-speed, multi-layer, digital printed circuit board (PCB) design
* Current or previous DoD security clearance
* Experience with GPUs and/or AI engines
* Experience with git
* Experience with Bitbucket CI, Jenkins or similar CI/CD flows
* Experience with DoD & related System/SW Architectures and messaging standards (e.g. OMS, SOSA, Link-16, etc)

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 500 employees and counting across 5 global offices

On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS) Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. This covers the board support package (BSP), kernel, OS image, update system, real-time behavior, GPU platform, and fleet tooling across every robot program and compute platform (AGX Thor, IGX Thor, and future NVIDIA silicon)
* Architect the next-generation OS image, including the move to a Yocto / meta-tegra based build. Make it reproducible, hermetic and secure, and make it fast for many engineers to iterate on
* Define and drive the production update strategy: atomic A/B and over-the-air updates, rollback, secure and verified boot, fusing and signing, and factory provisioning, so we can ship to a growing fleet safely
* Shape the platform's real-time architecture. Help define how CPU cores, interrupts, memory and the GPU are divided between control loops at kilohertz rates and large AI models. Set the latency budgets and the measurement infrastructure that proves we meet them
* Collaborate with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams alongside other Meta engineers: share requirements, push fixes upstream, and help plan how we adopt new Jetson Linux / JetPack releases with minimal fork debt
* Partner with electrical, firmware, and mechanical engineers on new compute and carrier-board designs. Weigh in early on SoC configuration, interfaces, power and thermal so boards are easier to bring up and software stays simpler
* Drive bring-up of new boards and modules end to end: boot chain (MB1/MB2, UEFI), BPMP and device tree, pinmux, PCIe/USB/Ethernet, power profiles, and the drivers for robot hardware (EtherCAT, USB-C power delivery, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, sensors, cameras)
* Help set the quality bar for the RT kernel and out-of-tree drivers: kernel configuration, ABI compatibility, and a plan to upstream changes or align with Meta's kernel instead of carrying long-lived patches
* Build the reliability and observability foundation: crash and kernel-log capture, symbolization, boot-time tracing, health telemetry, and fleet triage tooling, so that any robot failure can be diagnosed remotely
* Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, mentorship, and technical hiring. Grow OS and embedded talent on the team, and help shape on-call and operational practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience building and shipping system software for embedded Linux or Android-based products
* Experience architecting and owning an operating system, BSP or platform software stack on a shipped hardware product
* Deep experience with C and Linux kernel internals, including device drivers, device tree, scheduling, interrupts, and memory management
* Proficient in at least one of C++, Rust or Python
* Experience driving new-SoC or new-board bring-up on ARM64, from boot chain through kernel to a production OS
* Experience designing OS image build and release systems, such as Yocto/OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, Debian packaging or AOSP, including the strategy for updates and release management
* Experience debugging hard cross-layer problems spanning hardware, firmware, kernel and user space
* Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams or organizations, including external silicon or hardware vendors

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

**Principal Laser Controls Engineer**
-------------------------------------

### **Role Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Laser Controls Engineer to define and drive the control architecture for advanced laser-based optical modules. This role demands deep expertise in laser physics, control systems, and embedded implementation. You will own the technical vision for laser control—spanning optical power regulation, current control, thermal stabilization, and wavelength calibration—ensuring robust, scalable, and production-ready solutions across the full product lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and own the **end-to-end laser module control architecture**, including:

  + **APC (Automatic Power Control)** loops for stable optical output
  + **ACC (Automatic Current Control)** strategies for laser drive optimization
  + **Automatic calibration frameworks** (power, current, aging compensation, temperature drift)
  + TEC (Thermoelectric Cooler) control for wavelength and thermal stability
  
* Lead the design, modeling, and optimization of laser control loops, accounting for:

  + Laser non-linearities (L-I curves, threshold behavior)
  + Aging, degradation, and environmental variations
  + Noise, stability margins, and transient performance
  
* Architect **closed-loop control strategies** that balance performance, reliability, and manufacturability across PVT and lifetime conditions
  
* Develop and own module embedded **laser control firmware**, including:

  + Real-time control loops
  + Calibration routines (factory + in-field)
  + Fault detection, protection, and recovery mechanisms
  
* Establish **modeling and correlation frameworks** linking simulation to silicon and optical performance

### **Qualifications**

  

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Controls, or related field
  
* ~12–15+ years of experience with deep focus on **laser systems and control**
  
* Strong expertise in:

  + APC/ACC loop design and optimization
  + Laser behavior (L-I-V characteristics, thermal effects, degradation mechanisms)
  + Feedback control theory and real-world implementation
  
* Proven experience implementing **calibration algorithms** (factory and adaptive/in-field)
  
* Strong embedded firmware background for real-time control systems
  
* Proficiency in modeling and simulation (MATLAB/Python/Simulink or equivalent), with demonstrated correlation to hardware

jobs.title: GPU Kernel Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Relace**

Relace is building a globally distributed inference cloud. Customers send us requests, we run them on our own fleet of GPUs across the world, and we compete on price, speed and reliability against companies far larger than us. We have customers and revenue today, we’re venture backed, and the team is still small, so roles come with a lot of responsibility and room to grow.

We build our own stack, and the fleet runs on Kubernetes across multiple clouds. Performance here is the business: making the system ten percent faster makes the company roughly ten percent more money, and we can show you the number.

Some numbers: we process 800B+ tokens a day, we’ve grown 3x in the last three months, we are regularly one of the top providers by volume on OpenRouter, and we raised a $23M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with Matrix Partners and Y Combinator.

**The role**

You would work at the bottom of the stack, writing and tuning the code that runs directly on the GPU: making the hardware do more work per second and per dollar, shrinking models so they’re cheaper to run without making them worse, and hunting down the many boring reasons a GPU sits idle. We don’t require GPU or CUDA experience. We’d rather have an excellent low-level systems engineer with no GPU background than an average CUDA programmer; learning to program a GPU on top of that takes a few months.

**What we need to see**

* Around five or more years of low-level performance work where the speed of the system mattered: operating systems, drivers, databases, compilers, trading systems, inference engines.
* Strong C or C++ and genuine comfort at a low level: memory, concurrency, caches, hardware behaviour.
* A track record of making something significantly faster, where you can explain precisely why it was slow and what you changed. This matters more than anything else on this list.
* The habit of measuring. You profile before and after, and you’re suspicious of numbers that came from a sloppy test setup.

**Nice to have**

Operating system, hypervisor, driver, firmware or real-time systems work; performance tools you built for other engineers to use; compiler work; actual GPU experience, whether at NVIDIA or AMD or through open-source work on the common inference projects. We can teach you the GPU, but we can’t teach performance instincts.

**Working here**

San Francisco, in person, five days a week. This is a senior role, with competitive compensation plus equity.

jobs.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**

Candidates for this role could end up working with a number of our internal products and teams:

***Flow*** is Hadrian’s FactoryOS, our core platform comprised of a variety of applications that model, manage, and automate an extremely complex network of factories.

***Copilot***is our suite of manufacturing automation products which automates or accelerates key processes within the factory including quoting, CAM programming, and CMM programming.

***Factory Automation***develops robotic cells for use in our factories and the software that controls them.

We have a broad set of applications internally. Candidates interested in redefining manufacturing software will have ample opportunity to do so.

*Note: You do not need to have aerospace, defense, or manufacturing experience to excel in this role*

**What You'll Do**

* Scope, architect, implement, and deploy critical applications that will drive revenue and make a positive impact in the world
* Own a product vertical with the opportunity to build a team around yourself over time (if interested)
* Work directly with our internal and external customers to drive our roadmap
* Get to build alongside an incredible team of engineers, operators, and the best machinists/CAM programmers in the world
* Be given autonomy and virtually unlimited room to grow

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bias to action, take pride in your work, and care more about getting to the right solution than being right
* Have tech-lead critical projects or initiatives
* Have worked on large, complex codebases
* Have extensive experience shipping modern, full-stack applications (our front-ends are React/Next/Typescript and back-ends are Go and Python)
* Are product-minded and user-driven
* Are excited to work in a fast-paced environment with high-stakes and quick iteration cycles
* Are a previous or future founder — if you leave Hadrian to start a company we'll do everything to support you, including investing in you and introducing you to Hadrian's investors
* Can work from our Los Angeles Factory (Torrance)

**Logistics**

This role is based out of our Los Angeles (Torrance) or San Francisco Bay Area office.

**Compensation**

For this role, the target salary range is $220,000 - $320,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

**Benefits for Full-time Employees**
------------------------------------

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
    
  401k
* Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
* Flexible vacation policy
* Equity

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

**Use of AI in hiring**
-----------------------

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

**Consideration of Criminal History**
-------------------------------------

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

**Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**
--------------------------------------------

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability stat

**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are seeking a Simulation Engineer to develop simulation technology for physical AI and robotics applications. In this role, you will develop simulation algorithms spanning many-body dynamics and finite element analysis, with a particular emphasis on contact algorithms, and validate their performance on robotics hardware. Working at the intersection of simulation and real-world deployment, you will connect numerical methods with practical robotics applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop simulation algorithms for physical AI and robotics applications, including many-body dynamics and finite element analysis.
* Develop and refine contact algorithms to model physical interactions in robotics scenarios.
* Validate simulation algorithms on robotics hardware and use experimental results to guide improvements.
* Evaluate simulation behavior against real-world deployment scenarios to identify and address differences between simulated and hardware results.
* Apply control theory and controller optimization and tuning methods to support simulation and hardware validation, as applicable.

Required Qualifications

* Degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

* PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related discipline.
* Expertise spanning both numerical methods or simulation and practical robotics deployment scenarios.
* Experience with many-body dynamics, finite element analysis, and contact algorithms.
* Experience validating simulation algorithms on robotics hardware.
* Expertise in control theory and controller optimization and tuning.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is growing in maturity, so now is the time to join and drive game changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our designs will fundamentally change the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.  
  
AWS is seeking a Robotics Engineer to support building systems that operate in our data centers and collect rich sensor data at scale. We're seeking a Generalist Machine Learning Engineer to own the ML that turns robot-collected data — imagery, LiDAR, thermal streams, etc — into useful, reliable outputs. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of reliable performance in production across a broad range of problems — perception, model fine-tuning, evaluation, and the pipelines that feed and serve them. This role closely collaborates with robotics and software engineers so model outputs are usable downstream, and so field data feeds back into better training data and better models.  
  
As Amazon has a global presence, intermittent travel will be necessary and should be expected to be approximately 30% to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation tests. While most travel will be domestic, some international travel may be required.  
  
About the team  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping ML to production.
* Strong general software engineering and debugging skills, and fluency in Python.
* Hands-on experience owning problems across the full ML stack: data/feature pipelines, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
* Hands-on experience with the AWS ML stack (or equivalent) — Amazon SageMaker AI (training, tuning, endpoints), Amazon Bedrock, S3-based data/feature pipelines, and GPU training on EC2.
* Computer vision / perception experience (detection, segmentation, recognition) on real-world sensor data — RGB, PCD, etc.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience as the sole or lead ML engineer on a team of otherwise non-ML engineers.
* Familiarity with robotics data and tooling (ROS 2, MCAP, sensor fusion) and edge deployment.
* Experience fine-tuning and evaluating open models / LLMs, and building evaluation harnesses.
