jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - GNSS / INS
jobs.description:
Overview:

We are seeking a full-time **Senior Software Engineer** **(GNSS / INS)** at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area or at our location in Cochrane, Alberta, Canada. This role is on our Core Platform Technology team and will develop GNSS and INS based positioning solutions. This is an innovation and exploration role where you will work closely with all of Garmin's product segments to explore, align and advance positioning technology in all of Garmin's product categories.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Contribute to productization and algorithm development in positioning technologies
* Design, implement, test and document complex software applications using C/C++ for use in embedded systems
* Participate in peer reviews of software designs, algorithm designs and software implementation
* Collaborate with colleagues on software/algorithm design approaches and implementations
* Provide reliable solutions to a variety of positioning problems using sound problem solving techniques
* Participates in project leadership and/or program planning including providing technical input to product development plans and concept documents
* Makes substantial contributions toward determination of project goal/objective feasibility and applies good judgment in setting schedules/risk taking
* Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced Software Engineers (1 & 2)
* Contributes to advanced technical research on new technologies
* Offers process improvement suggestions and authors new procedures as appropriate
* Provides reliable solutions to a wide range of difficult problems using sound problem solving techniques
* Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced software engineers (Software Engineer 1 & 2 & Senior Software Engineers)

Qualifications:

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Math, Physics or related field **AND** a minimum of 5 years relevant experience **OR** an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience in positioning algorithms for consumer applications with a strong understanding of GNSS measurements and error sources, estimation techniques including least squares & Kalman filtering, blunder/fault detection, multi-constellation and multi-frequency, AGNSS, inertial navigation systems, inertial sensors, sensor fusion and other geomatic related topics.
* Proficient in software development and engineering with C/C++ for embedded, real-time environments
* Strong ability to use scripting languages (i.e. Python, Matlab etc.) or C++ to automate data analysis of large amounts of data to verify positioning algorithms
* Proven ability to explore and research technical algorithmic problems and implementing appropriate algorithmic solutions
* Demonstrate a successful track record in managing exceedingly complex problems and providing success solutions which are highly innovative and ingenious
* Experience with architecting solutions for multiple groups and/or disciplines
* Must be positive, detail oriented, organized, team oriented and a driven problem solver, multi-tasker, and self-starter with the ability to prioritize and lead in a fast paced, deadline-driven environment

**Desired Qualifications**

  

* Expertise in inertial navigation techniques (e.g. vehicle and pedestrian dead reckoning, GNSS aided INS)
* Experience in Java
* Knowledge of carrier phase measurement processing methods
* Knowledgeable in GNSS measurement generation, tracking loops and how measurements are impacted by environment.
* Experience in MEMS sensor technology, including error source modeling and quantification of accelerometers and gyroscopes
* Experience in detection of GNSS denial of service, jamming or spoofing events

*Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.*

*This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here:* *Garmin Benefits*

jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Aechelon Technology, a Shield AI company, is a leading producer of 3D simulator content, including Geospecific visual/sensor databases and realistic 3D models. We seek people who share our passion for real-time computer graphics and commitment to our mission of helping make our Nation's pilots safer. We will give you a chance to work with some of the most talented people in the graphics industry.**

The Senior AI Enablement Software Engineer will design tools and infrastructure that help teams use artificial intelligence effectively. This hands-on individual contributor will work with locally hosted models, build reusable AI skills and integrations, and introduce practical AI workflows.

The engineer will initially focus on enabling software development teams, with the opportunity to expand these capabilities across the organization. They will collaborate with infrastructure, security, and technical peers while mentoring others on the effective and responsible use of AI.

### **Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to the following:**

* Design and implement AI tools, services, reusable skills, agent tools, and developer infrastructure.
* Evaluate, deploy, and optimize locally hosted models on individual workstations and shared internal systems.
* Connect models with source repositories, documentation, build systems, issue trackers, and other internal tools.
* Build workflows and curate approved datasets for training and fine-tuning models using internal source code and technical documentation.
* Work with software teams to identify practical use cases and turn successful prototypes into supported capabilities.
* Develop and maintain practices for model configuration, skill development, prompt management, evaluation, and versioning.
* Assess model and workflow quality, performance, resource usage, reliability, and suitability for their intended purpose.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and security teams on deployment, data handling, access control, governance, and handoff for operational support.
* Diagnose issues involving model behavior, context management, tool integration, inference performance, and hardware utilization.
* Create documentation, examples, and training materials, and mentor users on appropriate AI practices, limitations, and review processes.
* Track developments in local models, agent systems, inference runtimes, and AI-assisted development tools.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a similar technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience developing production software, developer tools, libraries, services, APIs, or platform infrastructure for use by other teams.
* Experience working with or integrating into software codebases written in Python and C++.
* Experience integrating generative AI into applications and workflows, including model inference, training or fine-tuning, prompt design, tool calling, structured output, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience running or integrating models in local or privately hosted environments.
* Understanding of dataset preparation, model evaluation, context management, and the limitations of AI-generated output.
* Familiarity with Windows and Linux development environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to explain AI capabilities and limitations to audiences with different levels of technical experience.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience training or adapting Nemotron or comparable open-weight models using source code and technical documentation.
* Experience creating Codex-style skills, agent tools, plugins, or Model Context Protocol services.
* Experience with GPU computing, model quantization, or inference optimization.
* Experience scripting or developing tools in TypeScript.
* Familiarity with AI security, data governance, access control, and responsible-use practices.
* Familiarity with real-time graphics, geospatial visualization, content creation, or other technical domains supported by the organization.
* Experience with Git or Perforce and defect-tracking systems such as Jira or Bugzilla.

### **Compensation and Benefits**

**$128,000 - $192,000 per year**

Final compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

We offer a very attractive compensation package including competitive base salary, company performance-based profit sharing, 401k, 100% employer paid health benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, std, ltd, and life insurance plans).

No relocation reimbursement provided.

This position description is not intended to be a complete listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee holding this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may be changed or others may be assigned at any time by the Company with notice to the employee.

Shield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing access and opportunities to individuals with disabilities. If you are an applicant who is unable to fully utilize/access our application process because of a disability, Aechelon Technology will provide a reasonable accommodation. Please send an email to dl-aechelon\_hr-team@shield.ai to request that accommodation, and please be sure to include a detailed description of your requested accommodation, your name and preferred method of contact.

jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary:**
----------------------------

Are you passionate about technology and ready to make an impact? We’re looking for an Endpoint Systems Engineer to help us deliver exceptional support to our end users, ensuring their systems are always running smoothly. If you're someone who thrives on troubleshooting, solving problems, and keeping up with the latest in hardware and software technology, we want YOU to join our team!

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**What You'll Do:**

As an Endpoint Systems Engineer I, you will play a pivotal role in the day-to-day support and maintenance of our endpoint systems. You’ll work closely with end users to ensure they have the tools they need to succeed, including:

* **System Maintenance & Support**: Manage and maintain a fleet of endpoint computers, mobile devices, and software applications, ensuring everything is up-to-date and functioning flawlessly.
* **Problem Solving**: Troubleshoot hardware and software issues and provide timely, effective solutions that keep users productive.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer 3 - Annapolis Junction, MD
jobs.description:
Overview:

**About M.C. Dean**

M.C. Dean is Building Intelligence®. We design, build, operate, and maintain cyber-physical solutions for the nation’s most mission-critical facilities, secure environments, complex infrastructure, and global enterprises. With over 9,000 employees, our capabilities span electrical, electronic security, telecommunications, life safety, automation and controls, audiovisual, and IT systems. Headquarters in Tysons, Virginia, M.C. Dean delivers resilient, secure, and innovative power and technology solutions through engineering expertise and smart systems integration.

**Why Join Us?**

Our people are passionate about engineering innovation that improves lives and drives impactful change. Guided by our core values—agility, expertise, and trust—we foster a collaborative and forward-thinking work environment. At M.C. Dean, we are committed to building the next generation of technical leaders in electrical, engineering, and cybersecurity industries.

We are seeking a IT-oriented **System Engineer 3** to join our **Security and Electronic Systems (SES)** business Unit. As part of **(SES)** Strategic Business Unit you will be part of a dynamic team responsible for the design, implementation, operations & maintenance, and cybersecurity for large complex resilient hardware and virtualized infrastructure to ensure implemented solutions meet stakeholder needs, standards, and performance requirements.

Responsibilities:

**What you’ll do:**

The position drives the design of architectural frameworks for large complex resilient systems to ensure implemented solutions meet stakeholder needs, standards, and performance requirements. You will provide technical direction for the requirements development, design, engineering, configuration, integration, and testing of specific components of complex hardware/software systems.

Specific responsibilities include:

* Assist with the automation and optimization of engineering processes.
* Perform systems engineering assessments (upgrades, system improvements, lifecycle refreshes, migrations, new deployments), develop conceptual design solutions, and create implementation work breakdown structures to drive planning and estimating. Advise on alternative and innovative approaches and conduct feasibility studies.
* Support research, prototyping, and development of integrated system capability by working closely with industry partners and OEMs to implement the latest and best-in-bread capabilities to meet customer emerging needs.
* Support identification and documentation of operational, functional, and technical requirements.
* Develop technical documentation, such as system architecture and system design documentation, functional and performance verification test plans, and technical implementation plans.
* Incorporate new plans, designs and systems into ongoing operations.
* Interact with the Government regarding Systems Engineering technical considerations and for associated problems, issues or conflicts.
* Conduct configuration and development activities.
* Conduct testing against established test plans.
* Participate in interface definition, design, and changes to the configuration between affected groups and individuals throughout the life cycle.
* Review and provide input to program and contract work breakdown structure (WBS), work packages and the integrated master schedule (IMS).
* Support the review of system engineering documentation to ensure that processes and specifications meet system needs and are accurate, comprehensive, and complete.
* Support configuration management through the system development and sustainment lifecycle.

Qualifications:

**Clearance/Citizen Type:** Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements, including U.S. Citizenship, for access to classified information; **Active TS/SCI with Polygraph is required**

**Education/Experience:**

* Education: Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical, Computer Science, or a Related Engineering Discipline .
* Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ Years of progressive experience.
* Master’s Degree desirable.
* 2+ years of experience with the provision of system solutions for physical security systems and IT solutions.
* Experience eliciting requirements, conducting research, designing, testing, and implementing hardware and software solutions for data center and virtual infrastructure technologies.
* Engineering experience with some of the following core platforms and services:
  + VMware ESXi and vSphere.
  + Microsoft Windows Server Deployment and Administration.
  + Microsoft Windows Deployment and Administration.
  + DNS, DFS, and DHCP.
  + Windows Server Update Services (WSUS), Key Management Service (KMS)
  + Active Directory and defining, implementing, and maintaining Group Policy.
  + Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and Certificate Authorities
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining highly secure and reliable solutions that meet all organizational Cybersecurity and Information Assurance requirements.
* Experience with API management, scripting languages including PowerShell, Python, JSON, Bash, etc.
* Meet DoD 8570 IAT Level-II requirements.
* Strong Oral, Written and Presentation Skills with the ability and experience communicating directly with customer leadership and technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated background working with multidisciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated time management and organization skills to meet deadlines and quality objectives.
* Strong MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio Skills is a plus.

**Desired Experience:**

* Experience virtualizing enterprise applications (Active Directory, MS SQL, RHEL, MS SharePoint, etc.).

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
BAE Systems is seeking a full-time Systems Engineer (w/Mechanical focus) to be a part of our Interface Management team working on the US Sea-Launch-Cruise-Missile (SLCM-N) Weapons Program. The selected candidate will work closely with numerous engineering teams supporting the US Navy's Strategic Systems Programs command and its industry partners.
  
  
About SLCM-N
  
In response to global threats, SSP is continuing to defend our nation by adding a second nuclear defense system option to their mission responsibilities with the SLCM-N Program. SSP is building this modular, survivable cruise missile system that will be outfitted on some submarines and surface ships. SSP is responsible for designing, developing, building, and deploying the SLCM-N Weapons System and BAE Systems is supporting our customer in the pre-development activities for the program.
  
  
Our primary function is to ensure that all weapon system interface requirements are correctly defined and properly allocated to the cognizant organization. This is achieved by performing technical change evaluations and interfacing with government and contractor activities to define Weapon System Coordinated Interfaces. Accuracy, integrity, the ability to work independently, and a natural curiosity are important traits for a successful candidate to demonstrate.
  
  
About BAE Systems and the U.S. Navy’s Strategic Systems Programs (SSP)
  
Our organization has supported the U.S. Navy’s Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) continually since the program’s inception in the 1950s. SSP developed the first sea-based, underwater-launched Strategic Weapon System (SWS), a defense system that is truly critical to our national security. For more than six decades, SSP has maintained and upgraded this weapon system and we have been there every step of the way. The sea-based SWS is the ultimate stealthy weapon system and as the first leg of the U.S. nuclear triad. With over 70% of our nation’s nuclear arsenal its importance to maintaining world peace cannot be overstated. The development of Columbia, the most advanced nuclear-powered, nuclear-armed submarine ever designed, as well the next D5LE2 weapon system is under way and will begin to be rolled out over the next decade. The Navy projects this system to be operational through 2084, meaning the program will have a total life span of more than 120 years. This is a truly unique program and BAE Systems employees on this program understand they are part of an important legacy.
  
  
As a decades long sole source partner on multiple contracts on behalf of our customer, our program has remarkable stability and is concurrently experiencing significant growth. Combined, these factors provide ample opportunity for professional growth and development for capable and talented individuals on our team.
  
BAE Systems, Inc is the wholly owned U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems, PLC.
  
BAE Systems, PLC provides some of the world's most advanced, technology-led defense, aerospace, and security solutions. As one of the top ten defense contractors, we employ a skilled workforce of around 100,000 people in more than 40 countries. We develop, engineer, manufacture, and support products and systems to protect national security and keep people safe.  
  
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

Education and years of related/relevant work experience required: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Mechanical, Aerospace, or Systems Engineering preferred and at least four years of related/relevant work experience.

Additional skills/experience required:

* Understand Systems Engineering principles

jobs.description:
**Summary**

This role helps the scientists who build and operate QuEra's neutral-atom quantum computers program those machines effectively. You will maintain the domain-specific language and compiler stack, built on the open-source Kirin toolchain, that experimental physicists use every day to run their experiments.

You will work closely with physicists and control stack engineers. You'll help machine teams turn new experiments into working programs, keep the toolchain reliable as our hardware evolves, and drive its integration with our control system. The role suits an engineer who enjoys building tools and also helping others succeed with them.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the domain-specific language and its compilation stack: triage issues, fix bugs, review pull requests, manage releases and keep CI, tests and dependencies healthy.
* Act as the point of contact for machine and testbed teams programming their experiments. Help them build new experiments, port legacy programs and diagnose compilation or runtime problems.
* Work with control stack engineers on integrating compiled programs with our control system. This includes defining and evolving the program representation passed between the compiler and the control system, keeping the two in sync across releases, and debugging problems that span both.
* Turn user problems into minimal reproducible reports, regression tests and focused fixes, and work with the compiler team on larger language or IR changes.
* Find and fix performance problems in program compilation and execution, such as compile time, program size and timing correctness.
* Write and maintain user-facing documentation, tutorials, example programs and agent skills that make it easier for physicists to write correct programs.
* Work with the hardware control team to support new channel types, control hardware and machine configurations.
* Collect feedback from machine users and turn it into a prioritized roadmap for usability improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Python skills, including type hints, packaging and testing (pytest).
* Enjoys building tools for, and working closely with, scientists who are not professional software developers. Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience working across team boundaries: agreeing on interfaces, coordinating changes between components and debugging problems that span several systems.
* Experience debugging unfamiliar code and reducing complex failures to minimal reproductions.
* Familiarity with the full software lifecycle: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, logging, profiling, debugging and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with compilers, domain-specific languages or SSA-based intermediate representations (experience with Kirin, MLIR or LLVM is a plus).
* Background in experimental physics, especially AMO or atomic physics lab control (AWGs, AOMs/AODs, DDS, timing systems, cameras).
* Experience with real-time or embedded control systems, FPGAs, or experiment-control frameworks such as ARTIQ or Labscript.
* Experience with real-time scheduling or execution systems, such as runtime schedulers, streaming or instruction-dispatch systems.
* Experience with C++ or Rust.
* Contributions to open-source libraries.
* Experience using AI coding agents in a development workflow.

---------------

Amazon is seeking a talented, enthusiastic, and motivated Interdisciplinary Senior Systems Engineer to join a dynamic team that provides leadership for concept development, architecture, and design of robotics systems and industrial equipment. The Senior Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer will:
  

* Define, expand, and explore the design space for complex, multidisciplinary robotics and automation problems
* Identify and analyze the cross-functional tradeoffs between design alternatives, including impact on performance, schedule, cost, risk, complexity, and scale
* Break down and frame problems using con-ops, use cases, structural/functional decompositions, and other system representations to clarify needs and align technical teams
* Identify design choices to ensure our products are safe, reliable, and usable, and can be deployed and supported at Amazon scale
* Build quantitative models and analyses (Excel, MATLAB, Python, internal tools) to conduct trade studies, refine requirements, and understand key system drivers across the integrated systems of systems
* Perform technical risk assessments (such as TRL, Gap Analysis, FMEDA, HARA, etc.), devise mitigation plans, and create system test strategies

* Drive and prioritize execution of system test campaigns that span lab and field testing environments in collaboration with subsystem development and test teams (test readiness reviews, test execution, post-test analysis and reporting)
* Guide and inform, via analyses, cross-functional architecture definition
* Mentor junior engineers in engineering best practices, and participate in hiring of new team members

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
* 7+ years of professional experience
* Experience with eliciting and clarifying business and end user needs, and connecting those needs to system concepts, requirements, and designs
* Experience leading technical collaborations and creating alignment across diverse groups (e.g. hardware engineering, software engineering, controls, functional safety, program management)
* Experience identifying and analyzing dependencies, tradeoffs, and sensitivities across multi-disciplinary systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with industrial robotics and automated material handling solutions
* Experience with machine learning systems
* Experience developing and supporting hardware/software systems across the product life cycle
* Experience with scalable production systems

jobs.description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis are critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.

We believe in using the best tool for the job and are constantly evaluating our tech stack. Our current tools include:

* Python
* Vue.js
* Django + DRF
* Docker
* AWS: EKS, S3, RDS/PostgreSQL, SQS, MSK/Kafka

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical leader on the team building AISight, our digital pathology platform used by pathologists and labs worldwide. This is a fullstack role, but we don't expect equal depth everywhere. We want someone with deep expertise in either frontend or backend who works comfortably across the whole stack. You will set technical direction for the platform, take on our hardest cross-cutting problems, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.

* You will own the architecture of major areas of the platform and drive technical strategy in line with the product roadmap, balancing near-term delivery against long-term scalability and maintainability.
* You will lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through production. That means writing and reviewing technical designs, finding risks early, and making tradeoffs explicit.
* You will stay hands-on, writing production code on the most critical and technically demanding parts of the system.
* You will set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, security and performance across codebases, and drive improvements to our development practices and tooling.
* You will work with product, design, machine learning, infrastructure, QA and regulatory teams to make sure the software we ship is reliable, protects data integrity and patient data, and meets the requirements of a regulated medical device environment, including design controls and validation.
* You will mentor senior and mid-level engineers, grow technical leadership on the team, and help shape how we hire and onboard.
* You will represent engineering in conversations with customers, partners and stakeholders, explaining complex technical concepts to non-experts.

**Who You Are (Required)**
--------------------------

* You have a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* You have 8+ years of full lifecycle software development experience, including significant time in a senior or technical lead role.
* You have a track record of architecting and shipping large-scale production systems, and of leading technical initiatives across team boundaries.
* You have deep expertise in at least one of these areas, and working proficiency in the other:

* Backend: designing and building Python-based applications and APIs (Django or FastAPI), data modeling, relational databases (PostgreSQL) and distributed or event-driven systems.
* Frontend: building complex, performant web applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React or equivalent), including state management, frontend architecture and UX quality.

* You have a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* You have hands-on experience building and operating systems on a cloud platform (AWS preferred).
* You influence technical decisions through clear writing, sound judgment and collaboration, not authority.
* You have excellent communication skills and can work effectively with a distributed team and with non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience building software in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, HIPAA, CE-IVDR) or in healthtech.
* Experience with medical imaging, digital pathology, or large image and data visualization (e.g., whole-slide image viewers, WebGL or canvas rendering).
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitLab CI).
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with an infrastructure-as-code framework (e.g., Terraform, CDK).
* Experience integrating ML models or AI-powered features into production applications.

This is a hybrid position based in Boston, MA. Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $146,250 – $224,250. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. Summary
  
Research, design and develop the manufacturing and installation of electrical equipment, components and systems.

* Communication
* Critical Thinking
* Team Work

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Offboard Python Application
jobs.description:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford's autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you'll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – ***all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.***

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

**Meet the team:**

The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that's cloud-agnostic as well as capable of running on-prem. The results of these simulations is business-critical for us - they're used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end-to-end capabilities.

**What you'll do:**

* We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we're releasing a safe product. You'll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we're constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You'll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you'll implement solutions to increase efficiency.
* It's not enough to have a framework that is functional - it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction - both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical.
* We also can't build it all, so we want to make the framework well-documented and as self-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there's a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly.
* In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You'll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage.
* Once we've run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV's performance; these metrics could range from low-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high-level business objectives. You'll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise.

**What you'll need to succeed:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)
* Expertise in writing Python code that's efficient, well-documented, and well-tested
* 2+ years' experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment
* 2+ years' experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services
* Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming
* Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems

**Nice to have (optional):**

* C++ development experience
* Experience with Kubernetes

**What we offer you:**

* Competitive compensation packages
* High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Health savings account with available employer match
* Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting
* Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance
* Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program
* Paid medical leave
* Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays
* Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations
* Pre-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Monthly wellness stipend
* Backup child and elder care program
* Professional development reimbursement
* Employee assistance program
* Discounted programs that include legal services, identity theft protection, pet insurance, and more
* Company and team bonding outlets: employee resource groups, quarterly team activity stipend, and wellness initiatives

Learn more about Latitude's team, mission and career opportunities at lat.ai!

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

  

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

  

**Why work for us**

Our culture is focused on building inclusive teams, where differences and unique perspectives are embraced so you can contribute to your fullest potential as you pursue your career. Our locations feature a variety of work environments, including open workspaces and virtual connection platforms to inspire productivity and flexible collaboration. And we are proud to support employee volunteer interests and make it a priority to join together in efforts that give back to our communities.

  

**The Role:**

The Lab System Integration Engineering (LSIE) team is a part of a central engineering resource group that supports various battery, component, and propulsion test laboratories as well as vehicle garages in Pontiac, Warren, and Milford, Michigan. The Test Site Systems Engineer will directly support the Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL), the Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC), and the Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) at the Warren Technical Center campus with a focus on the software environments and automation platforms that enable safe, efficient testing.

  

The Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL-W) and Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC) utilize various automation software systems to operate 24/7. The Global Battery Systems Lab has testing capabilities that include traditional environmental testing, vibration, safety and abuse, exploratory development testing, and maintains commonality with GM’s battery lab located in Shanghai, China (GBSL-S). The Wallace Battery Innovation Center houses battery cell test chambers, cell formation chambers, a material synthesis lab, a slurry mixing and processing lab, a coating room, an electrolyte production lab, and a forensics lab with material analysis equipment and advanced software The Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) performs advanced diagnostic and failure analysis on returned components as well as full systems, using specialized test equipment, data analytics, plus forensic methods to resolve complex warranty issues. These labs and the results they produce are used by GM’s growing team of engineers working on advanced batteries and electrified vehicles, in support of the vision of a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions, and Zero Congestion.

  

This role manages the lab software ecosystem for GBSL, WBCIC, and the RWC. Scope includes TCWS (test cell workstation) builds and configurations, LSIE’s test automation toolchain, small operational applications, the Influx/Telegraf/Grafana metrics stack, Databricks interfaces for moving lab data into analytics pipelines, and Windows-based operating environments for critical test PCs. The engineer will use enterprise automation tooling (e.g. Ansible, Baramundi) to provision test systems, manage fleets, execute software deployments, coordinate environment changes, maintain configuration records plus change records, and standardize how test sites use enterprise toolchains. The focus is on solutions that meet operator and lab needs while staying aligned with enterprise direction.

  

An engineer seeking end-to-end ownership of the software backbone that keeps more than 100 battery test beds running across GBSL, WBCIC, and the RWC will be well-matched to this position. The engineer in this position will design and standardize back-end environments, deployment pipelines, Windows test-fleet automation, and metrics pipelines that connect enterprise platforms to day-to-day lab operations while building a broad skill set across DevOps, site systems, and large-scale test automation. **This is an onsite role at the Warren Technical Center to ensure direct engagement with lab operations, test systems, and partner teams.**

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities):**

* Support testing PC builds, related test software configuration, and deployments across GBSL/WBCIC/RWC in partnership with DevOps engineers.
* Maintain software environments on critical test PCs by coordinating OS and security updates with IT while managing LSIE-owned applications plus configurations.
* Own lifecycle management for key test systems, including version control, compatibility planning, environment upgrades, and major platform migrations.
* Own the metrics pipeline for lab test systems across Influx, Telegraf, Grafana, and test automation systems
* Support and maintain LSIE’s test automation toolchain that underpins daily lab operations at GBSL/WBCIC/RWC.
* Maintain software change logs, configuration records, runbooks, and standard test PC images to support traceability, audit readiness, and faster root-cause analysis.
* Act as the technical bridge between LSIE, Computer Aided Testing (CAT), and IT for infrastructure decisions that affect the test environment.
* Evaluate, pilot, and implement tools from pertinent teams so they fit site needs
* Standardize software support approaches, toolchains, and configurations across GBSL/WBCIC/RWC to reduce redundant local solutions
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for software issues that impact test execution, working with LSIE application engineers, lab operations, CAT, and IT.
* Plan and execute complex software and infrastructure changes that affect the labs including source control or license migrations, environment upgrades, and other enterprise-driven changes
Support weekend or off-shift needs for planned changes and high-priority software issue

**Staff Systems Engineer**

**Working at Abbott**  
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.

* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

**The Opportunity**  
This position works out of our St. Paul, MN location in the **Electrophysiology** division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the Staff Systems Engineer role, you will be a technical leader on our **Electrophysiology Systems Engineering** team focused on delivering the future in **Ablation technologies**. This role will involve a range of responsibilities including but not limited to definition of system behavior, system architecture, system performance, and system integration for our next generation products. This engineer will be a key member of Abbott’s product development team to bring systems from concept to launch.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Develop technical and business strategy at the core team level for major system-level programs
* Utilize multidisciplinary engineering knowledge and experience to design and develop new products specific for cardiac mapping and ablation.
* Provide system engineering leadership for new products from concept phase through launch.
* Lead cross-functional teams to solve technical challenges and drive research initiatives.
* Work with Product Marketing, Clinical Engineering, and Key Opinion Leaders to develop design input requirements from user and business needs.
* Communicate to Sr. Management including technical presentations, status updates, and program reviews.
* Lead system behavior definition activities utilizing use case modeling and other appropriate tools.
* Develop the system architecture while working collaboratively with the other engineering functions (hardware, software, catheter).
* Plan, manage, and report on overall systems integration activities.
* Provide input into the technology and product roadmaps
* Be a strong team player and lead cross-functional teams to resolve issues and meet budget and schedule requirements.
* Create a positive, collaborative culture amongst the technical teams while working to solve challenging engineering problems
* Mentor junior engineers
* Ensure compliance with procedural and documentation requirements of Abbott, FDA , ISO and other regulatory bodies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 11+ years of experience in developing highly complex electrical hardware, software, and signal-processing based systems.
* 5+ years of experience as a Systems Engineer
* Demonstrated ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish project goals
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex engineering problems and mentor other engineers
* Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization
* Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize and meet deadlines in timely manner.
* Strong organizational skills, as well as attention to detail

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Engineering and/or Science (could substitute for 2 years of engineering experience)
* Medical device experience, specifically supporting cardiac mapping and/or ablation systems
* Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross-division business units model

**Job Description**  
Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics – from detecting threats for F-35 pilots to illuminating the night for soldiers. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  
  
Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems.
  
  
In Countermeasure & Electromagnetic Attack Solutions (CEMA), we provide next-generation threat detection and countermeasure solutions to provide unparalleled electronic warfare capabilities to enhance mission survivability.
  
  
You will be a technical member of the Countermeasure & Electromagnetic Attack Solutions (CEMA) Systems Engineering Group that is responsible supporting design, development, integration, implementation, test and verification/validation of EW systems across multiple business areas. As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for and support technologies on next-generation military/commercial applications. You will also perform, delivering technical value, in the role of a Systems Engineer, for programs ranging from developing prototypes, full rate production, and sustainment of systems.
  
  
Because of the need for consistent, in-person collaboration and/or the requirement to perform all work onsite due to the nature of this particular role, it will be performed full-time on site. This means work will be conducted on location at a BAE Systems facility 100% of the time

* Ability to prioritize and adjust to dynamic project needs.
* Experience with systems engineering processes, methodologies and tools.

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

jobs.description:
**About Thea Energy:**

Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future.

**Position Overview:**

The Electrical Engineering Manager is accountable for the engineering execution and operating readiness of electrical and power supply systems used by Thea Energy's technology development programs. The work covers prototype equipment, experimental test stands, and facilities used to test superconducting magnets. The manager turns approved program requirements into systems that can be built, commissioned, operated, maintained, and modified safely.

The manager leads a multidisciplinary team of electrical engineers, power electronics engineers, electronics design engineers, technicians, and other specialists. This is a hands-on leadership role with responsibility for the team's daily priorities, technical coordination, field execution, and delivery evidence.

### **Key Responsibility Areas:**

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we're on a mission to drive innovation and uphold the highest standards of business ethics. * Support the Moorestown Manufacturing Operations Site through the design, development, and implementation of robotic automation solutions for manufacturing processes

EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran

* Provides support for training engineers and technicians.

MTSI is searching for a skilled Systems/Project Manager to support development of first-of-kind operational space or space related missions. This handpicked candidate must possess technical expertise and experience with developing, designing, building, and integrating advanced systems. In this position, you will provide System Engineering Technical Assistance (SETA) to the Space Rapid Capabilities Office (RCO).

﻿The Space RCO program office, located at Kirtland AFB, NM, is a small, streamlined organization with dedicated, organic acquisition support functions: contracting, financial management, human resources, security, program management and technical engineering support that are critical in enabling the rapid response required for classified space programs. The mission is to develop and deliver operationally dominant space capabilities at the speed of warfighting relevance in response to Commander, U.S. Space Command requirements. A successful candidate should be a leader and problem solver with a proven ability to deliver superior results as part of a high performing team in a high-profile, fast-paced environment.

**Systems Engineer/Project Manager Principal Duty**

You will work in a small, highly empowered team where every team member is directly responsible for the success of the program. Engineering responsibilities span ground and space system hardware and software technology domains and include technical project management for large-scale system assembly, integration, and test in a fast-paced, responsive development environment.

This SETA candidate oversees development and management of the government customer’s Integrated Master Schedule (IMS). This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing technical activities from requirements development through design, build, integration, verification, delivery, and sustainment. The candidate will have a Systems Engineering background and strong multidisciplinary technical leadership skills, with significant experience planning and executing system assembly, integration, and test efforts. This role includes close collaboration with Program Management, the Chief Engineer, IPT Leads, and the Integrated Master Scheduler. You must apply advanced principles, theories, and concepts for highly classified systems, while also effectively communicating complex results with management and executive leadership.

**SETA Role and Responsibilities:**

* Leads technical programs, projects, or tasks whose technical complexity requires engineering oversight

* Oversees development and management of the government customer’s Integrated Master Schedule
* Manages internal and external Integrated Master Schedule dependencies

* Experience executing Earned Value Management (EVM) on large, complex programs

* Must have ability and willingness to work in a highly collaborative team environment
* Communicate clearly, concisely, and with technical accuracy—oral and written
* Other duties as required

**Qualifications**

**Required skills:**

* Minimum ten (10) years DoD/IC, or relevant industry work experience
* Experience planning complex, full lifecycle engineering projects across a range of hardware and software development, assembly, integration, and test efforts
* Skilled in Integrated Master Schedule development and management oversight
* Experience with risk & opportunity management
* Experience with Statements of Work (SOW) and Performance Work Statements (PWS)

**Desired skills:**

* Five (5) years of relevant DoD and/or Industry work experience with SAP/RSV and/or SCI
* Experience as System Engineering Technical Assistance (SETA) to Government program office
* Experience with ACAT I/II level acquisition programs
* Experience in planning and executing test campaigns for ground or space systems

**Education**

At Intel, we create world-changing technology that improves the life of every person on the planet. By joining the Advanced Packaging Technology and Manufacturing (APTM) Yield Group, you will be part of a team tasked with the critical objective of driving yield and defect improvement across our entire advanced packaging portfolio. We solve highly complex physical and electrical problems to ensure our latest packaging technologies successfully transition from development into high-volume manufacturing.

We are seeking a APTM Yield Analysis/Device Engineer to drive technology development, transfers, and manufacturing ramps in Rio Rancho, New Mexico. In this role, you will analyze massive, multi-dimensional datasets to identify where manufacturing processes, test content, and inline metrologies must be optimized. Acting as a strategic technical advisor, you will set clear engineering priorities, lead cross-functional problem-solving initiatives, and directly influence our technology yield roadmap.

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Engineer** to help strengthen and reinforce our security processes, workflows, and posture as it relates to our applications, cloud infrastructure, and platform. In this role, you won't just be patching what's already broken; you will be defining how we find and close exposures before they're used against us. You will own and engineer the detection, investigation, and response capabilities that protect our global platforms while leading the charge into AI-augmented defense, using AI to compress the time between a vulnerability's disclosure and its exploitation in the wild.

You will act as the bridge between deep, code-level investigation and enterprise-wide risk reduction, ensuring our software supply chain, cloud infrastructure, and applications are not just compliant, but resilient by design.  

**\*\* Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office four days a week. \*\***

**What Makes This Job Awesome? You will...**

* **Security Architecture & Tooling:** Own our SAST/DAST program end-to-end, selecting, tuning, and integrating static and dynamic analysis tooling into the CI/CD pipeline so vulnerabilities are caught before merge, not after breach.
* **AI & Agentic Defense:** Proactively identify and build AI/LLM-driven agents that close the gap between exposure and detection. CVE feeds alone are a shrinking signal in an AI-accelerated threat landscape, so we need LLM inference layered at multiple points in the platform: dependency and supply-chain analysis, code-level review, and runtime behavior, catching what a CVE number never will.
* **Deep Investigation:** Own security incidents end-to-end, from the first anomalous signal, through root-cause analysis and remediation, to the post-mortem that prevents recurrence. You follow a problem to completion; you don't hand it off halfway through.

* **Incident Response:** Serve as a high-level escalation point for complex security incidents, conducting deep-dive post-mortems that drive structural improvements rather than quick fixes.

AI has rewritten the security landscape almost overnight, and some of the assumptions and playbooks that worked two years ago no longer hold. You know your way around Arxiv and ACM, and keep a genuine eye on the research as it's published, not just the vendor's take on it three months later. You track where the industry is headed, not just where it's been, and you're comfortable saying "that doesn't work anymore" and rebuilding the approach.
* **Secure by Design:** You have hands-on experience with secrets management (Vault, AWS KMS/Secrets Manager, or similar), secure API design (authN/authZ, input validation, rate limiting), and system hardening standards like CIS Benchmarks and SELinux/AppArmor.
* **The "AI Native" Defender Mindset:** You are passionate about the intersection of security and AI, and you think beyond CVE feeds, you want LLM inference embedded at multiple layers of the platform (supply chain, code, runtime) doing the correlation and triage a human can't keep pace with alone. To you, an LLM is nothing more than a non-deterministic program, and you can tell the difference between a genuine threat and hype.
* **Proven Track Record:** You have 8+ years of experience in Security Engineering, AppSec, Vulnerability Research, or Incident Response, with at least 2 years in a Senior-level capacity driving cross-team initiatives.
* **Foundational & Polyglot:** You can write in a systems-level language, such as C, C++, Rust, Go, or ASM, not because you'll ship production code daily, but because writing it is what makes reading it, and anything else in the stack (Ruby, Node.js, Java, Typescript, Python), critically possible. If the moment ever calls for it, you can pop open a shared object in a disassembler and figure out what is actually happening.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer 1 – Robotics & Automation
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Join our team at Siemens Healthineers as a Systems Engineer 1 – Robotics & Automation, where you will help design, integrate, and validate robotic systems that advance the next generation of laboratory diagnostics. Working alongside experienced systems, hardware, and software engineers, you will apply collaborative robotics, sensing, and automation to make complex laboratory workflows more precise, reliable, and efficient. This position is ideal for an early-career engineer with hands-on robotics experience who is excited to work at the intersection of mechanical, electrical, and software engineering to bring robotic systems from concept to reliable operation in a regulated medical-device environment.

**As a Systems Engineer 1 – Robotics & Automation, you will be responsible for:**

**Robotics & automation (core focus):**

* Program, configure, and tune robotic arms to execute precise, repeatable multi-step workflows in a laboratory setting.
* Characterize and improve robot accuracy and repeatability, and apply calibration and measurement techniques to achieve tight positioning tolerances.
* Develop and optimize motion paths and parameters to balance cycle time, reliability, and precision.
* Integrate vision-guided perception and robust grasping for manipulation of objects in real-world laboratory conditions.
* Use simulation and modeling tools to prototype and de-risk robotic behaviors before deployment on physical hardware.
* Design and iterate mechanical fixtures, adapters, and end-effectors to support robust robotic handling, including rapid prototyping.

**Systems engineering & integration:**

* Support system-level design, integration, and verification of robotic subsystems within larger diagnostic and lab-automation platforms.
* Translate product and process requirements into technical specifications, interface definitions, and structured test plans.
* Build data-collection and analysis tools to quantify robot and process performance, and communicate results to cross-functional stakeholders.
* Perform root-cause analysis and troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical, and software domains.
* Contribute to design reviews, risk assessments, and engineering documentation within a regulated (FDA / ISO 13485) environment.

**Required skills to have for the success of this role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in robotics, biomedical, mechanical, electrical, systems, or a related engineering discipline (May 2027 graduation).
* Hands-on experience programming and integrating robotic arms – including configuration, calibration, and motion planning.
* Practical experience with the Robot Operating System (ROS2) and integrating robots, sensors, actuators, and microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino) into working platforms.
* Strong programming skills in Python and MATLAB for control, data collection, and analysis.
* Working knowledge of systems and controls fundamentals and the ability to reason about how subsystems interact as a whole.
* Experience with CAD / design tools such as SOLIDWORKS, Siemens NX, or Autodesk Inventor and rapid prototyping (3D printing) for fixtures and end-effectors.
* Familiarity with computer vision / perception for robotics (e.g., depth sensing, object detection, OpenCV).
* Exposure to agentic / AI-assisted programming – using AI coding assistants and agent-based tools to accelerate development, prototyping, and automation of engineering tasks.
* Strong analytical rigor, curiosity, and structured problem-solving; comfort characterizing and improving system performance with data.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical results clearly.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and project-coordination experience (academic, research, or extracurricular).

**Preferred / nice to have:**

* Experience with robot simulation and modeling environments.
* Exposure to robot kinematics and control of multi-degree-of-freedom arms.
* Experience building or orchestrating AI agents / agentic workflows (e.g., LLM-based copilots or automation agents) to support engineering productivity.
* Research experience applying engineering or ML methods to biomedical, physiological, or sensor data.
* Wet-lab or clinical exposure (e.g., tissue culture, assays) that complements engineering skills.
* Interest in medical-device development, quality systems, and regulated design processes.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here.

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

In this position you’ll be a member of the Central Engineering business group. If you picture Marvell as a wheel, Central Engineering is the center hub providing IP to be used by all the other spokes on that wheel, including Storage, Security, and Networking. You’ll be part of the 3rd party IP management team.

**What You Can Expect**

In this role, you will work in parallel with a team of 3rd party IP engineers responsible for bringing in all subcontracted IP under the Marvell IP umbrella. This is a dynamic and challenging role, and, in this position, you will engage all parts of Marvell.

Looking for a talented 3rd party IP integration engineer to assist Marvell in offering DDR/LPDDR/GDDR/HBM/eMMC memory interface cores to our clients. Become part of a team creating leading-edge designs for the latest applications in artificial intelligence, hyper-scaler, communications, and storage.

  

As a 3rd party core integrator, you will be involved in all stages of SoC development including defining core requirements, validating IP developer competence, overseeing core development, technology compliance, core integration, test compliance and silicon validation.

in this role you will:

* Assist sales in winning bids by working with leading edge IP providers to meet customer requirements.
* Manage 3rd party developers in completing core designs and providing required design rules.
* Advise the Marvell design center on core integration into custom silicon designs and hold joint reviews with the design center and 3rd party IP provider. Responsibilities will also include developing statements of work, leading provider progress reviews, using 3rd party developer problem reporting tools to drive to problem resolution.
* Assist with 8D follow-through for significant supplier issues.

**What We're Looking For**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields and 10-15 years of related professional experience. OR Master’s degree and/or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields with 5-10 years of experience.
* Proficient in understanding of DDR type interfaces (DDR, LPDDR, GDDR, HBM, eMMC), including the challenges associated with SoC PHY integration, timing analysis, packaging, and multi-chip integrated packaging
* Proficient in project management tasks required to manage 3rd party developers
* Broad-based exposure to ASIC design flows required for releasing a chip to fabrication including logic synthesis, physical design, timing, DRC/LVS, Formal verification and electrical checking
* Good understanding of Design-For-Test concepts including DFT logic insertion, test generation, scan and embedded core testing
* Good communication and customer management skills
Post-silicon validation at customer sites will require a limited degree of travel.  

  

**Expected Base Pay Range (USD)**

0 - 0, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

**Interview Integrity**

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
