jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Overview Energy**

Overview Energy is a mission-driven team committed to building a new layer of energy infrastructure: satellites in geosynchronous orbit that redirect solar energy to terrestrial solar projects via passively safe near-infrared light. We’re in the earliest phase, where every circuit board and harness that leaves our facility is designed, built, and tested end-to-end by a small, dedicated team. Headquartered in the Northern Virginia / Washington, DC area and backed by world-class investors, we are advancing the next generation of clean energy technology.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the electronics behind our flight and ground hardware. You’ll report directly to our lead electrical engineer and work daily with our mechanical, embedded software, and systems engineers.

This is a generalist seat. One week you’re capturing a schematic and bringing up a new board on the bench. The next, you’re holding a supplier to its statement of work and checking that what ships matches what we specified.

This is built for someone a few years into their career who has already put real hardware on a bench and wants a far bigger slice of the system than a large prime can offer. The role is onsite daily at our Ashburn Virginia facility.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and capture schematics for analog, digital, and power boards: sensors, data acquisition, power delivery, and the interfaces between them.
* Select components, build BOMs, and see boards through fabrication and assembly.
* Bring up new PCBs with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench supplies, then debug and characterize them against requirements.
* Support systems engineering on requirements, architecture, and interfaces.
* Design and document wire harnesses and interconnects: wire gauge, connectors, pinouts, and interface control documents (ICDs).
* Manage electronics suppliers and contractors: review statements of work, track deliverables, and verify what arrives against spec.
* Run power budgets and first-pass thermal and EMI checks, applying derating and space-environment practices to every design.
* Write test procedures and scripts that automate measurements and data analysis.
* Drive hardware anomalies to root cause and close out corrective actions.
* Write complete design reports, ICDs, and test procedures, so the next engineer can pick up your work without a meeting.

**What We’re Looking For From You**

* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 2–5+ years of hands-on electrical hardware experience. Internships and co-ops count, as does a substantial hardware program such as CubeSat, Formula SAE, solar car, hybrid/EV, rocketry, or UAV teams.
* At least one piece of hardware you designed, built, or tested end-to-end and can walk us through on a whiteboard.
* Solid fundamentals in analog and digital circuits, plus enough embedded experience to work with microcontrollers and common communication buses.
* Schematic capture experience in Altium, KiCad (preferred), or a similar tool.
* Comfort on the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Some experience working with an external supplier or contractor, even a single one on a single program.
* Ability to work onsite at our Northern Virginia facility.

**We Have a Strong Preference For**

* Hardware that has flown, or a full program cycle in space, aerospace, UAV, or another high-reliability field.
* Exposure to environmental testing: vibration, shock, and thermal vacuum.
* Familiarity with circuit design in LTspice or related simulation platforms such as SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, PLECS, or Qspice
* Power electronics or battery system experience.
* Wire harness design and fabrication.
* Range across mechanical, electrical, and embedded work.

The salary band for this position is $110,000 - $150,000 commensurate with experience. Individuals with demonstrated exceptional ability may be considered beyond this band.

**Our Benefits**

We take care of our people. In addition to competitive salary and equity, Overview Energy offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, a health and wellness stipend, 4 weeks paid time off, 2 weeks sick leave, parental leave, and 401(k) matching. Benefits are subject to change at the Company's discretion.

**ITAR Requirements**

This position is subject to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Overview Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at talent@overviewenergy.com.

Research shows that women and individuals from underrepresented groups often only apply for roles where they meet every listed qualification. If you believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply - even if you don't check every box.

**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

Rocket Lab's Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER**

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Principal Software Engineer for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Chantilly, VA, you will design flight software in support of spacecraft for Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Play a key role supporting the development of payload flight software for our Space Systems programs.
* Focus on deployment of novel algorithms into austere environments on Size/Weight/Power constrained sensor systems.
* Lead cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and deliver integrated solutions.
* Provide technical leadership in all aspects of software design and development starting with requirements generation and following through implementation, testing, deployment.
* Define and influence software architecture, design patterns, interfaces, and technical standards to ensure scalable, maintainable, and extensible solutions.
* Drive core software fundamentals of performance-oriented programming leveraging a variety of accelerator technologies.
* Mentor engineers across experience levels, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support technical planning, effort estimation, risk identification, dependency management, and milestone delivery while communicating technical status and risks to stakeholders.
* Be part of a team of driven pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER****:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering.
* 12+ years of experience in embedded software engineering experience.
* Experience in designing complex multithreaded application.
* Experience designing flight software.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an U.S. Government security clearance.

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Familiarity with high-performance and parallel processing.
* Exposure to novel architectures including FPGA, CUDA, etc.
* Familiarity with flight software system management.
* Experience with algorithm implementation.
* Exposure to Python and MATLAB is highly desired.
* Familiarity with numerical computing principles.

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

**FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:**

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Expand your horizons, advance your career, and contribute to a secure future for generations. Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector invites you to bring your pioneering spirit to our collaborative teams. As an eCad Electrical Engineer – Level 3 or Level 4 located in Dulles, VA, you’ll be a linchpin in missions of paramount importance, defining the art of the possible from day one. This position is 100% onsite and cannot accommodate telecommute work.

We are seeking an engineer specializing in PCB layout design to join our growing team of qualified, diverse professionals. In this role, you will focus exclusively on board-level layout responsibilities—this is not a schematic design position. You will work closely with design engineers to implement high-reliability, multilayer circuit boards for spaceflight hardware, applying best practices and aerospace standards. If you’re passionate about layout precision, spaceflight reliability, and pushing design boundaries, this is your mission.

This position will work a 9/80 schedule, with every other Friday off.

Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Own the end-to-end PCB layout process using Cadence Allegro PCB Designer.
* Develop multilayer, high-density interconnect (HDI) and controlled impedance layouts optimized for space environments.
* Create and maintain PCB symbols, footprints, and padstacks in accordance with internal library standards.
* Work closely with electrical and mechanical engineer to ensure layout meets electrical, mechanical, and thermal constraints.
* Implement high-speed routing techniques including differential pairs, length tuning, and EMI/EMC compliance practices.
* Support RF and mixed-signal layout requirements, including:
* Controlled impedance and matched-length RF signal traces
* Proper isolation and grounding strategies for RF sections
* Minimization of parasitic effects, signal loss, and coupling across layers
* Placement and routing for connectors, antennas, or filters used in RF paths
* Incorporate blind/buried vias, microvias, and stackup design for rigid/flex and complex assemblies.
* Generate fabrication (Gerber, ODB++) and assembly files, release documentation, and participate in design reviews.
* Apply NASA-STD-8739 and IPC-2221/2222 layout standards for space-rated hardware.
* Participate in DFM/DFX reviews with manufacturing partners to ensure layout readiness for fabrication and assembly.
* Collaborate with engineers to define layout constraints, clearance rules, and placement strategies.
* Drive quality through internal peer reviews, ECAD checklist adherence, and continuous layout optimization.
* Other duties as assigned

If this job description reads like it was written specifically for you, consider joining our team!

**Basic Qualifications for Level 5:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12 years of professional PCB layout experience – OR – Master’s degree with 10 years of professional experience – OR – PhD with 8 years of professional experience.
* No clearance required to start
* Proven experience with Cadence Allegro PCB Designer in an aerospace, medical, or other high-reliability environment.
* Experience with creating and managing ECAD libraries (symbols/footprints).
* Demonstrated expertise in multilayer board layout with signal integrity and power integrity in mind.
* U.S. Citizenship.
* Demonstrated leadership in layout design for flight boards or mission-critical systems.
* Experience with IPC CID or CID+ certification or equivalent layout training.

**Preferred** **Qualifications:**

* IPC CID or CID+ Certification.
* Experience with NASA-STD-8739.x, IPC-6012, and ECSS standards.
* Experience with RF layout best practices (e.g., maintaining return path integrity, shielding, and connector placement).
* Familiarity with designing for radiation environments and space qualification processes.
* Proficiency with constraint-driven design, stackup development, and controlled impedance routing.
* Experience with thermal/mechanical analysis coordination for layout decisions.
* Prior experience designing layouts for space-rated programs including DoD, NASA, or commercial LEO/GEO missions.

**Description**
---------------

**About WSDOT**

The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation!

Washington State Ferries (WSF) is an essential part of Washington's transportation network. Every year, we carry nearly 20 million passengers across Puget Sound and the San Juan Islands on more than 400 sailings a day. Our dedicated teams with over 2,100 people work together to serve our communities and shape the future of ferry travel.

  
  

**The Opportunity**

WSF, a division of WSDOT, is currently seeking an engineering professional with maritime experience to support the electrical systems that keep Washington’s ferry fleet operating safely and reliably. Working under the direction of the Chief Naval Architect, this position contributes to vessel modifications, repairs, and new construction that sustain essential ferry service. Maritime experience is critical to developing designs that address vessel operating conditions and meet applicable marine regulatory and electrical standards. Join a team dedicated to strengthening fleet reliability and serving the communities that depend on Washington State Ferries.

As we navigate a once-in-a-generation transformation to decarbonize our system — guided by our core values Serve, Respect, Trust, Grow Navigate, and bold strategic priorities Service Excellence, Improved Communication and Empowered People — there’s never been a more meaningful time to come aboard at Washington State Ferries.

  

**What to Expect**

Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, you/the Electrical Engineer 4 will:

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS)
jobs.description:
Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS) Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. This covers the board support package (BSP), kernel, OS image, update system, real-time behavior, GPU platform, and fleet tooling across every robot program and compute platform (AGX Thor, IGX Thor, and future NVIDIA silicon)
* Architect the next-generation OS image, including the move to a Yocto / meta-tegra based build. Make it reproducible, hermetic and secure, and make it fast for many engineers to iterate on
* Define and drive the production update strategy: atomic A/B and over-the-air updates, rollback, secure and verified boot, fusing and signing, and factory provisioning, so we can ship to a growing fleet safely
* Shape the platform's real-time architecture. Help define how CPU cores, interrupts, memory and the GPU are divided between control loops at kilohertz rates and large AI models. Set the latency budgets and the measurement infrastructure that proves we meet them
* Collaborate with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams alongside other Meta engineers: share requirements, push fixes upstream, and help plan how we adopt new Jetson Linux / JetPack releases with minimal fork debt
* Partner with electrical, firmware, and mechanical engineers on new compute and carrier-board designs. Weigh in early on SoC configuration, interfaces, power and thermal so boards are easier to bring up and software stays simpler
* Drive bring-up of new boards and modules end to end: boot chain (MB1/MB2, UEFI), BPMP and device tree, pinmux, PCIe/USB/Ethernet, power profiles, and the drivers for robot hardware (EtherCAT, USB-C power delivery, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, sensors, cameras)
* Help set the quality bar for the RT kernel and out-of-tree drivers: kernel configuration, ABI compatibility, and a plan to upstream changes or align with Meta's kernel instead of carrying long-lived patches
* Build the reliability and observability foundation: crash and kernel-log capture, symbolization, boot-time tracing, health telemetry, and fleet triage tooling, so that any robot failure can be diagnosed remotely
* Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, mentorship, and technical hiring. Grow OS and embedded talent on the team, and help shape on-call and operational practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 10+ years of experience building and shipping system software for embedded Linux or Android-based products
* Experience architecting and owning an operating system, BSP or platform software stack on a shipped hardware product
* Deep experience with C and Linux kernel internals, including device drivers, device tree, scheduling, interrupts, and memory management
* Proficient in at least one of C++, Rust or Python
* Experience driving new-SoC or new-board bring-up on ARM64, from boot chain through kernel to a production OS
* Experience designing OS image build and release systems, such as Yocto/OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, Debian packaging or AOSP, including the strategy for updates and release management
* Experience debugging hard cross-layer problems spanning hardware, firmware, kernel and user space
* Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams or organizations, including external silicon or hardware vendors

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience growing a platform from prototype to production fleet scale
* A track record of upstream contributions to the Linux kernel, Yocto or related open-source projects
* Experience designing secure boot, verified boot and OTA / A/B update systems for a large device fleet
* Experience with EtherCAT, CAN-FD or other robotics fieldbuses, and with host-to-microcontroller architectures (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
* GPU platform experience: CUDA, NVML/MIG, TensorRT, or deploying ML inference on edge devices alongside real-time workloads
* Deep hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson (Orin / Thor) and Jetson Linux / JetPack, including custom carrier-board bring-up, BCT/BPMP configuration, nvidia-oot, and flashing and mass-production tooling
* Experience with real-time Linux in production (PREEMPT\\_RT, CPU and interrupt isolation, latency analysis) for robotics, automotive, industrial or other safety-critical systems
* Experience with Yocto / meta-tegra, and with hermetic build and CI systems
* Experience with AOSP or other mobile/XR OS platform work: vendor BSP integration, HALs, SELinux, init, OTA, or kernel and vendor upgrade programs

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco, San Jose, or Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own controls standards and reference architectures for mechanical systems supporting large-scale AI data centers.
* Develop control narratives, sequences of operation, points lists, alarm matrices, cause-and-effect diagrams, and controller requirements.
* Define automation for central cooling plants, heat-rejection systems, pumps, heat exchangers, CRAHs, CDUs, liquid-cooling loops, valves, and associated equipment.

Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. jobs.title: Principal GNSS Systems Engineer, Amazon LEO
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Senior GNSS Systems Engineer with a minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in GNSS engineering, satellite systems, and advanced positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) technologies. This is a senior-level technical leadership role requiring deep, first-principles expertise across the full GNSS signal chain — from satellite constellation physics and signal generation through receiver design, carrier phase tracking, and precision position and time solutions delivered to ground terminals.  
The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of a custom satellite-based wireless positioning and timing transfer service operating across S-Band and L-Band frequencies. This system will transmit simultaneous multi-source signals that ground terminals can receive, correlate, and process to extract carrier phase differentials, enabling high-accuracy ranging, time delta computation, and precise geolocation. The role demands mastery of both the theoretical underpinnings of GNSS — including relativistic time corrections, ionospheric and tropospheric propagation modeling, and CDMA spreading code correlation — and the practical engineering required to implement real-world satellite communication subsystems. This position sits at the intersection of satellite communications engineering, precision time and frequency, and advanced signal processing. The engineer will own the GNSS subsystem architecture end-to-end, contribute to the TT&C subsystem, and serve as the technical authority on all matters related to satellite-based PNT service design, clock disciplining, and time transfer over wireless and optical physical mediums.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Senior GNSS Systems Engineer will serve as the technical lead and subsystem owner for the spacecraft GNSS architecture, driving all aspects of design from initial requirements definition through hardware acceptance.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Master's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field. A Bachelor's degree may be considered with exceptional demonstrated experience.
* Minimum 10 years of professional engineering experience in GNSS systems engineering, RF systems engineering, satellite payloads, TT&C design, or precision PNT system development.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least two of the major GNSS constellations (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo) at the signal and systems engineering level — not limited to receiver integration.
* Proven experience designing or significantly contributing to precision time transfer systems, including two-way time transfer (satellite or optical medium), with documented accuracy results at the nanosecond level or better.
* Demonstrated experience implementing Kalman filter-based navigation or timing solutions in real-world systems, with measurable performance results.
* Experience with RF systems engineering across S-Band and/or L-Band frequencies, including link budget derivation, antenna specifications, and receiver performance analysis.
* Proven track record managing RF hardware development cycles with external suppliers and defining strict test and qualification parameters for flight hardware.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience designing a custom satellite-based PNT service from initial concept through operational deployment — including waveform design, ground terminal specification, and algorithm development.
* Practical experience with optical time transfer systems (White Rabbit, TWFTF) and integration of optical and RF time references in hybrid synchronization networks.
* Expertise in Alternative PNT (Alt-PNT) system design and evaluation, including non-GNSS positioning technologies and GNSS-independent timing sources.
* Experience with GNSS security: anti-spoofing detection, signal authentication (OSNMA, Chimera), and cryptographic protection of PNT services.
* Background in precise orbit determination (POD) and its integration into GNSS timing error budgets for high-accuracy applications.
* Familiarity with satellite communication standards (CCSDS) and their application to TT&C and custom PNT service link layer design.
* Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for signal simulation, filter design, and automated test data analysis.

In this role, you'll help manage and improve the platforms that support every employee device at LendingTree, including Microsoft Intune, Iru, and our patching and security tools. ------------------------

You'll join the Endpoint Engineering team within Digital Workplace, working alongside senior engineers who will help you develop your technical and software engineering skills. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**What Will Help You Thrive**
-----------------------------

* **Product mindset:** You think about the endpoint as a product and the employee as the customer, focusing on reliability, security, and user experience.
* **Automation mindset:** You look for opportunities to eliminate repetitive tasks, improve consistency, and make endpoint operations more efficient.

* **Collaboration:** You're open to feedback, comfortable asking questions, and willing to share knowledge and work through challenges with teammates.

====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future. Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Home Software Platform (HSP) is the shared cloud foundation behind Generac's connected home energy products - PWRcell, PWRmicro, HSB Generator, Load Management, and HEMS. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer focused on Infrastructure and Security, you will shape how that platform is architected and defended: designing the cloud infrastructure behind Generac's home energy software - the applications, services, data, and connected devices it spans - and embedding security into every layer of it. You will work closely with SRE and engineering teams to lead and influence technical direction across the platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with organization-wide technical influence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide architectural leadership and direct technical influence over HSP-wide infrastructure decisions on AWS, defining the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that engineering teams build on across the platform.
* Design scalable, resilient, cost-efficient infrastructure for a high-volume cloud platform - APIs and services, data and streaming pipelines, compute and storage, and device-to-cloud data flows.
* Help shape infrastructure-as-code standards (Terraform, AWS CDK, or equivalent) so that environments are reproducible, reviewable, and auditable end to end.
* Drive the platform's security posture as a first-class design concern: threat modeling, secrets management, network segmentation, and data protection for device and consumer data.
* Lead cloud security architecture across the AWS account structure: IAM boundaries, least-privilege access, encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
* Partner with SRE teams to strengthen the observability and reliability backbone - metrics, tracing, logging, alerting, and SLOs.
* Partner with product engineering teams to review designs, unblock hard infrastructure and security problems, and raise the bar on operational and secure-coding practices through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Contribute to multi-year platform architecture and technology strategy, translating platform capabilities into concrete, buildable infrastructure and security roadmaps.
* Lead build-vs-buy evaluations for infrastructure and security tooling, and guide the technical integration of selected third-party services.
* Partner with SRE teams to drive cost visibility and optimization across the cloud estate without compromising reliability or security.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a substantial focus on cloud infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting production systems on a major public cloud, preferably AWS.
* Several years of hands-on security engineering across secure architecture, identity and access management, and threat modeling, applied to large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency with infrastructure-as-code, containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and modern observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Deep familiarity with the AWS security and networking stack (IAM, KMS, VPC design, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config, WAF).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code at scale using Terraform and/or AWS CDK, including module design and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Track record of building high-volume distributed cloud platforms; experience with device-to-cloud patterns (OTA update, edge computing, telemetry pipelines) is a plus.
* Experience securing consumer data and connected-device fleets, including relevant privacy and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar).
* Proficiency with container orchestration (Kubernetes / EKS) and event-driven and streaming architectures.
* Practitioner-level experience building or deploying AI/LLM-powered applications and tooling, including hands-on use of Claude via Amazon Bedrock.
* Familiarity with the home energy domain - HEMS, demand response, utility APIs, and grid-services integrations.
* Strong technical-communication skills: able to translate complex infrastructure and security trade-offs into clear, actionable narratives for engineering teams and technical stakeholders.
* A track record of raising engineering standards through mentorship, design review, and pragmatic technical leadership.

new_jobs.title: Senior Battery Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**  
The Avionics team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Terran R's nervous system — designing, building, testing, installing, and operating the hardware that connects and controls every major electrical system on the vehicle and ground. Engineers are deeply embedded into other functions within Relativity, working closely with propulsion, GNC, fluids, and stage engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and operation. As a Staff Engineer, you'll help shape Terran R's fundamental avionics architecture, own critical flight hardware, and build and grow the team that delivers it.  
  
**About the Role:**  
You will join the team developing the vehicle's high-voltage battery system and grow into technical ownership of it as a complete product, covering cell, mechanical, thermal, electrical/BMS, and vehicle integration. Early on, you will work closely with experienced battery engineers to learn the current design, its history, and how it flies. Over time, you will take on more of the system's technical direction. You will be the link between the battery's mechanical and electrical disciplines and the rest of the vehicle. You'll help turn mission and vehicle needs into a clear, traceable battery specification, and help shape the architecture that meets it. This is a hands-on technical role with real cross-functional influence. As the battery team grows, it offers a clear path to technical leadership, including leading other engineers.  
  
Architecture & Requirements

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

### **Senior Electrical Engineer**

Parallel Systems is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to lead the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems for our production autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles. This role will own critical electrical architectures and subsystems, including power distribution, traction and braking interfaces, safety-critical control systems, wiring harnesses, and compute/sensor networks.

As a senior technical contributor, you will drive electrical engineering decisions from initial concept through production deployment, establish robust design and verification processes, and ensure reliable integration across mechanical, software, and autonomy systems. You will be responsible for developing high-reliability electrical systems that meet demanding performance, safety, and regulatory requirements while supporting the transition from prototype development to production.

The ideal candidate brings substantial experience designing and integrating complex electrical systems in automotive, rail, aerospace, or other vehicle-based applications. You are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, leading cross-functional engineering efforts, and balancing hands-on execution with system-level technical leadership.

#### **Responsibilities**

* **Own end-to-end electrical system development:** Lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems, including power distribution, wiring harnesses, commercial-off-the-shelf hardware, and electrical test infrastructure.
* **Drive technical design decisions:** Establish electrical design requirements, define system interfaces, evaluate design tradeoffs, and make recommendations that balance performance, reliability, safety, cost, and manufacturability.
* **Lead safety-critical engineering:** Develop and maintain system-level risk assessments, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (DFMEAs), hazard analyses, and verification and validation plans for critical electrical subsystems.
* **Lead system integration:** Coordinate electrical interfaces with mechanical, embedded software, controls, and autonomy teams to ensure reliable operation across vehicle subsystems and dependencies.
* **Drive hands-on testing and troubleshooting:** Lead hardware bring-up, bench testing, prototype vehicle integration, fault isolation, and root-cause analysis to resolve complex electrical and system-level issues.
* **Support production readiness:** Partner with manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to transition electrical designs from prototypes to production, addressing design-for-manufacturing, assembly, testability, and quality requirements.
* **Establish engineering standards:** Develop and maintain electrical design practices, interface specifications, test procedures, and validation methods that improve system reliability and repeatability.
* **Own engineering documentation and configuration:** Ensure accuracy and traceability of schematics, wiring diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), test reports, engineering changes, and release documentation.
* **Provide technical leadership:** Mentor engineers as needed, review electrical designs, identify technical risks, and drive resolution of complex engineering challenges across the product lifecycle.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **30 Days:** You've reviewed existing vehicle architectures and are contributing to the definition of system-level requirements for new or upgraded subsystems (e.g., braking control, high-voltage distribution). You're actively participating in safety reviews and design discussions.
* **60 Days:** You're leading the design and documentation of a new electrical subsystem. You've outlined validation and compliance testing plans and are driving system alignment across disciplines.
* **90 Days:** You've completed a first-pass system architecture for a new subsystem and led its integration into a prototype or test vehicle. You're actively shaping the roadmap for future electrical system upgrades and regulatory milestones.

### **Basic Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience designing, developing, integrating, or validating electrical systems for vehicles or other complex electromechanical products.
* Demonstrated ownership of electrical systems or subsystems through multiple stages of the product development lifecycle, from concept and design through testing and production.
* Strong understanding of vehicle power distribution, electrical architecture, control systems, and embedded communication protocols such as CAN and Ethernet.
* Experience defining system requirements, managing electrical interfaces, and developing verification and validation strategies.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex electrical systems using first-principles analysis, structured debugging, and root-cause investigation.
* Experience with electrical design and documentation tools such as SolidWorks Electrical, Altium, RapidHarness, or equivalent.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to engineering and manufacturing stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing and deploying electrical systems for automotive, rail, aerospace, commercial vehicles, or heavy industrial equipment.
* Experience with traction, braking, high-voltage power distribution, vehicle control systems, or other safety-critical vehicle subsystems.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Overlay & Networking
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------

The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.

**About the Job**
-----------------

Every Sentry Tower we ship, across Counter-Intrusion and Air Defense, boots from a common software platform: a NixOS-based overlay that defines the base images, the system services, the compute configuration for each hardware generation, and the network topology that ties the tower's payloads together. That platform is the foundation the entire product line stands on, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own it.

This is a systems and infrastructure role with unusually direct product consequences. The tower's network is not a datacenter network: it is a set of VLANs and bridges carrying camera, radar, GPS, and sensor-board traffic over a mix of mesh radio, cellular, and satellite backhaul, on hardware that sits at the far end of a very long support loop. When a business line adds a new payload with its own switch, or when a routing priority is wrong, the failure shows up in the field. You will own the topology as a contract: define it, document it, review changes against it, and make the correct integration the easy one.

You will also be a primary steward of our build and configuration system. Our images are fully declarative and reproducible, spanning several compute generations and a dozen product variants, and we are actively consolidating legacy per-product configurations into a common, composable base.

Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own the shared base of our NixOS overlay: system modules, compute platform definitions, common tower services, and the image definitions that every product variant composes from.
* Own the tower network topology end to end: VLAN and subnet allocation, bridging, link ranking and failover across heterogeneous backhaul, NAT and firewall policy, and the physical-port-to-payload mapping for each carrier board.
* Define and enforce the integration contract that business line teams use to add network-attached payloads, so their additions extend the platform instead of diverging from it.
* Drive the consolidation of legacy, per-product configurations into the common overlay, with build-time checks that keep them from drifting back apart.
* Support and extend our real-time messaging layer as services migrate from the legacy pub-sub bus to its next-generation replacement, including the topic and schema contracts that define who owns which data.
* Debug problems that cross every layer at once: kernel and device tree, systemd unit ordering, Nix evaluation, link-layer configuration, and the sensor daemons on top.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of professional software engineering with substantial time in Linux systems, embedded platforms, or infrastructure work.
* Deep, practical networking knowledge: VLANs, bridging, routing and policy routing, DHCP, multicast, NAT, and firewalling, plus fluency with ip, tcpdump, and Wireshark for diagnosing real traffic.
* Strong experience with declarative configuration management and reproducible builds. Nix or NixOS is what we use and what we most want to see; adjacent depth in Bazel, Buildroot, Yocto, or infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi) is a solid substitute.
* Proficiency in Rust or C++, enough to read and modify the services that sit on top of the platform, not just the configuration that deploys them.
* Comfort operating and troubleshooting real hardware: serial consoles, provisioning and reflashing, boot problems, and remote debugging of systems you cannot physically reach.
* Demonstrated ability to define a technical interface that other teams build against, and to hold that line through code review and documentation rather than authority.
* US person status required, with eligibility to obtain and maintain a US security clearance.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Hands-on NixOS experience, including writing modules and maintaining flakes.
* Python for tooling and automation.
* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Xavier, Orin, Thor) including BSP integration, device trees, and JetPack upgrades.
* Fleet-scale operational experience: over-the-air update systems, observability pipelines, or long-lived embedded deployments.
* Familiarity with CAN, SNMP, or managed-switch configuration in an embedded context.
* Experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for large build graphs and hardware-in-the-loop pipelines.

CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with omniscient systems purpose-built for today's realities. CHAOS is seeking a highly-skilled and motivated FPGA Engineer to join our team supporting our R&D and product engineering initially focusing on our next-generation radar products. This is a highly collaborative role which will allow you to work on multiple capabilities within our product offerings. As a member of our engineering team, you also have the opportunity to expand your skillset across our product families.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement complex FPGA designs targeting our next-generation sensor products
* Support system integration of FPGA designs with complex software systems
* Support deployed FPGA capabilities in the hands of our U.S. and international customers
* Work full-time on-site in our office in Hawthorne, California

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related degree
* 5+ years of experience in a professional setting performing detailed digital RTL design targeting FPGAs
* Extensive experience with the entire FPGA design life cycle: RTL design, behavioral simulation, place and route, timing analysis, hardware integration
* Extensive experience developing in Verilog and SystemVerilog
* Extensive experience with the ARM AMBA AXI Protocol (AXI4, AXI4-Lite, AXI4-Stream)
* Extensive experience with the AMD (Xilinx) Vivado Design Suite and SoC FPGAs (Zynq, Ultrascale/Ultrascale+, Versal)
* Experience with Network Protocols (TCP/UDP/IP)
* Experience with Serial Protocols (I2C, JTAG, UART, SPI, CAN)
* Experience using Bash and Python for scripting and testing
* Experience modifying software drivers and applications when needed to validate FPGA designs
* Experience with Agile lifecycle processes including Scrum, Continuous Integration, and Test-Driven Development Methodologies
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and collaborate on small teams
* U.S. Person status is required as this position will require the ability to access U.S.-only data systems

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience designing and implementing highly performant baseband signal processing in an FPGA
* Experience translating high level algorithms from Simulink/MATLAB or similar into RTL including FPGA Vendor IP implementations
* Experience developing and implementing software drivers (C/C++/Python) to interface with FPGA designs
* Experience with FPGA Ethernet IP blocks (1G/10G/40G/100G)
* Experience with Software-Defined Radios (SDRs) (e.g. Ettus, NI, HackRF)
* Experience with Analog Device Transceivers
* Experience in Ground or Airborne Sensors (Radars, EO/IR, EW, etc.)
* Experience with Time Synchronization technologies (NTP / PTP)
* Experience with HLS Synthesis and languages (C/C++/SystemC/Chisel)
* Experience with VHDL
* Experience with high-speed, multi-layer, digital printed circuit board (PCB) design
* Current or previous DoD security clearance
* Experience with GPUs and/or AI engines
* Experience with git
* Experience with Bitbucket CI, Jenkins or similar CI/CD flows
* Experience with DoD & related System/SW Architectures and messaging standards (e.g. OMS, SOSA, Link-16, etc)

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 500 employees and counting across 5 global offices

Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. ### **Role Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Laser Controls Engineer to define and drive the control architecture for advanced laser-based optical modules. This role demands deep expertise in laser physics, control systems, and embedded implementation. You will own the technical vision for laser control—spanning optical power regulation, current control, thermal stabilization, and wavelength calibration—ensuring robust, scalable, and production-ready solutions across the full product lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and own the **end-to-end laser module control architecture**, including:

  + **APC (Automatic Power Control)** loops for stable optical output
  + **ACC (Automatic Current Control)** strategies for laser drive optimization
  + **Automatic calibration frameworks** (power, current, aging compensation, temperature drift)
  + TEC (Thermoelectric Cooler) control for wavelength and thermal stability
  
* Lead the design, modeling, and optimization of laser control loops, accounting for:

  + Laser non-linearities (L-I curves, threshold behavior)
  + Aging, degradation, and environmental variations
  + Noise, stability margins, and transient performance
  
* Architect **closed-loop control strategies** that balance performance, reliability, and manufacturability across PVT and lifetime conditions
  
* Develop and own module embedded **laser control firmware**, including:

  + Real-time control loops
  + Calibration routines (factory + in-field)
  + Fault detection, protection, and recovery mechanisms
  
* Establish **modeling and correlation frameworks** linking simulation to silicon and optical performance

### **Qualifications**

  

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Controls, or related field
  
* ~12–15+ years of experience with deep focus on **laser systems and control**
  
* Strong expertise in:

  + APC/ACC loop design and optimization
  + Laser behavior (L-I-V characteristics, thermal effects, degradation mechanisms)
  + Feedback control theory and real-world implementation
  
* Proven experience implementing **calibration algorithms** (factory and adaptive/in-field)
  
* Strong embedded firmware background for real-time control systems
  
* Proficiency in modeling and simulation (MATLAB/Python/Simulink or equivalent), with demonstrated correlation to hardware
  
* Track record of driving **system-level architecture** and influencing cross-functional teams

### **Nice to Have**

  

* Experience with pluggable optical modules and CMIS
  
* Familiarity with high-speed optical links, SerDes
  
* Experience with reliability engineering (lifetime drift, burn-in, field performance)
  
* Exposure to high-volume manufacturing, yield optimization, and test infrastructure

### **Why Join Us**

  

* Define the control and calibration backbone of next-generation laser products
  
* High ownership across laser physics, control algorithms, and system integration
  
* Opportunity to shape product direction in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment

new_jobs.description:
**About Relace**

Relace is building a globally distributed inference cloud. Customers send us requests, we run them on our own fleet of GPUs across the world, and we compete on price, speed and reliability against companies far larger than us. We have customers and revenue today, we’re venture backed, and the team is still small, so roles come with a lot of responsibility and room to grow.

We build our own stack, and the fleet runs on Kubernetes across multiple clouds. Performance here is the business: making the system ten percent faster makes the company roughly ten percent more money, and we can show you the number.

Some numbers: we process 800B+ tokens a day, we’ve grown 3x in the last three months, we are regularly one of the top providers by volume on OpenRouter, and we raised a $23M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with Matrix Partners and Y Combinator.

**The role**

You would work at the bottom of the stack, writing and tuning the code that runs directly on the GPU: making the hardware do more work per second and per dollar, shrinking models so they’re cheaper to run without making them worse, and hunting down the many boring reasons a GPU sits idle. We don’t require GPU or CUDA experience. We’d rather have an excellent low-level systems engineer with no GPU background than an average CUDA programmer; learning to program a GPU on top of that takes a few months.

**What we need to see**

* Around five or more years of low-level performance work where the speed of the system mattered: operating systems, drivers, databases, compilers, trading systems, inference engines.
* Strong C or C++ and genuine comfort at a low level: memory, concurrency, caches, hardware behaviour.
* A track record of making something significantly faster, where you can explain precisely why it was slow and what you changed. This matters more than anything else on this list.
* The habit of measuring. You profile before and after, and you’re suspicious of numbers that came from a sloppy test setup.

**Nice to have**

Operating system, hypervisor, driver, firmware or real-time systems work; performance tools you built for other engineers to use; compiler work; actual GPU experience, whether at NVIDIA or AMD or through open-source work on the common inference projects. We can teach you the GPU, but we can’t teach performance instincts.

**Working here**

San Francisco, in person, five days a week. This is a senior role, with competitive compensation plus equity.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is growing in maturity, so now is the time to join and drive game changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our designs will fundamentally change the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.  
  
AWS is seeking a Robotics Engineer to support building systems that operate in our data centers and collect rich sensor data at scale. We're seeking a Generalist Machine Learning Engineer to own the ML that turns robot-collected data — imagery, LiDAR, thermal streams, etc — into useful, reliable outputs. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of reliable performance in production across a broad range of problems — perception, model fine-tuning, evaluation, and the pipelines that feed and serve them. This role closely collaborates with robotics and software engineers so model outputs are usable downstream, and so field data feeds back into better training data and better models.  
  
As Amazon has a global presence, intermittent travel will be necessary and should be expected to be approximately 30% to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation tests. While most travel will be domestic, some international travel may be required.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping ML to production.

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Hardware Platform, 8+ years of experience
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for Senior Electrical Engineers to join our rapidly growing Hardware Platform organization, supporting defense hardware development across propulsion and weapons systems programs  
  
**Propulsion:** Develop and test cutting edge electronics for propulsion system. We are looking for a self-starter with deep technical experience in defense or aerospace hardware development to apply these skills in propulsion flight controllers, power electronics, high-efficiency motor controllers, and electromagnetic actuators.  
  
**ESAD**: Develop fuzing circuitry for missile systems, closely collaborate with vehicle development teams to design, document, and produce tailored fuzing systems and effectors. Develop system interconnect diagrams and define wire harnesses that connect electronic equipment within the vehicle.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own full-cycle PCB design for high-reliability defense hardware — from requirements capture and schematic design through component selection, layout (Altium preferred), bring-up, test, debug, and system integration — while setting the technical standard for execution across the team
* Architect and optimize circuit solutions for safety-critical aerospace and defense applications, including power electronics, motor/actuator drivers, digital control systems, fuzing circuitry, or vehicle interconnect — depending on program focus
* Drive rigorous design analysis across programs: worst-case analysis (WCA), thermal analysis, DFMEA, component derating, and signal/power integrity analysis to ensure reliability across extreme vibration and temperature environments

new_jobs.title: LLM Inference Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

We’re seeking an inference systems engineer to build the distributed serving and high-performance networking layer behind our large language models. You will own the path from model server to GPU fabric: prefill/decode disaggregation, KV-cache transfer, multi-node execution, and the observability and benchmarks needed to make those systems reliable in production. This role sits in the Inference team within the company’s Model team and partners closely with Model, Infrastructure, and Application engineering.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
------------------

* Design, implement, and operate disaggregated LLM serving architectures, including independent prefill and decode pools, KV-cache transfer, routing, batching, and failure recovery.
* Optimize multi-node inference across modern GPU systems using NVLink, NVSwitch, NVLS, InfiniBand, RoCEv2, GPUDirect RDMA, NCCL, UCX, and related communication paths.
* Build and tune serving systems using SGLang, vLLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, or comparable frameworks.
* Profile end-to-end performance across compute, memory, network, and storage; improve time to first token, inter-token latency, throughput, tail latency, and cost per token.
* Develop repeatable benchmark and capacity-planning workflows across model architectures, GPU types, parallelism strategies, and concurrency levels.
* Productionize serving on Kubernetes with health checks, autoscaling, safe rollouts, metrics, tracing, and actionable diagnostics.
* Diagnose complex distributed failures such as collective timeouts, topology mismatches, packet loss, congestion, KV-transfer stalls, GPU OOMs, and uneven load.
* Partner with model researchers and platform engineers to launch new models, serving features, and hardware generations safely.

**LOCATION REQUIREMENT**
------------------------

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

### **Must-Have:**

* Production experience building or operating distributed systems, high-performance computing systems, or large-scale ML inference platforms.
* Strong understanding of LLM inference, including tensor/pipeline/data parallelism, continuous batching, KV-cache management, and prefill/decode behavior.
* Hands-on experience with GPU communication and networking technologies such as NCCL, NVLink/NVSwitch, InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, UCX, or equivalent systems.
* Strong Python skills and working proficiency in C++ or another systems language.
* Ability to profile and debug performance across application, runtime, kernel, network, and infrastructure layers.
* Experience deploying production workloads on Kubernetes and operating them with clear reliability and observability standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication across research, infrastructure, and product-facing teams.
* Master's or PhD Required

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* Direct experience with disaggregated serving, KV-cache transfer, NVIDIA Dynamo/NIXL, SGLang, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM.
* Experience with NVLS, SHARP, GPUDirect RDMA, UCX, RDMA congestion control, or GPU-cluster topology optimization.
* CUDA, Triton, custom kernel, or low-level GPU performance experience.
* Experience with speculative decoding, multi-LoRA serving, quantization, or cache-aware routing.
* Contributions to open-source inference, networking, or distributed-systems projects.
* Experience benchmarking new GPU platforms and turning results into production architecture decisions.

**REFERENCES**
--------------

* Polaris: A Safety-focused LLM Constellation Architecture for Healthcare — https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13313
* Polaris 2 — https://www.hippocraticai.com/polaris2
* Personalized Interactions — https://www.hippocraticai.com/personalized-interactions
* Human Touch in AI — https://www.hippocraticai.com/the-human-touch-in-ai
* Empathetic Intelligence — https://www.hippocraticai.com/empathetic-intelligence

**Why Join Hippocratic AI**
---------------------------

**Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

**Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

**Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

**Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

We take frontier models, including large language, multimodal and diffusion models, and make them run efficiently on MTIA. The Home Software Platform (HSP) is the shared cloud foundation behind Generac's connected home energy products - PWRcell, PWRmicro, HSB Generator, Load Management, and HEMS. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer focused on Infrastructure and Security, you will shape how that platform is architected and defended: designing the cloud infrastructure behind Generac's home energy software - the applications, services, data, and connected devices it spans - and embedding security into every layer of it. You will work closely with SRE and engineering teams to lead and influence technical direction across the platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with organization-wide technical influence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide architectural leadership and direct technical influence over HSP-wide infrastructure decisions on AWS, defining the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that engineering teams build on across the platform.
* Design scalable, resilient, cost-efficient infrastructure for a high-volume cloud platform - APIs and services, data and streaming pipelines, compute and storage, and device-to-cloud data flows.
* Help shape infrastructure-as-code standards (Terraform, AWS CDK, or equivalent) so that environments are reproducible, reviewable, and auditable end to end.
* Drive the platform's security posture as a first-class design concern: threat modeling, secrets management, network segmentation, and data protection for device and consumer data.
* Lead cloud security architecture across the AWS account structure: IAM boundaries, least-privilege access, encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
* Partner with SRE teams to strengthen the observability and reliability backbone - metrics, tracing, logging, alerting, and SLOs.
* Partner with product engineering teams to review designs, unblock hard infrastructure and security problems, and raise the bar on operational and secure-coding practices through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Contribute to multi-year platform architecture and technology strategy, translating platform capabilities into concrete, buildable infrastructure and security roadmaps.
* Lead build-vs-buy evaluations for infrastructure and security tooling, and guide the technical integration of selected third-party services.
* Partner with SRE teams to drive cost visibility and optimization across the cloud estate without compromising reliability or security.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a substantial focus on cloud infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting production systems on a major public cloud, preferably AWS.
* Several years of hands-on security engineering across secure architecture, identity and access management, and threat modeling, applied to large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency with infrastructure-as-code, containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and modern observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Deep familiarity with the AWS security and networking stack (IAM, KMS, VPC design, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config, WAF).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code at scale using Terraform and/or AWS CDK, including module design and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Track record of building high-volume distributed cloud platforms; experience with device-to-cloud patterns (OTA update, edge computing, telemetry pipelines) is a plus.
* Experience securing consumer data and connected-device fleets, including relevant privacy and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar).
* Proficiency with container orchestration (Kubernetes / EKS) and event-driven and streaming architectures.
* Practitioner-level experience building or deploying AI/LLM-powered applications and tooling, including hands-on use of Claude via Amazon Bedrock.

Controls Engineer

We’re looking for a Senior Controls Engineer who knows industrial automation and can own projects from programming through startup.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll be working on custom automation equipment, Fanuc Robotics, programming PLCs and HMIs, troubleshooting systems, supporting installations, and working directly with customers and the rest of the engineering team.

The biggest thing we’re looking for is someone who is genuinely strong with Allen-Bradley / Rockwell controls and is comfortable walking into a machine or automation system, figuring out what’s going on, and getting it running.

Robotics and vision experience are a plus, but strong controls experience is much more important.
