* Supporting projects from design through installation and startup
* Working directly with customers during commissioning and startup
* Helping guide less experienced engineers when needed
* Traveling to customer sites for installations, startups, and service work

Travel is typically around 25% and comes with the territory in custom automation. It won’t be every week, but you should be comfortable getting on-site when a project needs you.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for someone with solid real-world controls experience, not someone who has only made minor PLC changes or supported existing equipment.

Ideally, you have:

* Strong Allen-Bradley / Rockwell PLC programming experience
* Strong Studio 5000 experience
* HMI programming experience
* Experience with industrial automation or custom machinery
* Experience commissioning and starting up equipment
* Strong electrical troubleshooting ability
* Experience with VFDs, servos, safety systems, sensors, and industrial networks
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Good communication skills with both customers and other engineers

Experience with Fanuc robots, Keyence vision systems, or robotic automation is a plus, but it is not required.

Why this role is worth looking at:

This isn’t a plant maintenance controls job where you’ll spend your day keeping the same equipment alive.

You’ll work on different automation projects, solve different problems, and be involved in projects from the engineering stage all the way through startup.

If you like building things, troubleshooting equipment, programming controls, and seeing a project actually come to life, this is the kind of role you’ll probably enjoy.

new_jobs.description:
Description:

You will develop the guidance and control software that carries a flight vehicle from ascent through atmospheric entry and an autonomous runway landing. Your algorithms and C++ code will be exercised in high-fidelity simulation, hardware-in-the-loop environments, and ultimately in flight. You will help maintain the six-degree-of-freedom simulation that the broader program depends on for design decisions and mission confidence. If you value simple, testable software and want your work connected directly to vehicle performance, this role offers meaningful end-to-end ownership.

**WORKSITE**: Onsite in Titusville, Florida

**WORK SCHEDULE:** Full-time; schedule based on program needs

**PAY RATE:** Salary determined based upon experience

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

Paid sick leave based on state regulations after 90 days of employment

Medical, dental, and vision coverage after a waiting period (60% paid by Fortuna)

Free TeleMedicine and Mental Health support for all employees and their families.

Additional voluntary benefits: Group Life Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Critical Care, Short-Term Disability

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

Develop, integrate, test, and maintain flight GNC algorithms in C++ for ascent, entry, terminal-area energy management, approach, and autonomous landing.

Build and maintain a high-fidelity six-degree-of-freedom vehicle simulation used for algorithm development, verification, and program decision-making.

Model vehicle dynamics, sensors, actuators, atmosphere, navigation inputs, and failure cases with appropriate fidelity for each phase of flight.

Design and execute software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop tests, analyze results, and resolve discrepancies between models, hardware, and expected performance.

Collaborate with flight software, avionics, aerodynamics, propulsion, systems, test, and operations teams to define interfaces and verify integrated behavior.

Support mission rehearsals, flight-readiness activities, console operations, and post-flight data review for test and flight events.

Requirements:

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

At least five years of experience in guidance, navigation and control, flight controls, vehicle dynamics, robotics controls, or flight-critical embedded software.

Strong C++ development skills and a solid foundation in control theory, numerical methods, rigid-body dynamics, and state-space modeling.

Experience developing or maintaining six-degree-of-freedom simulations and validating algorithms through software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Experience with flight-critical software, autonomous vehicles, launch vehicles, reentry vehicles, missiles, aircraft, or spacecraft is strongly preferred.

Bachelor's degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, computer engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.

Ability to work onsite in Titusville, Florida, communicate technical results clearly, and develop straightforward, testable, maintainable code.

new_jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled, adaptable, and customer-focused Sr. Network/Systems Engineer to join our Managed Service Provider (MSP) team based in Jacksonville, FL. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting complex networks, systems, and security infrastructures for a diverse portfolio of clients.

Unlike a traditional in-house IT role, an MSP Network Engineer must balance multiple client environments simultaneously, shifting smoothly from proactive solution architecture to diagnosing and resolving intricate, multi-layered computer problems. This position requires mostly work from our main office and traveling to local customer sites across the greater Jacksonville area. We place a premium on candidates who possess elite customer service skills, are highly responsive to client needs, have a passionate willingness to learn new technologies on the fly, and are eager to mentor and train junior IT staff.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Complex Troubleshooting:** Act as a high-level technical investigator to diagnose, isolate, and resolve complex IT and network infrastructure issues, identifying root causes across hardware, operating systems, and cloud dependencies.
* **Customer-Centric Support:** Serve as a highly responsive, consultative technical resource for clients, ensuring all communication is prompt, clear, and reassuring during disruptions.
* **Infrastructure Management:** Deploy, configure, and maintain multi-vendor network hardware including managed PCs, servers, switches, firewalls, VOIP phones and wireless access points (WAPs).
* **Security Infrastructure Management:** Oversee, configure, and actively manage clients' advanced endpoint and network security solutions, including **EDR, MDR, and XDR** platforms.
* **Systems & Cloud Engineering:** Support and manage client Microsoft Azure instances, **Microsoft 365 / Office 365 (M365/O365)** ecosystems, **Windows Server** environments, and **Windows desktop** operating systems.
* **Team Mentorship:** Actively share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and **help train junior IT staff and help desk technicians** to elevate the team's overall capabilities.
* **Continuous Learning:** Rapidly adapt to and adopt new vendor tools, software suites, and emerging technologies on the fly as clients update their tech stacks.
* **Documentation:** Maintain meticulous, up-to-date documentation of client network topologies, configuration backups, credentials, and security profiles.

**Travel & Schedule Requirements**

* **In-Office & Local Travel:** This is an in-office position requiring regular travel to customer locations throughout the Jacksonville area.
* **Travel Flexibility:** Must be flexible and ready to travel out-of-town to client sites within day of notice to address urgent client requests.
* **Out-of-Town Travel:** Occasional overnight or out-of-town travel may be required based on project needs.
* **Reimbursement:** All business-related travel and mileage will be reimbursed per company policy.
* **Off-Hours Support:** Candidates must be flexible to provide support and handle network deployments during off-hours or weekends when required to minimize client downtime.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Advanced Problem-Solving:** A proven track record of solving complex IT problems under pressure, demonstrating structured troubleshooting methodologies.
* **Adaptability & Growth Mindset:** A strong desire and demonstrated ability to research, learn, and implement unfamiliar technologies independently and quickly.
* **Customer Service Excellence:** Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of being highly responsive, empathetic, and attentive to customer needs.
* **Core Technical Experience:** **3–5+ years** of dedicated network, systems, and security engineering experience.
* **Cybersecurity Tools Proficiency:** Practical experience administering enterprise security suites, specifically endpoint detection and response (EDR), managed detection and response (MDR), or extended detection and response (XDR) architectures (e.g., SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Huntress).
* **Microsoft Ecosystem Proficiency:** Proven hands-on experience managing and supporting Microsoft Azure, M365/O365, Windows Server (AD, Group Policy), and Windows Desktop (10/11).
* **Vendor Familiarity:** Hands-on experience managing enterprise networking platforms such as Cisco, Fortinet (FortiGate), SonicWall, Ubiquiti (UniFi), Palo Alto, or Cisco Meraki.
* **Mobility & Screening:** Clean driving record and reliable transportation for frequent local client visits. Successful candidates must pass a background check and drug test prior to employment.

**Preferred Certifications & Tools (MSP Tech Stack)**

* Prior MSP experience is highly preferred.
* MSP Tech Stack Experience: Familiarity with professional services automation (PSA) and remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools (e.g., ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, NinjaOne, Auvik, Domotz).
* Microsoft Certifications or any industry certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CySA+).

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive base salary based on experience.
* Discretionary performance-based bonus structure linked to technical execution, team leadership/mentorship, and client satisfaction metrics.

new_jobs.title: Offshore Recovery Electrical Engineer I
new_jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Offshore Recovery team is responsible for designing, building and operating the maritime vessels used to land and recover the Terran R launch vehicle. This isn't your standard desk job. We are a lean, fast-moving team who cover the full project lifecycle – beginning with system requirements definition and design, hands-on with build and activation in the shipyard, all the way through supporting critical offshore recovery missions at sea. We collaborate with teams across the company, including Terran R designers, launch pad builders and rocket engine testers!

**About the Role:**

* Support the design, integration, testing, and operation of electrical systems aboard the recovery barge throughout the engineering lifecycle, including development, construction, sea trials, certification, and offshore mission support.
* Provide engineering support for electrical systems, including low-voltage control systems, rocket ground systems, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), networking, high-power distribution, and RF telemetry.
* Support offshore recovery operations by verifying electrical system functionality and assisting with troubleshooting to enable safe and reliable landing and recovery of Terran R.
* Collaborate with engineering, marine, and operations teams to resolve technical issues, improve system performance, and support mission readiness.
* Incorporate lessons learned from initial recovery operations into the design and integration of future landing platforms and recovery systems.

**About You:**

* You have a bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, with academic projects, internships, or other hands-on experience applying engineering principles to physical hardware or electrical systems.
* You have a foundational understanding of electrical engineering principles and can apply technical knowledge to unfamiliar systems and engineering challenges.
* You can communicate technical information clearly and coordinate effectively with engineering, construction, and operations teams.
* You can work collaboratively across disciplines, contribute to shared technical objectives, and support activities outside your primary area of responsibility as project needs evolve.
* You are willing to travel an average of at least 25% of the time, with potential for weekend work and schedule variations to support shipyard activities, construction, sea trials, certification, and offshore mission operations.
* You can work in marine and offshore environments as required by the role, including supporting field activities and collaborating with teams during system integration, testing, and operational readiness.

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* Familiarity with low-voltage control systems, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), networking, or RF systems.
* Familiarity with high-power electrical distribution systems.
* Experience supporting engineering, testing, or operations in a marine environment.

**Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.**

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.***

***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Core Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

At Anduril's Tactical Recon and Strike (TRS) team, we're pushing the boundaries of aerial drone technology. We're the driving force behind groundbreaking products like Ghost, Anvil, Bolt, and Altius, taking them from concept to fully operational systems that are reshaping the landscape of defense and security. Our team tackles the entire spectrum of small drone development (Group 1-3), from the drones themselves to the critical equipment needed for testing, deployment, and operation. We thrive on solving complex challenges, collaborating with specialist teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions for our customers. In TRS, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working with state-of-the-art technology and pushing the limits of what autonomous systems can achieve. If you're passionate about creating transformative technology and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of defense capabilities, we want to hear from you. Join us in our quest to develop game-changing aerial systems that are redefining what's possible in tactical reconnaissance and strike operations.

#### **THE ROLE**

This position is on the TRS Core Infrastructure team and will be focused on building the infrastructure to field TRS Products such as Altius, Ghost, Bolt and Anvil. Our charter is to provide the foundation for teams across Anduril to deploy cutting edge TRS autonomy and to tie it all together into an easy-to-use product. The solutions that you will create address the current needs of our customers and will have immediate impact towards the success of our products.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, test, and release the backend services used during manufacturing and deployment of Anduril Products.
* Help define foundational software architectures, configuration processes, and user experience workflows for our products, working directly with chief engineers, program managers, flight test engineers, and end-user customers to demonstrate capability and iterate on feedback.
* Work directly with frontend technologies like TypeScript/React/PySide, high-performance backend technologies like Golang/Python/Rust, and software product lifecycle technologies like NixOS/CircleCI/Docker.
* Interface with engineers developing every aspect of the system from low-level Linux drivers to cutting edge autonomy and streamlined user interfaces.
* Test and evaluate your software at multiple levels of rigor using simulations, benchtop hardware, and live flight assets.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 3+ years working with a variety of programming languages such as Python, Rust, C++, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, etc.
* Have experience working with customers to deliver novel software capabilities
* Want to work on building the tools that technicians, engineers, and operators will use to prepare Altius for real-world missions
* Have built user interfaces using popular frontend frameworks (React, PySide, etc)
* Are passionate about user experience and always strive to provide the most streamlined product
* Have an intuition for finding solutions to complex problems that involve multiple first and third party technologies (related to simulation, data management, compute infrastructure, networking, and more)
* Enjoy collaborating with team members and partners in the autonomy domain, and building technologies and processes which enable users to safely and rapidly develop and deploy autonomous systems at scale
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* You've built or invented something: an app, a website, game, startup
* Previous experience working in an engineering setting: a startup (or startup-like environment), engineering school, etc.
* Professional software development lifecycle experience using tools such as version control, CI/CD systems, etc.
* A deep, demonstrated understanding of how computers and networks work, from a single desktop to a multi-cluster cloud node (UDP, TCP, gRPC, REST, etc.)
* Experience creating infrastructure for robots or other complex embedded devices
* Experience building scalable backend software systems with various data storage and processing requirements
* Experience with industry standard cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), CI/CD tools, and software infrastructure fundamentals (networking, security, distributed systems)
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
* Experience with modern build and deployment tooling (e.g. CircleCI, Docker, NixOS, Terraform)
* Experience designing complex software systems, and iterating upon designs via a technical design review process
* Familiarity with industry standard monitoring, logging, and data management tools and best practices
* A bias towards rapid delivery and iteration

SEL (Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories) seeks a professional and innovative individual to join our Equipment Automation Engineering (EAE) team in Lewiston ID. SEL is a 100 percent employee-owned company that specializes in creating and manufacturing digital products and systems that protect and control power systems around the world.

**As an Automation Controls Engineer, a typical day might include the following:**

3. Laying out new industrial electrical control panels which are NFPA79/NEC/UL508A compliant and creating electrical schematics.

5. Managing electrical cabinet builds.

6. Creating machine interactions with plant-wide Manufacturing Execution System (MES).

8. Managing project scope, schedule, and budget for assigned projects.

9. Mentoring Associate Engineers and Technicians.

10. Other duties as assigned.

**This job might be for you if you have:**

1. B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or related discipline; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

2. Typically 2+ years relevant experience in designing, implementing, and/or modifying automation solutions in a manufacturing environment.

3. Working knowledge in the area of PLCs (example: Allen Bradley, Mitsubishi), HMI/GUI layout, Field Bus Networks, Vision Systems, and integration of Robotics.

4. Familiarity with electrical prints and standards for industrial equipment.

5. Demonstrated proficiency in programming PLCs.

6. Familiarity with some of the following programming methodologies:

* State machines
* Pick and place automation
* Parallel processing

* Data management

**JOB SUMMARY:**

NORC at the University of Chicago is seeking a Systems Engineer to join the Secure Computing and Operations group. This Systems Engineer position at NORC is for a hybrid role supporting the organization's voice infrastructure and its Computer Assisted Telephone Interviewing (CATI) systems. The role requires a blend of design, implementation, and operational support across Cisco, Microsoft, and CATI environments.

The Systems Engineer will design, implement, and maintain NORC’s voice communication systems, with a strong focus on Voice over IP (VoIP) and Unified Communications (UC) solutions. The Systems Engineer responsibilities span hardware and software management, network integration, troubleshooting, and ensuring high-quality, reliable, and secure voice services.

The Systems Engineer’s focus is on gaining operational proficiency with all components of the Voxco platform (including dialers, servers, and web survey tools) to ensure smooth operation. Responsibilities also include the configuration and maintenance of surveys and Interactive Voice Response (IVR) scripts, as well as the proactive monitoring, diagnosis, and resolution of all related system and access issues.

*This position will be based in our Chicago Loop office, with the expectation of hybrid work schedule of two days a week in the office.*

*Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.*

  

**DEPARTMENT: Secure Computing Systems and Operations**

NORC's Information Technology program provides technology services to our staff and clients. new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Seeker Market Expansion
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
**The Mission**
  
Join the **Seeker Market Expansion Software Team** within our Precision Strike & Sensing Solutions (PGSS) business. This isn't just another maintenance role; you will be a foundational technical contributor for a new, low-cost seeker program series that is critical to BAE Systems' growth over the next decade.
  
We are currently in the high-impact phase building and testing prototypes while forming requirements and interfaces. While we have early prototypes the architectural roadmap is still open. We need visionary Senior Engineers to help us shape the critical design decisions that will define the success of this program for years to come.
  
  
**The Challenge**
  
You will contribute to the development of complex embedded systems utilizing Xilinx System-on-Chip (SoC) FPGAs and System-on-a-Module (SOM) architectures leveraging ARM processors.
  
You will be instrumental in evaluating and implementing the right operating systems for our processing units, whether that is **FreeRTOS, VxWorks, or Bare Metal,** to ensure maximum reliability and performance for precision munitions.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* **Drive Technical Excellence:** Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), from initial design and coding to integration and verification on hardware
* **Mentor & Lead:** Serve as a key technical mentor to junior engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and high-standard engineering patterns
* **Collaborate Across Domains:** Partner closely with Systems, Hardware, and Test engineers to resolve complex technical bottlenecks and optimize the SoC interface
* **Secure the Future:** Implement security-focused development practices to mitigate vulnerabilities in critical national security infrastructure
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred)
* Ability to obtain a Secret Security Clearance
* 4+ years of experience in embedded systems development
* Proven track record creating software for Xilinx SoC FPGAs
* Proficiency in C/C++ with an expert-level understanding of memory management, data structures, and algorithms
Experience configuring and deploying embedded operating systems  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with RTOS (VxWorks, FreeRTOS) or Bare Metal development.
* Knowledge of signal processing or guidance and control systems
* Experience with Agile workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and static code analysis tools
* First-hand experience with agentic workflows
A security-first mindset regarding embedded vulnerabilities  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $88189 - $149922
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - GNSS / INS
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

We are seeking a full-time **Senior Software Engineer** **(GNSS / INS)** at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area or at our location in Cochrane, Alberta, Canada. This role is on our Core Platform Technology team and will develop GNSS and INS based positioning solutions. This is an innovation and exploration role where you will work closely with all of Garmin's product segments to explore, align and advance positioning technology in all of Garmin's product categories.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Contribute to productization and algorithm development in positioning technologies
* Design, implement, test and document complex software applications using C/C++ for use in embedded systems
* Participate in peer reviews of software designs, algorithm designs and software implementation
* Collaborate with colleagues on software/algorithm design approaches and implementations
* Provide reliable solutions to a variety of positioning problems using sound problem solving techniques
* Participates in project leadership and/or program planning including providing technical input to product development plans and concept documents
* Makes substantial contributions toward determination of project goal/objective feasibility and applies good judgment in setting schedules/risk taking
* Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced Software Engineers (1 & 2)
* Contributes to advanced technical research on new technologies
* Offers process improvement suggestions and authors new procedures as appropriate
* Provides reliable solutions to a wide range of difficult problems using sound problem solving techniques
* Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced software engineers (Software Engineer 1 & 2 & Senior Software Engineers)

Qualifications:

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Math, Physics or related field **AND** a minimum of 5 years relevant experience **OR** an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience in positioning algorithms for consumer applications with a strong understanding of GNSS measurements and error sources, estimation techniques including least squares & Kalman filtering, blunder/fault detection, multi-constellation and multi-frequency, AGNSS, inertial navigation systems, inertial sensors, sensor fusion and other geomatic related topics.
* Proficient in software development and engineering with C/C++ for embedded, real-time environments
* Strong ability to use scripting languages (i.e. Python, Matlab etc.) or C++ to automate data analysis of large amounts of data to verify positioning algorithms
* Proven ability to explore and research technical algorithmic problems and implementing appropriate algorithmic solutions
* Demonstrate a successful track record in managing exceedingly complex problems and providing success solutions which are highly innovative and ingenious
* Experience with architecting solutions for multiple groups and/or disciplines
* Must be positive, detail oriented, organized, team oriented and a driven problem solver, multi-tasker, and self-starter with the ability to prioritize and lead in a fast paced, deadline-driven environment

**Desired Qualifications**

  

* Expertise in inertial navigation techniques (e.g. vehicle and pedestrian dead reckoning, GNSS aided INS)
* Experience in Java
* Knowledge of carrier phase measurement processing methods
* Knowledgeable in GNSS measurement generation, tracking loops and how measurements are impacted by environment.
* Experience in MEMS sensor technology, including error source modeling and quantification of accelerometers and gyroscopes
* Experience in detection of GNSS denial of service, jamming or spoofing events

*Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.*

*This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here:* *Garmin Benefits*

The selected candidate will work closely with numerous engineering teams supporting the US Navy's Strategic Systems Programs command and its industry partners.
  
  
About SLCM-N
  
In response to global threats, SSP is continuing to defend our nation by adding a second nuclear defense system option to their mission responsibilities with the SLCM-N Program. SSP is building this modular, survivable cruise missile system that will be outfitted on some submarines and surface ships. SSP is responsible for designing, developing, building, and deploying the SLCM-N Weapons System and BAE Systems is supporting our customer in the pre-development activities for the program.
  
  
Our primary function is to ensure that all weapon system interface requirements are correctly defined and properly allocated to the cognizant organization. This is achieved by performing technical change evaluations and interfacing with government and contractor activities to define Weapon System Coordinated Interfaces. Accuracy, integrity, the ability to work independently, and a natural curiosity are important traits for a successful candidate to demonstrate.

Our organization has supported the U.S. Navy’s Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) continually since the program’s inception in the 1950s. new_jobs.title: Scientific Software Engineer – Machine Programming
new_jobs.description:
**Summary**

This role helps the scientists who build and operate QuEra's neutral-atom quantum computers program those machines effectively. You will maintain the domain-specific language and compiler stack, built on the open-source Kirin toolchain, that experimental physicists use every day to run their experiments.

You will work closely with physicists and control stack engineers. You'll help machine teams turn new experiments into working programs, keep the toolchain reliable as our hardware evolves, and drive its integration with our control system. The role suits an engineer who enjoys building tools and also helping others succeed with them.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the domain-specific language and its compilation stack: triage issues, fix bugs, review pull requests, manage releases and keep CI, tests and dependencies healthy.
* Act as the point of contact for machine and testbed teams programming their experiments. Help them build new experiments, port legacy programs and diagnose compilation or runtime problems.
* Work with control stack engineers on integrating compiled programs with our control system. This includes defining and evolving the program representation passed between the compiler and the control system, keeping the two in sync across releases, and debugging problems that span both.
* Turn user problems into minimal reproducible reports, regression tests and focused fixes, and work with the compiler team on larger language or IR changes.
* Find and fix performance problems in program compilation and execution, such as compile time, program size and timing correctness.
* Write and maintain user-facing documentation, tutorials, example programs and agent skills that make it easier for physicists to write correct programs.
* Work with the hardware control team to support new channel types, control hardware and machine configurations.
* Collect feedback from machine users and turn it into a prioritized roadmap for usability improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Python skills, including type hints, packaging and testing (pytest).
* Enjoys building tools for, and working closely with, scientists who are not professional software developers. Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience working across team boundaries: agreeing on interfaces, coordinating changes between components and debugging problems that span several systems.
* Experience debugging unfamiliar code and reducing complex failures to minimal reproductions.
* Familiarity with the full software lifecycle: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, logging, profiling, debugging and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with compilers, domain-specific languages or SSA-based intermediate representations (experience with Kirin, MLIR or LLVM is a plus).
* Background in experimental physics, especially AMO or atomic physics lab control (AWGs, AOMs/AODs, DDS, timing systems, cameras).
* Experience with real-time or embedded control systems, FPGAs, or experiment-control frameworks such as ARTIQ or Labscript.
* Experience with real-time scheduling or execution systems, such as runtime schedulers, streaming or instruction-dispatch systems.
* Experience with C++ or Rust.
* Contributions to open-source libraries.
* Experience using AI coding agents in a development workflow.

The approximate base salary range for this position is $102,400 - $166,400.

new_jobs.description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis are critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.

We believe in using the best tool for the job and are constantly evaluating our tech stack. Our current tools include:

* Python
* Vue.js
* Django + DRF
* Docker
* AWS: EKS, S3, RDS/PostgreSQL, SQS, MSK/Kafka

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical leader on the team building AISight, our digital pathology platform used by pathologists and labs worldwide. This is a fullstack role, but we don't expect equal depth everywhere. We want someone with deep expertise in either frontend or backend who works comfortably across the whole stack. You will set technical direction for the platform, take on our hardest cross-cutting problems, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.

* You will own the architecture of major areas of the platform and drive technical strategy in line with the product roadmap, balancing near-term delivery against long-term scalability and maintainability.
* You will lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through production. That means writing and reviewing technical designs, finding risks early, and making tradeoffs explicit.
* You will stay hands-on, writing production code on the most critical and technically demanding parts of the system.
* You will set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, security and performance across codebases, and drive improvements to our development practices and tooling.
* You will work with product, design, machine learning, infrastructure, QA and regulatory teams to make sure the software we ship is reliable, protects data integrity and patient data, and meets the requirements of a regulated medical device environment, including design controls and validation.
* You will mentor senior and mid-level engineers, grow technical leadership on the team, and help shape how we hire and onboard.
* You will represent engineering in conversations with customers, partners and stakeholders, explaining complex technical concepts to non-experts.

**Who You Are (Required)**
--------------------------

* You have a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* You have 8+ years of full lifecycle software development experience, including significant time in a senior or technical lead role.
* You have a track record of architecting and shipping large-scale production systems, and of leading technical initiatives across team boundaries.
* You have deep expertise in at least one of these areas, and working proficiency in the other:

* Backend: designing and building Python-based applications and APIs (Django or FastAPI), data modeling, relational databases (PostgreSQL) and distributed or event-driven systems.
* Frontend: building complex, performant web applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React or equivalent), including state management, frontend architecture and UX quality.

* You have a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* You have hands-on experience building and operating systems on a cloud platform (AWS preferred).
* You influence technical decisions through clear writing, sound judgment and collaboration, not authority.
* You have excellent communication skills and can work effectively with a distributed team and with non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience building software in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, HIPAA, CE-IVDR) or in healthtech.
* Experience with medical imaging, digital pathology, or large image and data visualization (e.g., whole-slide image viewers, WebGL or canvas rendering).
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitLab CI).
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with an infrastructure-as-code framework (e.g., Terraform, CDK).

new_jobs.description:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford's autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you'll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – ***all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.***

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

**Meet the team:**

The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that's cloud-agnostic as well as capable of running on-prem. The results of these simulations is business-critical for us - they're used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end-to-end capabilities.

**What you'll do:**

* We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we're releasing a safe product. You'll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we're constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You'll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you'll implement solutions to increase efficiency.
* It's not enough to have a framework that is functional - it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction - both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical.
* We also can't build it all, so we want to make the framework well-documented and as self-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there's a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly.
* In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You'll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage.
* Once we've run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV's performance; these metrics could range from low-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high-level business objectives. You'll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise.

**What you'll need to succeed:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)
* Expertise in writing Python code that's efficient, well-documented, and well-tested
* 2+ years' experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment
* 2+ years' experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services
* Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming
* Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems

**Nice to have (optional):**

* C++ development experience
* Experience with Kubernetes

* Health savings account with available employer match
* Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting
* Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

  

**Why work for us**

Our culture is focused on building inclusive teams, where differences and unique perspectives are embraced so you can contribute to your fullest potential as you pursue your career. Our locations feature a variety of work environments, including open workspaces and virtual connection platforms to inspire productivity and flexible collaboration. And we are proud to support employee volunteer interests and make it a priority to join together in efforts that give back to our communities.

  

**The Role:**

The Lab System Integration Engineering (LSIE) team is a part of a central engineering resource group that supports various battery, component, and propulsion test laboratories as well as vehicle garages in Pontiac, Warren, and Milford, Michigan. The Test Site Systems Engineer will directly support the Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL), the Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC), and the Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) at the Warren Technical Center campus with a focus on the software environments and automation platforms that enable safe, efficient testing.

  

The Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL-W) and Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC) utilize various automation software systems to operate 24/7. The Global Battery Systems Lab has testing capabilities that include traditional environmental testing, vibration, safety and abuse, exploratory development testing, and maintains commonality with GM’s battery lab located in Shanghai, China (GBSL-S). The Wallace Battery Innovation Center houses battery cell test chambers, cell formation chambers, a material synthesis lab, a slurry mixing and processing lab, a coating room, an electrolyte production lab, and a forensics lab with material analysis equipment and advanced software The Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) performs advanced diagnostic and failure analysis on returned components as well as full systems, using specialized test equipment, data analytics, plus forensic methods to resolve complex warranty issues. These labs and the results they produce are used by GM’s growing team of engineers working on advanced batteries and electrified vehicles, in support of the vision of a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions, and Zero Congestion.

  

This role manages the lab software ecosystem for GBSL, WBCIC, and the RWC. Scope includes TCWS (test cell workstation) builds and configurations, LSIE’s test automation toolchain, small operational applications, the Influx/Telegraf/Grafana metrics stack, Databricks interfaces for moving lab data into analytics pipelines, and Windows-based operating environments for critical test PCs. The engineer will use enterprise automation tooling (e.g. Ansible, Baramundi) to provision test systems, manage fleets, execute software deployments, coordinate environment changes, maintain configuration records plus change records, and standardize how test sites use enterprise toolchains. The focus is on solutions that meet operator and lab needs while staying aligned with enterprise direction.

  

An engineer seeking end-to-end ownership of the software backbone that keeps more than 100 battery test beds running across GBSL, WBCIC, and the RWC will be well-matched to this position. The engineer in this position will design and standardize back-end environments, deployment pipelines, Windows test-fleet automation, and metrics pipelines that connect enterprise platforms to day-to-day lab operations while building a broad skill set across DevOps, site systems, and large-scale test automation. **This is an onsite role at the Warren Technical Center to ensure direct engagement with lab operations, test systems, and partner teams.**

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities):**

* Support testing PC builds, related test software configuration, and deployments across GBSL/WBCIC/RWC in partnership with DevOps engineers.
* Maintain software environments on critical test PCs by coordinating OS and security updates with IT while managing LSIE-owned applications plus configurations.
* Own lifecycle management for key test systems, including version control, compatibility planning, environment upgrades, and major platform migrations.
* Own the metrics pipeline for lab test systems across Influx, Telegraf, Grafana, and test automation systems
* Support and maintain LSIE’s test automation toolchain that underpins daily lab operations at GBSL/WBCIC/RWC.
* Maintain software change logs, configuration records, runbooks, and standard test PC images to support traceability, audit readiness, and faster root-cause analysis.
* Act as the technical bridge between LSIE, Computer Aided Testing (CAT), and IT for infrastructure decisions that affect the test environment.
* Evaluate, pilot, and implement tools from pertinent teams so they fit site needs
* Standardize software support approaches, toolchains, and configurations across GBSL/WBCIC/RWC to reduce redundant local solutions
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for software issues that impact test execution, working with LSIE application engineers, lab operations, CAT, and IT.
* Plan and execute complex software and infrastructure changes that affect the labs including source control or license migrations, environment upgrades, and other enterprise-driven changes
Support weekend or off-shift needs for planned changes and high-priority software issue

With more than $1B in revenue, Tennant Company is a globally recognized leader in the cleaning equipment industry. For the past 150 years, we have been passionate about developing and manufacturing innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. At Tennant Company, we are committed to stewardship and creating a cleaner, safer and healthier world. With manufacturing, operations and sales, service, and support functions across the globe, your journey at Tennant can take you places you never expected.

  

**Position Overview**

The Senior Robotics Engineer - Machine Integration Lead supports the TNC Robotics Product Development and R&D organization by leading machine-level integration and technical execution across complex electromechanical systems, embedded software, controls, and partner technologies, such as Brain Corp, used in TNC robotic cleaning solutions.

This engineer translates product and system requirements into integrated, compliant, robust, and cost-effective machine solutions. The role coordinates cross-functional engineering work, resolves system interface issues, leads integration and prototype events, and applies disciplined systems engineering practices throughout New Product Development (NPD). Success is measured by the quality and readiness of integrated designs, timely resolution of technical risks, effective cross-functional execution, and achievement of program performance, cost, quality, and compliance objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Senior Robotics Engineer - Machine Integration Lead is responsible for coordinating technical execution against the system definition and development plan and for delivering system integration outcomes across NPD efforts:

* **Technical Planning & Work Breakdown:** Lead cross-functional planning for assigned machine systems and integration workstreams. Translate program objectives into a practical work breakdown structure with defined deliverables, interfaces, dependencies, milestones, and owners. Track execution, communicate status, and escalate technical risks, trade-offs, and corrective actions when program commitments are at risk.
* **Requirements Translation & Specification:** Translate customer, business, regulatory, and technical needs into clear system and subsystem requirements and specifications. Maintain linkage between requirements, design outputs, interfaces, and verification and validation (V&V) activities.
* **System Architecture & Integration:** Apply established system architecture to coordinate subsystem design and machine-level integration. Define and manage interfaces across mechanical, electrical, controls, embedded software, autonomy, communications, and partner systems. Verify that integrated solutions meet machine performance, cost, quality, serviceability, and reliability requirements.
* **Technical Execution & Design Reviews**: Plan and facilitate cross-functional technical reviews for assigned systems and integration deliverables. Ensure reviews address requirements compliance, interface maturity, technical risks, design decisions, V&V readiness, and readiness for prototype and production builds, including manufacturing, sourcing, quality, and service considerations.
* **Prototyping, Integration & De-risking**: Plan and coordinate prototype builds, bench testing, machine integration events, and proofs of concept. Use test results and structured learning to identify issues early, reduce technical uncertainty, and mature designs through the product development process.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Engineer** to help strengthen and reinforce our security processes, workflows, and posture as it relates to our applications, cloud infrastructure, and platform. In this role, you won't just be patching what's already broken; you will be defining how we find and close exposures before they're used against us. You will own and engineer the detection, investigation, and response capabilities that protect our global platforms while leading the charge into AI-augmented defense, using AI to compress the time between a vulnerability's disclosure and its exploitation in the wild.

You will act as the bridge between deep, code-level investigation and enterprise-wide risk reduction, ensuring our software supply chain, cloud infrastructure, and applications are not just compliant, but resilient by design.  

**\*\* Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office four days a week. \*\***

**What Makes This Job Awesome? You will...**

* **Security Architecture & Tooling:** Own our SAST/DAST program end-to-end, selecting, tuning, and integrating static and dynamic analysis tooling into the CI/CD pipeline so vulnerabilities are caught before merge, not after breach.
* **AI & Agentic Defense:** Proactively identify and build AI/LLM-driven agents that close the gap between exposure and detection. CVE feeds alone are a shrinking signal in an AI-accelerated threat landscape, so we need LLM inference layered at multiple points in the platform: dependency and supply-chain analysis, code-level review, and runtime behavior, catching what a CVE number never will.
* **Deep Investigation:** Own security incidents end-to-end, from the first anomalous signal, through root-cause analysis and remediation, to the post-mortem that prevents recurrence. You follow a problem to completion; you don't hand it off halfway through.
* **Read by Code:** Read code fluently enough to validate a finding at the source rather than taking a scanner's word for it. You won't be writing production code daily, but you need to be comfortable in at least one systems language (C, C++, Rust, or similar languages) well enough that reading it critically, and catching what's wrong with it, is second nature.
* **Vulnerability & Threat Management:** Lead vulnerability management and threat modeling across our entire environment, internal and external, prioritizing based on real-world exploitability and business impact, not just CVSS score.
* **Compliance & Trust:** Partner with legal, IT, and leadership to maintain and mature our compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, InfoSec, and customer security questionnaires), translating audit and control requirements into practical engineering work rather than checkbox paperwork.
* **Mentorship & Influence:** Act as a force multiplier by mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional product teams on secure coding, threat modeling, and security-first development.
* **Incident Response:** Serve as a high-level escalation point for complex security incidents, conducting deep-dive post-mortems that drive structural improvements rather than quick fixes.

**What You'll Do**

* **A Student of the Craft:** You're less interested in being the smartest person in the room than in staying honest about how fast the room is changing. AI has rewritten the security landscape almost overnight, and some of the assumptions and playbooks that worked two years ago no longer hold. You know your way around Arxiv and ACM, and keep a genuine eye on the research as it's published, not just the vendor's take on it three months later. You track where the industry is headed, not just where it's been, and you're comfortable saying "that doesn't work anymore" and rebuilding the approach.
* **Secure by Design:** You have hands-on experience with secrets management (Vault, AWS KMS/Secrets Manager, or similar), secure API design (authN/authZ, input validation, rate limiting), and system hardening standards like CIS Benchmarks and SELinux/AppArmor.
* **The "AI Native" Defender Mindset:** You are passionate about the intersection of security and AI, and you think beyond CVE feeds, you want LLM inference embedded at multiple layers of the platform (supply chain, code, runtime) doing the correlation and triage a human can't keep pace with alone. To you, an LLM is nothing more than a non-deterministic program, and you can tell the difference between a genuine threat and hype.

This role provides technical leadership for PLCs, HMIs, robotics, motion control, machine vision, and industrial communication networks to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing operations.

The Senior Controls & Automation Engineer works closely with manufacturing, maintenance, process engineering, quality, production leadership, and equipment suppliers to improve equipment performance, increase throughput, reduce downtime, and support new equipment installations and production launches. This position also provides technical guidance and mentorship to controls engineers, automation technicians, and maintenance personnel.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Controls Engineering & Automation***

* Design, develop, program, and maintain PLC-based control systems using Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation, or equivalent platforms.
* Develop and maintain HMI/SCADA applications, alarm systems, equipment interfaces, and production monitoring functionality.
* Integrate industrial robots, servo drives, motion control systems, sensors, actuators, machine vision, barcode readers, and automated inspection equipment.
* Support automated battery cell module and pack assembly processes.
* Integrate production equipment with industrial networks, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and plant monitoring systems.
* Review electrical schematics, control panel designs, I/O lists, network architecture, and equipment specifications.

***Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement***

* Lead complex troubleshooting efforts involving PLCs, electrical controls, robotics, sensors, drives, and automated equipment.
* Identify root causes of recurring equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Improve equipment cycle times, uptime, reliability, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies in collaboration with maintenance teams.
* Analyze equipment downtime and production data to identify opportunities for automation improvements and cost reduction.
* Provide technical support during production escalations and critical equipment breakdowns.

***Equipment Installation & Commissioning***

* Lead controls activities for new equipment installations, system upgrades, retrofits, and production line expansions.
* Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, validation, and production ramp-up.
* Collaborate with OEMs, integrators, contractors, and internal engineering teams to ensure equipment meets functional and performance specifications.
* Verify machine functionality, interlocks, alarms, sequence logic, and safety-related control requirements before equipment release.
* Maintain controls documentation, software backups, troubleshooting guides, and change records.

***Safety, Quality & Compliance***

* Ensure automation systems support appropriate machine safeguarding, safety interlocks, emergency stops, and safety-related control requirements.
* Follow applicable OSHA, NFPA, and other relevant electrical and machinery safety standards.
* Support risk assessments, safety reviews, and corrective actions related to automated equipment.
* Maintain compliance with plant engineering standards, change-control procedures, and equipment validation requirements.
* Support quality investigations and process improvements related to automated assembly and inspection systems.

***Technical Leadership & Collaboration***

* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and training to controls engineers, automation technicians, and maintenance personnel.
* Establish and promote controls programming standards, software documentation practices, and equipment design guidelines.
* Coordinate automation priorities with manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and process engineering teams.
* Manage technical issues with equipment vendors and integrators to ensure timely resolution.
* Support engineering project planning, technical reviews, equipment specifications, and project execution.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Typically 7+ years of experience in industrial controls, automation engineering, or manufacturing equipment integration.
* Strong experience programming and troubleshooting industrial PLCs, preferably Siemens and/or Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation.
* Experience developing HMI/SCADA applications, industrial networks, servo systems, and automated equipment.

Prior work in NASCAR, IndyCar, Formula 1, or another professional motorsports organization.

new_jobs.title: Junior IoT Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Note

* Hybrid, may be asked to come into the office for hands-on tasks

Junior IoT Engineer

**No engineering degree required, but curiosity is.**

We're a small IoT company building and deploying real-world sensor systems, and we're looking for someone early in their engineering career who loves learning how things work.

You might be getting an Electrical Engineering or Computer Science degree. You might have gone to trade school. You might be self-taught and have a desk covered in Arduinos, Raspberry Pis, wires, and half-finished projects.

We're interested in what you can **do and learn**, not the name on your diploma.

Show us what you've built

Seriously.

Built something with an Arduino? Designed a PCB? Made a robot? Automated your house? Written firmware? Set up a home server? Repaired electronics? Built something completely ridiculous just because you wanted to see if you could?

**Tell us about it.**

Personal projects, hobbies, and things you've taught yourself matter to us.

What you'll do

You'll work with real IoT hardware throughout its entire lifecycle—from engineering prototypes to devices deployed in the field.

Your work will include:

* Configuring and preparing IoT devices for deployment
* Managing firmware and device settings across our fleet
* Testing and QA'ing sensors before they become finished goods
* Troubleshooting devices that don't behave the way they're supposed to
* Using fleet data to investigate problems and identify trends
* Testing new hardware and firmware designs
* Presenting feedback to the rest of the R&D team
* Learning to diagnose PCB, sensor, power, firmware, and RF problems
* Helping us improve the tools and processes we use to configure, test, and deploy devices

Some days you'll be working with production hardware. Other days you might be looking through logs, testing a prototype, chasing down an RF problem, writing a script to automate something annoying, or putting an oscilloscope on a board to figure out what went wrong.

That's part of the fun.

Things you'll learn

We **do not expect you to already know all of these.**

Experience with any of them is a bonus. More importantly, we're looking for someone **excited to learn**:

* Microcontrollers and embedded systems
* Linux and the command line
* Firmware and device management
* PCB debugging
* Sensors and IoT systems
* RF and wireless communications
* Data analysis and troubleshooting
* Python and scripting
* Electronics test equipment, including:
* Multimeters
* Oscilloscopes
* Logic analyzers
* Programmable power supplies and loads
* Other lab equipment you'll probably find an excuse to play with

You'll get exposure to the full lifecycle of an IoT product:

**prototype → hardware → firmware → testing → production → deployment → fleet data → field troubleshooting**

Who we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:

* Curious
* Hands-on
* Comfortable saying, "I don't know, but I can figure it out"
* Excited to learn new tools
* Willing to dig into weird problems
* Careful enough to do good production and QA work
* Interested in understanding *why* something failed instead of simply replacing it
* Happy working across hardware, software, data, and production rather than staying in one narrow lane

If you've ever spent an evening trying to figure out why an Arduino wasn't doing what you told it to do, taken apart an electronic device just to see what was inside, or taught yourself something because you couldn't stop wondering how it worked, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

What it's like working here

You'll report directly to our **Head of Research & Engineering**.

We don't expect a junior engineer to walk through the door already knowing everything. Teaching and mentorship are a major part of how our R&D team operates. You'll start with problems you can tackle and take on increasingly difficult ones as your skills grow.

Because we're a small company, you won't be isolated from the rest of the product. You'll work alongside the people designing, programming, testing, deploying, and supporting the systems you're working on.

That means you'll get exposure to a lot of engineering very quickly.

We're also a team that genuinely enjoys working together. We take the engineering seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. Expect bad puns, plenty of joking around, people jumping in to help each other debug problems, and coworkers who actually enjoy hanging out together.

You do NOT need

* An engineering degree
* Years of professional experience
* To know every tool or technology listed above
* To pretend you know something when you don't

Bring curiosity, a willingness to learn, and something cool you've worked on.

**We can teach a lot of the rest.**

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cincinnati, OH 45202

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.
  
  
This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export control regulations, and applicants must be a 'U.S. Person' as defined by applicable law, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. The Equipment Maintenance Controls Engineer is responsible for supporting the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of manufacturing equipment and automated systems. The role focuses on reducing equipment downtime, improving equipment reliability, troubleshooting complex control-system issues, supporting preventive and predictive maintenance activities, and implementing equipment and controls improvements that support safe, efficient, and consistent manufacturing operations.

* Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC and HMI programs as required.
* Support industrial robots and automated material-handling systems, including troubleshooting programming, communication, interlock, and peripheral-equipment issues.

* Participate in continuous improvement, root cause analysis, and equipment reliability initiatives.

* Automotive, die-casting, machining, assembly, or similar manufacturing experience is beneficial

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.  

* Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
* Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
* Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.  

* Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
* Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
* Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
* Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
* Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
* Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

Join Intel as a **Memory Firmware Engineer** and help develop the foundational firmware that enables next-generation computing platforms. In this role, you will contribute to firmware solutions supporting memory initialization, training, calibration, and validation for advanced memory technologies.

Working alongside architecture, design, validation, and silicon engineering teams, you will help ensure memory subsystems operate reliably and efficiently across Intel platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer looking to develop expertise at the intersection of hardware and software.
