* Develop and enhance firmware for memory subsystem initialization, training, calibration, and configuration.
* Design firmware interfaces that enable seamless interaction between hardware and software components.
* Support firmware integration in simulation and validation environments.
* Debug and resolve firmware issues in both pre-silicon and post-silicon environments.
* Collaborate with architecture, RTL design, verification, and validation teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and validation activities to ensure firmware quality and reliability.
* Support compliance with JEDEC standards and memory subsystem requirements.

They will be the technical lead on both design and build-to-print projects for complex analog, digital, and radio frequency (RF) products. Responsibilities on these projects include leading engineering development, prototyping, design verification, and transition to production. The position requires the ability to exercise discretion and independent judgement and be able to mentor and lead other members of the engineering staff.  
  
Position Responsibilities:  

* Work cross-functionally across the organization (program management, procurement, manufacturing engineering, quality engineering, test, production, business development, contracts).
* Create and lead implementation of innovative ideas in support of internal research and development.
* Generate and implement improvements in product design and test throughput.
* Develop and implement test plans, procedures, and fixtures for complex Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) and electrical systems.
* Interface directly with customers and suppliers to support technical issues.
* Provide training, mentorship, and leadership to engineering and test staff.
* Research and apply complex electrical engineering principles and theories to solve customer problems.
* Manage complex and expansive build-to-print projects as a project engineer.
* Lead full design program life cycles (concept, specification, prototype, production, sustainment).
* Manage and perform analog and digital circuit design including system level design concepts and complex analyses such as EMI/EMC, signal integrity, and FDFL analysis.

* Lead design reviews, code reviews, and test reviews.

* Experienced in EMI/EMC design
* Experienced in reviewing physical designs, electronic schematics and PCB layouts of new products, in the military market

o Associates degree in Electronic Engineer Technology or related field and 18+ years of experience in design and production of high reliability DoD products and systems

Overview  
  
  

Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career.

  

At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day.

  

Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role.

  
  
Responsibilities  
  
  

### **Role Overview**

MSA Safety’s Verification and Validation Engineering organization is seeking a technically skilled and inquisitive **Software Verification and Test Automation Engineer**. As an integral member of the engineering team, you will help shape the product from requirements through release, ensuring customer and product needs are clearly defined, testable, and delivered as intended.

  

By working across requirements, design, development, and testing, you will gain a deep understanding of the entire product. You will use that knowledge to influence engineering decisions, identify risks early, implement and improve test automation, and help deliver high-quality products that protect people when it matters most.

### **What You Will Experience**

* Join a global technology company that develops products and solutions designed to protect industrial workers and firefighters, save lives, and help organizations manage their environmental impact.
* Apply your technical expertise and quality-focused approach across a range of technologies and product types.
* Collaborate with engaged, cross-functional team members who bring different skills, backgrounds, and perspectives.
* Work with products and systems that may include:

  + Safety-critical and secure software
  + Hazardous-environment detection systems
  + Sensor technologies such as environmental sensing, location tracking, infrared, and lasers
  + Connected physical and digital products using technologies such as AWS, cellular networks, GNSS, Bluetooth Low Energy, and wired communication

* Improve products, tools, processes, and ways of working while advancing your technical skills and career.

* Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for embedded software, including integration, regression, performance, and system-level testing.
* Maintain and improve test automation systems, tools, and supporting infrastructure, while performing manual testing when needed.
* Participate in code reviews and work with developers to identify, investigate, and resolve software issues.
* Analyze and communicate test results, quality data, and risks to guide product development and process improvements.
* Travel domestically or internationally up to 10% as needed.

  
Qualifications  
  
  

This position is responsible for developing test methodologies, processes, tools, and automation for complex embedded software systems, and therefore must have demonstrated skills in the following areas:

* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Experience supporting embedded product development
* Strong Python scripting skills
* Experience in developing test cases, test harnesses, and test scripts
* Experience in developing test automation in an embedded environment
* Understanding the application of testing methodologies, such as Unit Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, System Testing, and Performance Testing.
* Experience using version control, issue tracking, and collaboration tools (e.g. Git, Jira, Confluence etc.)
* Experience using Continuous Integration tools, such as Bamboo, Jenkins, or Travis.
* Experience with software development and related quality metrics
* A passion for software development quality, and a strong desire for learning and continuous improvement
* Strong communications skills, and a desire to work in a global, multicultural team

**NOW HIRING: INDUSTRIAL CONTROLS & AUTOMATION ENGINEERS**

Entry-Level to Senior Electrical Engineering Opportunities

**Department:** Engineering (Electrical)

**Location:** On-site only | 531 Old Swede Road – Douglassville, PA 19518 (no remote or hybrid)

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | 8:00AM–4:30PM | Full-time

**Compensation:** $80,000 – $120,000 annually, based on electrical/controls-programming experience, technical capability, education, ability to contribute independently, and market data

Looking for real engineering work, hands-on problem solving, and projects that actually get built?

We're looking for Electrical Engineers with strong industrial controls and automation experience, especially engineers who have programmed, commissioned, or supported automated equipment using Beckhoff Structured Text or similar IEC 61131-3 platforms.

Your controls logic, electrical designs, and troubleshooting decisions will run equipment that is built, tested, installed, and operated in real industrial environments.

You won't get lost here. Your work will be seen, and it will matter.

**No Crane Experience?** Keep Reading

Direct overhead-crane experience is valuable, but it's not the only way in. We especially want engineers from industries that design, build, integrate, or support:

* Conveyor and sortation systems
* Automated material-handling equipment
* Distribution and fulfillment centers
* Packaging and processing machinery
* Robotics and motion-control systems
* Custom industrial machinery
* Warehouse and manufacturing automation
* Systems integration
* Heavy industrial equipment

If you've designed controls for equipment that moves, positions, lifts, transfers, sequences, or automates material, your experience may translate directly to our work.

**What This Role Really Is**

This is a hands-on industrial electrical engineering and controls role focused on custom crane, hoist, motion-control, and automated material-handling systems.

You'll work across the full equipment lifecycle: electrical design, controls programming, manufacturing support, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and field performance. Depending on experience, you'll either support projects under mentorship or own the electrical and controls scope for complex engineered systems.

This role takes more than creating drawings. Success depends on understanding how hardware, software, motors, drives, sensors, safety systems, and mechanical equipment work together as one system.

**Who Thrives Here (and Who Doesn't)**

You'll do well here if you:

* Enjoy programming and troubleshooting real industrial equipment
* Can connect controls logic to physical machine behavior
* Take ownership of technical decisions and system performance
* Are comfortable working across electrical design, software, manufacturing, and testing
* Enjoy custom-engineered projects more than repetitive product work
* Communicate well with engineers, technicians, electricians, manufacturing employees, and customers
* Want your designs to be built, tested, and used

This role is likely not a fit if you:

* Prefer software development with little interaction with physical equipment
* Want a highly segmented role limited to one narrow engineering task
* Avoid hands-on troubleshooting or manufacturing-floor involvement
* Prefer repetitive controls projects with limited customization
* Don't want accountability for how the completed system performs

**What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)**

**Early-Career Engineers**

* Learn ACECO electrical standards, controls architecture, products, and engineering workflows
* Support electrical schematics, hardware selection, software documentation, and system testing
* Develop familiarity with PLCs, VFDs, motor controls, sensors, safety circuits, and crane operating sequences
* Build working relationships with Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing, Field Service, and Project Management
* Begin contributing to controls programming and troubleshooting under guidance

**Experienced Engineers**

* Review existing industrial-controls architecture with minimal ramp-up
* Contribute independently to Structured Text programming, electrical design, and system troubleshooting
* Begin owning the electrical and controls scope for assigned projects
* Support manufacturing and field teams during equipment testing and issue resolution
* Identify improvements to controls standards, reusable code, documentation, and workflows
* Serve as a technical resource for less experienced engineers where appropriate

**Why Join Our Team at American Crane?**

* Controls Work With Physical Impact: your software and electrical designs directly control large, highly customized industrial equipment
* Complex Automation Challenges: motors, drives, feedback devices, motion systems, safety circuits, operator interfaces, sensors, and coordinated sequences
* Transferable Experience: conveyor, warehouse automation, packaging, robotics, systems integration, and custom machinery backgrounds apply directly
* Full-System Exposure: design, programming, manufacturing support, testing, commissioning, and field troubleshooting
* Technical Ownership: engineering judgment matters here, and you'll own how your designs perform
* Stability & Growth: an established manufacturer investing in automation, connected equipment, and advanced controls

**What You'll Do**

Industrial Controls Programming

* Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot PLC-based control systems for cranes, hoists, and material-handling equipment
* Program industrial automation applications
* Develop sequenced operations, interlocks, permissives, alarms, diagnostics, and fault-handling logic
* Support reusable programming standards, function blocks, libraries, and controls architecture
* Develop or support operator-interface and HMI functionality
* Document controls logic, software revisions, operating sequences, and system behavior
* Support software simulation, testing, debugging, and commissio

new_jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

**Ambiq** is on a mission to enable intelligence everywhere — powering the AI edge revolution with the world's lowest-power semiconductor solutions.

Built on our proprietary sub- and near-threshold technology, our chips deliver multi-fold improvements in energy efficiency without costly process scaling. Since 2010, we've shipped over 300 million units to customers building smarter wearables, medical devices, IoT products, and AI-powered edge applications.

Our cross-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. We move fast, tackle hard problems, and create space for people to grow through complex, meaningful work that shapes the future of technology.

We're looking for self-motivated, creative problem-solvers who are eager to push technological limits and make a real impact in energy efficiency.

At Ambiq, we live by five values: **Innovate. Collaborate. Focus. Learn. Achieve.**

If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here.

**This role will be on-site 5 days a week in NW Austin.**

### **Scope**

As the Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Power Management at Ambiq, you will drive the software architecture, requirements, development, testing, and performance optimization of the SDK power management software for our latest family of low-power Edge AI MCUs. In this role, you will work closely with SoC hardware power architects, product marketing, validation, and our IP vendors to define the software architecture, functional partitioning, and requirements for the platform's power management infrastructure. You will provide technical leadership and architectural direction to the software development and system test teams, ensuring the delivery of robust, production-quality software on schedule. The role encompasses the power management infrastructure, memory control and retention, clock management, low-power operating modes, and software techniques for optimizing system-level power consumption.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience in early-stage software architecture and hands-on embedded software development. They must have a proven track record of designing, implementing, debugging, profiling, and optimizing embedded software for ARM Cortex-M processors using an RTOS. Experience developing low-level firmware, power management software, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers is essential. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader who enjoys solving complex technical problems while remaining actively involved in software design, implementation, code reviews, and debugging.

**Responsibilities**

* Define software requirements and functional allocations based on evolving input from SoC hardware architects, product marketing, software architects, validation and software development teams.
* Design, develop, debug, profile, and optimize the AmbiqSuite SDK power management software, including power modeling and characterization under a wide range of operating conditions.
* Own the SoC software architecture, performance, and power optimization, identifying opportunities to reduce power consumption while maintaining system performance and functionality.
* Work closely with product marketing, field engineering, validation, and system test teams to understand customer use cases and translate them into software architecture, implementation, and test requirements.
* Serve as the technical authority for power management software, reviewing software designs, architecture, code, test plans, and validation results to ensure quality, performance, and low-power operation.
* Drive cross-functional technical discussions with hardware architects, firmware developers, validation, and IP vendors to resolve architectural issues and ensure successful product execution.
* Diagnose complex system-level issues spanning hardware and software, and evaluate architectural trade-offs to achieve the optimal balance of power, performance, cost, and implementation complexity.
* Develop software for low-power operating modes, clock management, memory retention, wake-up sequencing, and other power management infrastructure components.
* Define and implement methodologies, tools, and metrics for measuring, profiling, and optimizing software power consumption.
* Work with relevant teams to ensure power-optimized implementation of the RTOS ports for Ambiq SoCs.
* Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, technical mentoring, and by establishing software development best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience developing embedded software for ARM Cortex-M–based systems in bare-metal and RTOS environments.
* Expert-level C/C++ programming skills, with experience developing low-level firmware, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HAL), and startup code. Experience with ARM assembly language is a plus.
* Strong understanding of SoC architecture, including processor subsystems, memory hierarchy, bus interconnects, interrupts, DMA engines, cache architectures, memory protection, inter-processor communication, and shared memory systems.
* Proven experience designing, implementing, debugging, profiling, and optimizing software for ultra-low-power embedded systems.
* Strong understanding of embedded power management techniques, including clock management, voltage and frequency scaling, power domains, memory retention, clock gating, and low-power operating modes.
* Experience profiling and analyzing power consumption across software and hardware boundaries, including identifying and resolving system-level performance and power bottlenecks.
* Hands-on experience using embedded development and debug tools, including JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power analyzers

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

You will be an Algorithm Engineer on the Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Sensor Fusion team, working at the forefront of sensor fusion, perception, and autonomy for fighter and unmanned platforms. In this role you will have a significant impact on shaping the future of Sensor Fusion across Aeronautics, defining the vision for our next‑generation platforms, and integrating Lockheed Martin’s most advanced technologies. If you thrive on pushing the envelope, enjoy tackling difficult algorithmic challenges, and are passionate about turning novel sensor concepts into flight‑ready software, this position on our Emerging‑Technology Sensor Fusion team is for you.

As an engineer working in sensor fusion you will possess a combination of skills from various disciplines:

**Programming Fundamentals**

Programming Languages: Proficiency in languages such as Python, C++, C#, or MATLAB.  
Software Frameworks: Familiarity with software frameworks, such as NumPy, SciPy, or TensorFlow, MATLAB, MATLAB Object Oriented, for numerical computations.  
Simulation Tools: Knowledge of simulation tools, such as Simulink or MATLAB, for modeling and testing sensor fusion systems.

**Mathematical Foundations**

Linear Algebra: Understanding of vector spaces, linear transformations, and matrix operations.  
Probability Theory and Statistics: Familiarity with probability distributions, Bayes' theorem, and stochastic processes. Knowledge of statistical inference, estimation, and hypothesis testing.  
Advanced topics: Understanding of numerical optimization, convex optimization, non-linear optimization, machine learning, and/or mathematical methods.

**Signal Processing and Filtering**

Signal Processing: Understanding of signal processing techniques, such as filtering, convolution, and Fourier analysis.  
Kalman Filter: Familiarity with the Kalman filter algorithm, its variants (e.g., Extended Kalman Filter, Unscented Kalman Filter), and applications.  
Particle Filter: Knowledge of particle filter algorithms and their applications in non-linear, non-Gaussian systems.

**Tracking**

Embedded Development: Acute proficiency in Programming Fundamentals applied to embedded systems.  
Sensor Modeling: Understanding of sensor characteristics, noise models, calibration techniques, Signal Processing and Filtering, and Mathematical Foundations.  
Data Association: Familiarity with data association techniques, such as nearest neighbor, joint probabilistic data association, and multiple hypothesis tracking.  
State Estimation: Knowledge of state estimation algorithms, including Kalman filters, particle filters, and Bayesian estimation methods.

**Sensor Integration and Management**

Resource Allocation: Experience tasking, prioritizing, and scheduling of sensors and maximizing information value, system needs, or target tracking accuracy with a deep understanding of Programming Fundamentals.  
Sensor Integration: Experience with integrating sensors like LIDAR, RADAR, or cameras and offboard sources.

- Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field

- Experience implementing Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or statistical algorithms in real time operating systems

- Strong mathematical foundation in Linear Algebra, Probability Theory, and Statistics

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At Compu Dynamics, we don't just build infrastructure—we create the backbone of the digital future. As North America's premier technology infrastructure design-build partner, we design, construct, and maintain mission-critical data centers for some of the world's most innovative companies. With roots in one of the fastest-growing data center markets in the world, our growth is as intentional as our impact.

**About Compu Dynamics Modular**

Compu Dynamics Modular (CDM) is at the forefront of innovative modular solutions, specializing in Modular Data Centers (MDC), metal frame systems, and fully integrated enclosures. Our designs are scalable, efficient, and sustainable, tailored to meet the evolving needs of our clients in a dynamic industry.

  

**Summary/Objective:**

The **Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer** is a technical leader responsible for driving the design, development, and implementation of electrical and control systems across Compu Dynamics Modular's data center and commercial modular products. This role provides expertise from early-stage concepting through manufacturing, installation, and site commissioning. The Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer is a key contributor to product innovation and standardization and serves as a mentor to junior engineers, modular designers, and project managers .

  

This individual is recognized as a subject matter expert within the company and plays a critical role in maintaining compliance with all codes, improving processes, and delivering cutting-edge modular infrastructure solutions.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**1. Electrical Design & Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the electrical and controls system design process for modular product development, including commercial and data center applications.
* Develop and review one-line diagrams, electrical schematics, cable schedules, load lists, and detailed designs using AutoCAD
* Calculate electrical loads, select equipment, and perform code analysis to ensure design compliance.
* Generate complete electrical Bills of Material
* Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure designs meet production best practices and are constructible.
* Develop PLC and HMI based environmental monitoring systems from a hardware and software perspective
* Select monitoring systems and instruments as required, including biometric access, alarming systems, fire detection systems, leak detection, temperature, pressure, and humidity sensors

**2. Project & Product Development Support**

* Guide electrical scope development during bids and conceptual design phases; assist in cost estimation and proposal generation.
* Review and approve submittals, RFIs, and shop drawings; provide technical documentation and responses to client or inspector inquiries.
* Support field activities including site surveys, system troubleshooting, and commissioning support.
* Generate required installation and maintenance documentation

**3. Cross-functional Collaboration & Vendor Coordination**

* Interface with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders to resolve design issues and clarify technical requirements.
* Coordinate vendor selections based on technical and performance requirements; manage relationships with manufacturer representatives.
* Review external control schematics and ensure alignment with modular system needs.

**4. Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead efforts to ensure compliance with NEC, local codes, safety regulations, and internal documentation standards.
* Develop and maintain internal electrical design standards, tools, and templates.
* Research and implement industry best practices for modular system design and integration.

**5. Mentorship & Technical Leadership**

* Provide training and guidance to junior engineers and modular design staff.
* Conduct peer reviews and technical audits across project teams.
* Contribute to long-term engineering strategy and process improvement initiatives.

  

**Competencies:**

* Deep knowledge of electrical power systems, controls, and modular design.

* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit and Microsoft Office Suite.

* Familiarity with controller software (e.g., PLC and HMI based systems)

* Fundamental understanding of industrial networking protocols and BMS interface

* Excellent communication and technical writing skills.

* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving abilities.

* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple concurrent projects.

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

This role may mentor and oversee work performed by junior engineers or modular designers but does not have formal direct reports.

**Work Environment:**

Work is primarily performed in an office or collaborative environment with occasional site visits. Field work may include exposure to active construction, elevated temperatures, and energized equipment.

  

**Physical Demands:**

Must be able to conduct site walks, climb ladders, and lift up to 25 pounds occasionally. Must be comfortable working in manufacturing and job site environments when necessary.

**Position Type:**

Full-time, non-exempt. Work hours follow the service department schedule and may include occasional overtime.

**Travel:**

Up to 15% travel may be required for site walks, commissioning support, or vendor meetings.

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or similar field.
* 10+ years of experience in electrical engineering with an emphasis on commercial, industrial, or mission-critical projects.
* Expert-level understanding of power distribution, control systems, and electrical code compliance.

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* Professional Engineering (PE) license strongly preferred.
* Certifications such as LEED, CEM, or CPD are a plus.
* Modular construction or data center infrastructure design experience.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.  

* Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
* Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
* Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.  

* Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
* Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
* Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
* Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
* Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
* Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

new_jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

You will be joining Valar Atomics' I&C and Controls Engineering team within the Fuel Manufacturing group. I&C Hardware Engineers own the physical measurement and control layer field instrumentation and final elements, control panels and I/O architecture, field wiring and network infrastructure, and safety instrumented system hardware. You will work alongside I&C Software, process, electrical, mechanical, and nuclear safety engineers in a hands-on environment where measurement quality and installation integrity directly support production reliability and nuclear safety. The team values technical depth, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first culture.

**The Role**

Valar Atomics is seeking an I&C Hardware Engineer to specify, design, install, commission, and maintain the instrumentation and control hardware for nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role covers field instrument and final element selection, control panel and I/O architecture design, hazardous area classification, safety instrumented system hardware, field wiring and network infrastructure, calibration, loop commissioning, and control loop tuning supporting both capital projects and ongoing plant operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Select, size, and specify field instrumentation including flow, pressure, differential pressure, temperature, level, and analytical devices; produce instrument data sheets, specifications, and requisitions.
* Size and specify final control elements including control valves, actuators, positioners, regulators, on-off valves, and flow elements; perform valve sizing, noise and cavitation checks, and actuator thrust verification.
* Design control panels and remote I/O architecture including enclosure layout and rating, I/O module and channel allocation, terminal and marshalling arrangement, power distribution, UPS sizing, isolators, and intrinsic safety barriers.
* Perform hazardous area classification and select equipment for classified areas in accordance with NEC Article 500/505 or IEC 60079; prepare intrinsic safety loop calculations and verify entity parameters.
* Develop and maintain instrumentation engineering documentation including the instrument index, loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, I/O lists, instrument location plans, cable schedules, and P&ID instrumentation mark-ups.
* Support safety instrumented system hardware scope including SIL determination input, safety sensor and final element selection, redundancy and voting architecture, proof test interval and procedure development, and SIL verification calculations in accordance with IEC 61511 and IEC 61508.
* Tune PID and advanced regulatory control loops; commission field instrumentation; diagnose and resolve loop deviations, valve response problems, and measurement quality issues.
* Establish and execute the instrument calibration program including calibration procedures, ranges, tolerances, traceability to NIST-referenced standards, calibration records, and recall scheduling.
* Specify and oversee installation of field wiring and physical OT network infrastructure including cable schedules, tray and conduit routing, media selection, signal and power segregation, grounding and shielding practice, and field switch and cabinet placement.
* Prepare and execute hardware FAT, SAT, and commissioning plans; perform point-to-point continuity checks, loop checks, calibration verification, and end-to-end interlock testing from sensor through final element; produce turnover and as-built documentation.
* Diagnose and resolve field faults including I/O channel failures, transmitter drift, positioner and actuator faults, and wiring, grounding, or noise-induced signal problems; perform root cause analysis and document corrective actions.
* Support instrument reliability engineering including criticality and spares analysis, failure rate data collection, preventive and predictive maintenance strategy, and obsolescence planning.
* Coordinate with process, mechanical, and piping engineers on instrument installation details including process connections, tapping point location, impulse lines, manifolds, heat tracing, and material compatibility for wetted parts.
* Coordinate with I&C Software Engineers on I/O assignment, tag naming, signal scaling, loop commissioning, and control of tuning parameter changes to ensure field hardware and control logic remain consistent.
* Provide technical direction to contractors, vendors, and installation crews on I&C hardware scope; review and redline vendor packages and installation deliverables to ensure compliance with project standards and nuclear quality requirements.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Mechanical, Chemical, or Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of instrumentation or I&C engineering experience in process industries.
* Hands-on experience specifying and sizing field instruments and control valves, and producing instrument data sheets.
* Experience developing instrumentation deliverables including loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, I/O lists, and cable schedules.
* Working knowledge of hazardous area classification (NEC Article 500/505 or IEC 60079) and intrinsic safety principles.
* Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, electrical schematics, loop diagrams, and instrument data sheets.

new_jobs.description:
**About Overview Energy**

Overview Energy is a mission-driven team committed to building a new layer of energy infrastructure: satellites in geosynchronous orbit that redirect solar energy to terrestrial solar projects via passively safe near-infrared light. We’re in the earliest phase, where every circuit board and harness that leaves our facility is designed, built, and tested end-to-end by a small, dedicated team. Headquartered in the Northern Virginia / Washington, DC area and backed by world-class investors, we are advancing the next generation of clean energy technology.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the electronics behind our flight and ground hardware. You’ll report directly to our lead electrical engineer and work daily with our mechanical, embedded software, and systems engineers.

This is a generalist seat. One week you’re capturing a schematic and bringing up a new board on the bench. The next, you’re holding a supplier to its statement of work and checking that what ships matches what we specified.

This is built for someone a few years into their career who has already put real hardware on a bench and wants a far bigger slice of the system than a large prime can offer. The role is onsite daily at our Ashburn Virginia facility.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and capture schematics for analog, digital, and power boards: sensors, data acquisition, power delivery, and the interfaces between them.
* Select components, build BOMs, and see boards through fabrication and assembly.
* Bring up new PCBs with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench supplies, then debug and characterize them against requirements.
* Support systems engineering on requirements, architecture, and interfaces.
* Design and document wire harnesses and interconnects: wire gauge, connectors, pinouts, and interface control documents (ICDs).
* Manage electronics suppliers and contractors: review statements of work, track deliverables, and verify what arrives against spec.
* Run power budgets and first-pass thermal and EMI checks, applying derating and space-environment practices to every design.
* Write test procedures and scripts that automate measurements and data analysis.
* Drive hardware anomalies to root cause and close out corrective actions.
* Write complete design reports, ICDs, and test procedures, so the next engineer can pick up your work without a meeting.

**What We’re Looking For From You**

* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 2–5+ years of hands-on electrical hardware experience. Internships and co-ops count, as does a substantial hardware program such as CubeSat, Formula SAE, solar car, hybrid/EV, rocketry, or UAV teams.
* At least one piece of hardware you designed, built, or tested end-to-end and can walk us through on a whiteboard.
* Solid fundamentals in analog and digital circuits, plus enough embedded experience to work with microcontrollers and common communication buses.
* Schematic capture experience in Altium, KiCad (preferred), or a similar tool.
* Comfort on the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Some experience working with an external supplier or contractor, even a single one on a single program.
* Ability to work onsite at our Northern Virginia facility.

**We Have a Strong Preference For**

* Hardware that has flown, or a full program cycle in space, aerospace, UAV, or another high-reliability field.
* Exposure to environmental testing: vibration, shock, and thermal vacuum.
* Familiarity with circuit design in LTspice or related simulation platforms such as SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, PLECS, or Qspice
* Power electronics or battery system experience.
* Wire harness design and fabrication.
* Range across mechanical, electrical, and embedded work.

The salary band for this position is $110,000 - $150,000 commensurate with experience. Individuals with demonstrated exceptional ability may be considered beyond this band.

**Our Benefits**

We take care of our people. In addition to competitive salary and equity, Overview Energy offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, a health and wellness stipend, 4 weeks paid time off, 2 weeks sick leave, parental leave, and 401(k) matching. Benefits are subject to change at the Company's discretion.

**ITAR Requirements**

This position is subject to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Overview Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at talent@overviewenergy.com.

Research shows that women and individuals from underrepresented groups often only apply for roles where they meet every listed qualification. If you believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply - even if you don't check every box.

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

Rocket Lab's Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Principal Software Engineer for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Chantilly, VA, you will design flight software in support of spacecraft for Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Play a key role supporting the development of payload flight software for our Space Systems programs.

* Experience designing flight software.

* Familiarity with high-performance and parallel processing.
* Exposure to novel architectures including FPGA, CUDA, etc.

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. * You have demonstrated problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with limited supervision.
* You have the ability to provide technical guidance, support team collaboration, and contribute to a professional engineering environment.
* You have a commitment to safety, quality, continuous improvement, and ongoing technical development.
* You have SAP experience, which is preferred.
* You have proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* You have thorough knowledge of and hands-on experience with PLC and IPC programming.

new_jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

**About WSDOT**

The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation!

Washington State Ferries (WSF) is an essential part of Washington's transportation network. Every year, we carry nearly 20 million passengers across Puget Sound and the San Juan Islands on more than 400 sailings a day. Our dedicated teams with over 2,100 people work together to serve our communities and shape the future of ferry travel.

  
  

**The Opportunity**

WSF, a division of WSDOT, is currently seeking an engineering professional with maritime experience to support the electrical systems that keep Washington’s ferry fleet operating safely and reliably. Working under the direction of the Chief Naval Architect, this position contributes to vessel modifications, repairs, and new construction that sustain essential ferry service. Maritime experience is critical to developing designs that address vessel operating conditions and meet applicable marine regulatory and electrical standards. Join a team dedicated to strengthening fleet reliability and serving the communities that depend on Washington State Ferries.

As we navigate a once-in-a-generation transformation to decarbonize our system — guided by our core values Serve, Respect, Trust, Grow Navigate, and bold strategic priorities Service Excellence, Improved Communication and Empowered People — there’s never been a more meaningful time to come aboard at Washington State Ferries.

  

**What to Expect**

Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, you/the Electrical Engineer 4 will:

* Apply maritime electrical engineering expertise to design ferry vessel modifications, repairs, and new construction.
* Prepare calculations, specifications, and drawings for vessel power, lighting, communications, and navigation systems, including short-circuit and power analyses.
* Verify vessel-specific compliance with USCG, ABS, IMO/SOLAS, IEEE, and NEC requirements.
* Lead electrical installation design and coordinate engineering support for complex vessel projects.
* Conduct ship checks, verify drawings and calculations, confirm As-Built conditions, and prepare regulatory and stakeholder reports.
* Develop technical and cost information and specifications for equipment, materials, and shipyard installations and removals.
* Review vendor, consultant, contractor, and design work for accuracy and compliance with calculations, specifications, and contract requirements.
* Troubleshoot vessel electrical and electronic systems; provide technical assistance and training to vessel engineering and Eagle Harbor staff.
* Uphold WSF’s strategic priorities (Service Excellence, Improved Communication, and Empowered People) and values (Serve, Grow, Trust, Respect, and Navigate), ensuring they are embedded in WSF’s culture through leadership actions

**Qualifications**

To be considered for this opportunity, the following are required:

* **Service-Oriented –** Demonstrates a willingness to take action to meet the needs of others.
* **Growth Mindset –** Actively demonstrates a commitment to learning and growth.
* Experience contributing to a work environment that fosters a culture of respect and equal opportunity.
* Experience in shipyard or consulting Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering Design Office dealing with shipboard electrical systems.
* Registered as a Professional Engineer in electrical engineering in Washington State, or registration in another state with the ability to obtain Washington State licensure within six months of appointment.
* Ability to apply first-principles engineering methods to perform calculations and technical analyses in support of vessel systems and equipment.
* Ability to critically interpret and verify engineering drawings and technical specifications, and to develop accurate, well-structured reports and documentation in support of vessel equipment modification, correction, and installation.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS)
new_jobs.description:
Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS) Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. This covers the board support package (BSP), kernel, OS image, update system, real-time behavior, GPU platform, and fleet tooling across every robot program and compute platform (AGX Thor, IGX Thor, and future NVIDIA silicon)
* Architect the next-generation OS image, including the move to a Yocto / meta-tegra based build. Make it reproducible, hermetic and secure, and make it fast for many engineers to iterate on
* Define and drive the production update strategy: atomic A/B and over-the-air updates, rollback, secure and verified boot, fusing and signing, and factory provisioning, so we can ship to a growing fleet safely
* Shape the platform's real-time architecture. Help define how CPU cores, interrupts, memory and the GPU are divided between control loops at kilohertz rates and large AI models. Set the latency budgets and the measurement infrastructure that proves we meet them
* Collaborate with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams alongside other Meta engineers: share requirements, push fixes upstream, and help plan how we adopt new Jetson Linux / JetPack releases with minimal fork debt
* Partner with electrical, firmware, and mechanical engineers on new compute and carrier-board designs. Weigh in early on SoC configuration, interfaces, power and thermal so boards are easier to bring up and software stays simpler
* Drive bring-up of new boards and modules end to end: boot chain (MB1/MB2, UEFI), BPMP and device tree, pinmux, PCIe/USB/Ethernet, power profiles, and the drivers for robot hardware (EtherCAT, USB-C power delivery, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, sensors, cameras)
* Help set the quality bar for the RT kernel and out-of-tree drivers: kernel configuration, ABI compatibility, and a plan to upstream changes or align with Meta's kernel instead of carrying long-lived patches
* Build the reliability and observability foundation: crash and kernel-log capture, symbolization, boot-time tracing, health telemetry, and fleet triage tooling, so that any robot failure can be diagnosed remotely
* Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, mentorship, and technical hiring. Grow OS and embedded talent on the team, and help shape on-call and operational practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 10+ years of experience building and shipping system software for embedded Linux or Android-based products
* Experience architecting and owning an operating system, BSP or platform software stack on a shipped hardware product
* Deep experience with C and Linux kernel internals, including device drivers, device tree, scheduling, interrupts, and memory management
* Proficient in at least one of C++, Rust or Python
* Experience driving new-SoC or new-board bring-up on ARM64, from boot chain through kernel to a production OS
* Experience designing OS image build and release systems, such as Yocto/OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, Debian packaging or AOSP, including the strategy for updates and release management
* Experience debugging hard cross-layer problems spanning hardware, firmware, kernel and user space
* Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams or organizations, including external silicon or hardware vendors

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience growing a platform from prototype to production fleet scale
* A track record of upstream contributions to the Linux kernel, Yocto or related open-source projects
* Experience designing secure boot, verified boot and OTA / A/B update systems for a large device fleet
* Experience with EtherCAT, CAN-FD or other robotics fieldbuses, and with host-to-microcontroller architectures (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
* GPU platform experience: CUDA, NVML/MIG, TensorRT, or deploying ML inference on edge devices alongside real-time workloads
* Deep hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson (Orin / Thor) and Jetson Linux / JetPack, including custom carrier-board bring-up, BCT/BPMP configuration, nvidia-oot, and flashing and mass-production tooling
* Experience with real-time Linux in production (PREEMPT\\_RT, CPU and interrupt isolation, latency analysis) for robotics, automotive, industrial or other safety-critical systems
* Experience with Yocto / meta-tegra, and with hermetic build and CI systems
* Experience with AOSP or other mobile/XR OS platform work: vendor BSP integration, HALs, SELinux, init, OTA, or kernel and vendor upgrade programs

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Echodyne offers the world's first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

**Principal Analog and Mixed Signal Electrical Engineer**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Echodyne is seeking a Principal Analog and Mixed-Signal Electrical Engineer to join the Advanced Technology Development team and lead new circuit architectures, signal-chain development, power solutions, and rapid hardware prototyping for future radar products.

new_jobs.title: Principal GNSS Systems Engineer, Amazon LEO
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Senior GNSS Systems Engineer with a minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in GNSS engineering, satellite systems, and advanced positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) technologies. This is a senior-level technical leadership role requiring deep, first-principles expertise across the full GNSS signal chain — from satellite constellation physics and signal generation through receiver design, carrier phase tracking, and precision position and time solutions delivered to ground terminals.  
The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of a custom satellite-based wireless positioning and timing transfer service operating across S-Band and L-Band frequencies. This system will transmit simultaneous multi-source signals that ground terminals can receive, correlate, and process to extract carrier phase differentials, enabling high-accuracy ranging, time delta computation, and precise geolocation. The role demands mastery of both the theoretical underpinnings of GNSS — including relativistic time corrections, ionospheric and tropospheric propagation modeling, and CDMA spreading code correlation — and the practical engineering required to implement real-world satellite communication subsystems. This position sits at the intersection of satellite communications engineering, precision time and frequency, and advanced signal processing. The engineer will own the GNSS subsystem architecture end-to-end, contribute to the TT&C subsystem, and serve as the technical authority on all matters related to satellite-based PNT service design, clock disciplining, and time transfer over wireless and optical physical mediums.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Senior GNSS Systems Engineer will serve as the technical lead and subsystem owner for the spacecraft GNSS architecture, driving all aspects of design from initial requirements definition through hardware acceptance.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Master's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field. A Bachelor's degree may be considered with exceptional demonstrated experience.
* Minimum 10 years of professional engineering experience in GNSS systems engineering, RF systems engineering, satellite payloads, TT&C design, or precision PNT system development.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least two of the major GNSS constellations (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo) at the signal and systems engineering level — not limited to receiver integration.
* Proven experience designing or significantly contributing to precision time transfer systems, including two-way time transfer (satellite or optical medium), with documented accuracy results at the nanosecond level or better.
* Demonstrated experience implementing Kalman filter-based navigation or timing solutions in real-world systems, with measurable performance results.
* Experience with RF systems engineering across S-Band and/or L-Band frequencies, including link budget derivation, antenna specifications, and receiver performance analysis.
* Proven track record managing RF hardware development cycles with external suppliers and defining strict test and qualification parameters for flight hardware.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience designing a custom satellite-based PNT service from initial concept through operational deployment — including waveform design, ground terminal specification, and algorithm development.
* Practical experience with optical time transfer systems (White Rabbit, TWFTF) and integration of optical and RF time references in hybrid synchronization networks.
* Expertise in Alternative PNT (Alt-PNT) system design and evaluation, including non-GNSS positioning technologies and GNSS-independent timing sources.
* Experience with GNSS security: anti-spoofing detection, signal authentication (OSNMA, Chimera), and cryptographic protection of PNT services.
* Background in precise orbit determination (POD) and its integration into GNSS timing error budgets for high-accuracy applications.
* Familiarity with satellite communication standards (CCSDS) and their application to TT&C and custom PNT service link layer design.
* Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for signal simulation, filter design, and automated test data analysis.

**Platform Engineer, Endpoint Engineering**
===========================================

*PLEASE NOTE: This position is located in Seattle, WA and requires attendance at our office three days a week.*

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're seeking a Platform Engineer to join the Endpoint Engineering team within Digital Workplace. Our team treats Windows and Mac endpoints as products, building, securing, and delivering them through code, automation, and repeatable pipelines.

In this role, you'll help manage and improve the platforms that support every employee device at LendingTree, including Microsoft Intune, Iru, and our patching and security tools. You'll work at the intersection of IT and software engineering, using scripting, automation, version control, and CI/CD practices to deliver secure, reliable, and compliant endpoints. You'll also have the opportunity to strengthen your software engineering skills by working alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative, learning-focused environment.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* **Support and improve endpoint platforms:** Maintain and troubleshoot endpoint management solutions, including Microsoft Intune, Iru, and ManageEngine Endpoint Central, while supporting Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices.
* **Automate endpoint management:** Develop and maintain PowerShell and Python scripts and API integrations to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and streamline endpoint operations.
* **Build and maintain deployment pipelines:** Support CI/CD pipelines that validate, package, test, and deploy applications, scripts, and policies through test and pilot rings into production.
* **Strengthen endpoint security and compliance:** Implement and maintain security baselines, encryption, endpoint detection and response (EDR), Conditional Access, and device compliance policies in partnership with Information Security.
* **Improve reliability and visibility:** Monitor endpoint health, patching, and compliance metrics; maintain dashboards and alerts; troubleshoot issues; and support incident response and root cause analysis.
* **Apply engineering best practices:** Maintain endpoint configurations as code in Git, participate in code reviews, validate changes before broad deployment, and create documentation that supports reliable operations.

**Who You'll Work With**
------------------------

You'll join the Endpoint Engineering team within Digital Workplace, working alongside senior engineers who will help you develop your technical and software engineering skills. You'll collaborate with Information Security, Identity & Access Management, Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Service Desk, and Productivity Apps teams to deliver secure, reliable endpoint experiences across LendingTree.

The team emphasizes collaboration, code review, automation, documentation, and repeatable engineering practices. You'll have opportunities to contribute to larger endpoint initiatives while taking ownership of assigned work and learning from experienced teammates.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 4+ years of related experience supporting enterprise endpoints across Windows and macOS.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and a macOS mobile device management (MDM) platform, such as Iru, Jamf, or a similar solution.
* Experience writing automation scripts, with PowerShell required and some experience in Python or another general-purpose programming language.
* Working knowledge of Git, including commits, branches, and pull request workflows.
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and pipelines, such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Experience working with REST APIs, ideally Microsoft Graph, and an understanding of REST/JSON integrations.
* Experience packaging and deploying applications to managed endpoints.
* Understanding of Entra ID, Conditional Access, device compliance, endpoint security baselines, disk encryption, and EDR solutions such as Microsoft Defender.
* Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows 10/11 and macOS, with familiarity in iOS and Android device management.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, particularly across endpoint, enrollment, and policy issues.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**What Will Help You Thrive**
-----------------------------

* **Product mindset:** You think about the endpoint as a product and the employee as the customer, focusing on reliability, security, and user experience.
* **Automation mindset:** You look for opportunities to eliminate repetitive tasks, improve consistency, and make endpoint operations more efficient.
* **Engineering curiosity:** You're interested in learning software engineering practices, improving your scripting skills, and understanding how code and automation can improve IT operations.
* **Problem-solving approach:** You investigate issues methodically, look beyond immediate symptoms, and work toward identifying root causes.
* **Collaboration:** You're open to feedback, comfortable asking questions, and willing to share knowledge and work through challenges with teammates.
* **Ownership and accountability:** You manage your work, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for the quality and reliability of your deliverables.
* **Attention to detail:** You value clear documentation, readable code, testing, version control, and thoughtful change management.
* **Growth mindset:** You're willing to take on challenges, learn from mistakes, and build new technical capabilities through pairing, code reviews, and guidance from senior engineers.

new_jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Infrastructure and Security
new_jobs.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future. Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Home Software Platform (HSP) is the shared cloud foundation behind Generac's connected home energy products - PWRcell, PWRmicro, HSB Generator, Load Management, and HEMS. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer focused on Infrastructure and Security, you will shape how that platform is architected and defended: designing the cloud infrastructure behind Generac's home energy software - the applications, services, data, and connected devices it spans - and embedding security into every layer of it. You will work closely with SRE and engineering teams to lead and influence technical direction across the platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with organization-wide technical influence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide architectural leadership and direct technical influence over HSP-wide infrastructure decisions on AWS, defining the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that engineering teams build on across the platform.
* Design scalable, resilient, cost-efficient infrastructure for a high-volume cloud platform - APIs and services, data and streaming pipelines, compute and storage, and device-to-cloud data flows.
* Help shape infrastructure-as-code standards (Terraform, AWS CDK, or equivalent) so that environments are reproducible, reviewable, and auditable end to end.
* Drive the platform's security posture as a first-class design concern: threat modeling, secrets management, network segmentation, and data protection for device and consumer data.
* Lead cloud security architecture across the AWS account structure: IAM boundaries, least-privilege access, encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
* Partner with SRE teams to strengthen the observability and reliability backbone - metrics, tracing, logging, alerting, and SLOs.
* Partner with product engineering teams to review designs, unblock hard infrastructure and security problems, and raise the bar on operational and secure-coding practices through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Contribute to multi-year platform architecture and technology strategy, translating platform capabilities into concrete, buildable infrastructure and security roadmaps.
* Lead build-vs-buy evaluations for infrastructure and security tooling, and guide the technical integration of selected third-party services.
* Partner with SRE teams to drive cost visibility and optimization across the cloud estate without compromising reliability or security.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a substantial focus on cloud infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting production systems on a major public cloud, preferably AWS.
* Several years of hands-on security engineering across secure architecture, identity and access management, and threat modeling, applied to large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency with infrastructure-as-code, containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and modern observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Deep familiarity with the AWS security and networking stack (IAM, KMS, VPC design, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config, WAF).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code at scale using Terraform and/or AWS CDK, including module design and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Track record of building high-volume distributed cloud platforms; experience with device-to-cloud patterns (OTA update, edge computing, telemetry pipelines) is a plus.
* Experience securing consumer data and connected-device fleets, including relevant privacy and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar).
* Proficiency with container orchestration (Kubernetes / EKS) and event-driven and streaming architectures.
* Practitioner-level experience building or deploying AI/LLM-powered applications and tooling, including hands-on use of Claude via Amazon Bedrock.
* Familiarity with the home energy domain - HEMS, demand response, utility APIs, and grid-services integrations.
* Strong technical-communication skills: able to translate complex infrastructure and security trade-offs into clear, actionable narratives for engineering teams and technical stakeholders.
* A track record of raising engineering standards through mentorship, design review, and pragmatic technical leadership.

Generac is committed to fair and equity compensation practices. The salary range for this role based in Pewaukee, WI is $141,400 - $190,900. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate's relevant work experience, skills, certifications and geographic location. This position includes a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision plans; life, long-term disability, flexible, spending and health savings accounts, accrued paid time off, eight paid holidays in 401(k) retirement benefits.

Company Overview:

**Work Where it Matters**

Akima Data Management (ADM), an Akima company, is not just another federal IT contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At ADM, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

**For our shareholders,** ADM provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

**For our government customers,** ADM delivers agile and innovative cloud and IT services and solutions that enable mission dominance.

**As an ADM employee,** you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

Description:

ADM is looking for a System Engineer II to work in Washington, DC. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

Responsibilities:

* Serve as a seasoned expert with a strong background in installing, configuring, and administering Windows Servers and Windows operating systems.
* Responsible for the overall systems infrastructure including engineering, implementation and integration, and technical services and support.
* Designs, implements, installs, maintains, and administers infrastructures including hardware, software, and various configurations.

* Requires a senior-level knowledge of TCP/IP network design and support, including proficiency with Cisco equipment, LAN and WLAN networks, routing, and sub-netting is essential.

* Demonstrate minimum of 5 years of experience performing network monitoring of the network to include all assets.
* Demonstrate minimum of 5 years of experience providing technical support, advice and troubleshooting for utility network operations with a 99.999% target network uptime.
* Demonstrate minimum of 5 years of experience producing documentation for use in configuration, repair and troubleshooting of hardware, software and network operating systems.

* Demonstrate minimum of 5 years of experience troubleshooting, resolving, and communicating networking issues to other employees and management.
* Demonstrate minimum of 5 years of experience installing and configuring network equipment.
* Document minimum of 5 years of experience regarding the ability to analyze and evaluate networks, identify issues and provide solutions to ensure networks are operating efficiently.
